}

async function server() {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || os.tmpdir(), 'nfsu2-page-test-'));
  let data = process.env.NFSU2_DATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'projects/nsfu2/Need for Speed - Underground 2');
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(data, 'SPEED2.EXE'))) {
    data = path.join(tmp, 'game');
    fs.mkdirSync(data);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(data, 'SPEED2.EXE'), 'MZ');
  }
  const srv = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', data, '--http-port', String(PORT), '--state', path.join(tmp, 'state')]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let o = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start: ' + o)), 15000);
    srv.stdout.on('data', d => { o += d; if (o.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    srv.on('exit', c => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error('server exited ' + c + ' ' + o)); });
  });
  return {
    stop: async () => {
      const gone = srv.exitCode !== null || srv.signalCode !== null ? null : new Promise(r => srv.once('exit', r));
      srv.kill(); await gone;
      fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
    },
  };
}

/** In the page: how much wider than the screen it is, and the boxes and text that reach past the screen's edges or
 *  into their panel's padding (unless a box that clips them keeps them in), in the window's coordinates */
function measure() {
  const vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth, past = [], intoPadding = [];
  const name = el => {
    const set = el.closest('.set[data-key]'), sec = el.closest('section, .top');
    return `${sec ? (sec.id || sec.className.split(' ')[0]) + ' ' : ''}${set && set !== el ? `[${set.dataset.key}] ` : ''}${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}` +
      `${el.id ? '#' + el.id : ''}${typeof el.className === 'string' && el.className ? '.' + el.className.trim().split(/\s+/).join('.') : ''}`;
  };
  /** a box from el up to stop that clips what reaches past right */
  const clipped = (el, stop, right) => {
    for (let a = el; a && a !== stop; a = a.parentElement)
      if (getComputedStyle(a).overflowX !== 'visible' && a.getBoundingClientRect().right <= right + 0.5) return true;
    return false;
  };
  const check = (el, b, what) => {
    if (!b.width && !b.height) return;
    if ((b.right > vw + 0.5 || b.left < -0.5) && !clipped(el, null, vw)) past.push(`${what} ${b.left.toFixed(1)}..${b.right.toFixed(1)}`);
    const panel = el.closest('.panel, .top');
    if (!panel || panel === el || el.closest('.top > .bar')) return;   // the loading bar: a line along the header's edge
    const ps = getComputedStyle(panel), pb = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    const left = pb.left + parseFloat(ps.paddingLeft) + parseFloat(ps.borderLeftWidth);
    const right = pb.right - parseFloat(ps.paddingRight) - parseFloat(ps.borderRightWidth);
    if ((b.right > right + 0.5 || b.left < left - 0.5) && !clipped(el, panel, right))
      intoPadding.push(`${what} ${b.left.toFixed(1)}..${b.right.toFixed(1)}, its panel's ${left.toFixed(1)}..${right.toFixed(1)}`);
  };
  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.app *')) {
    if (el.closest('svg') && el.tagName.toLowerCase() !== 'svg') continue;
    if (el.getClientRects().length) check(el, el.getBoundingClientRect(), name(el));
  }
  // text: a word wider than its box reaches out of the box, which itself stays in
  const walk = document.createTreeWalker(document.querySelector('.app'), NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT), r = document.createRange();
  for (let n = walk.nextNode(); n; n = walk.nextNode()) {
    if (!n.data.trim() || !n.parentElement.getClientRects().length) continue;
    r.selectNodeContents(n);
    check(n.parentElement, r.getBoundingClientRect(), `"${n.data.trim().slice(0, 24)}" in ${name(n.parentElement)}`);
  }
  return { wider: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - vw, past, intoPadding };
}

/** In the page: the families its font (--font) names, and those the browser has (one it lacks draws a line of text as
 *  wide as the generic family after it) */
function fontsHad() {
  const named = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--font').split(',').map(f => f.trim())
    .filter(f => f && !/^(serif|sans-serif|monospace|cursive|fantasy|system-ui|ui-[a-z-]+)$/.test(f));
  const g = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  const w = font => { g.font = `16px ${font}`; return g.measureText('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123').width; };
  return { named, had: named.filter(f => ['monospace', 'serif'].some(b => w(`${f}, ${b}`) !== w(b))) };
}

/** One browser's pass over every language (touch: as a phone): what is too wide, by look; how many looks; the page's
 *  phase; its errors */
async function look(browser, kind, touch) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: WIDTH, height: 640 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, hasTouch: touch, isMobile: touch });
  try {
    const page = await ctx.newPage();
    const errors = [], found = {};
    let looks = 0;
    page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(String(e)));
    await page.goto(`http://localhost:${PORT}/`);
    const phase = await page.waitForFunction(() => ['ready', 'error'].includes(window.__nfsu2?.phase) && window.__nfsu2.phase, null, { timeout: 120_000, polling: 250 }).then(h => h.jsonValue());
    const fonts = await page.evaluate(fontsHad);
    if (!fonts.had.length) throw new Error(`none of the page's fonts (${fonts.named.join(', ')}) is on this machine: the browser ` +
      'draws its text in a fallback with other widths, so what it measures is not the page players see' +
      (process.platform === 'linux' ? ' (install fonts-liberation: Arial\'s widths)' : ''));
    // the language is a setting: the tab owns the saves and has read its settings
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('#settings .set') && !document.querySelector('#settings').hasAttribute('data-readonly'), null, { timeout: 30_000 });
    await page.click('#vault-make');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('#vault-on').hidden, null, { timeout: 30_000 });
    const frames = () => page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready.then(() => new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)))));
    for (const lang of LANGUAGES) {
      if (await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#lang-pick').value) !== lang) {
        const was = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.lang);
        await page.selectOption('#lang-pick', lang);
        await page.waitForFunction(w => document.documentElement.lang !== w, was, { timeout: 15_000 });
      }
      for (const shown of ['as it is', 'everything shown']) {
        await page.evaluate(all => {
          for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('.app details')) d.open = true;
          // (a tab's pane is the tabs' to show)
          if (all) window.__shown = [...document.querySelectorAll('.app [hidden]:not(.tab-panel):not(.pane)')].map(el => { el.hidden = false; return el; });
        }, shown === 'everything shown');
        for (const [panel, tab, sub] of VIEWS) {
          await page.click(`#${panel} > .tabs > .tab[data-tab="${tab}"]`);
          if (sub) await page.click(`#keys .tab[data-tab="${sub}"]`);
          await frames();
          const m = await page.evaluate(measure);
          looks++;
          if (m.wider > 0 || m.past.length || m.intoPadding.length) found[`${kind}, ${lang}, ${shown}, ${[tab, sub].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} tab`] = m;
        }
        await page.click('#settings > .tabs > .tab[data-tab="controls"]');
        await page.click('#keys .tab[data-tab="keys"]');
        await page.click('#about > .tabs > .tab[data-tab="about"]');
        await page.click('#settings > .tabs > .tab[data-tab="saves"]');
        // hidden again, as the page had them, before the next language
        await page.evaluate(() => { for (const el of window.__shown ?? []) el.hidden = true; window.__shown = []; });
      }
    }
    return { found, looks, phase, errors };
  } finally {
    await ctx.close();
  }
}

function seal(f) {
  f.writeUInt32LE(P.checksum(f.subarray(28, 36)), 16); f.writeUInt32LE(P.checksum(f.subarray(36)), 20); f.writeUInt32LE(P.checksum(f.subarray(0, 24)), 24);

/**
 * A profile as the game writes one, as far as the page reads it: the 31 stock cars, a
 * career car (type name or hash), the 6 preset cars, the name inside.

function profile(name, { career = ['240SX'], stock = 31, custom = [], inside = name, version = 0x10D } = {}) {

  f.write('20CM', 0, 'latin1');

  f.writeUInt32LE(version, 28); f.writeUInt32LE(54930, 32);
  const type = c => typeof c === 'number' ? c : P.bStringHash(c);
  for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) f.writeUInt32LE(i < stock ? i : 0xFFFFFFFF, B + i * 24 + 20);
  f.writeUInt32LE(stock, B + 1152);
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) f.writeUInt32LE(2, B + 1156 + i * 1072 + 16);
  custom.forEach((c, i) => f.writeUInt32LE(type(c), B + 1156 + i * 1072 + 28));
  career.forEach((c, i) => f.writeUInt32LE(type(c), B + 22596 + i * 2034 + 28));
  ['MIATA', 'FOCUS', '240SX', 'COROLLA', 'PEUGOT', 'FOCUS'].forEach((c, i) => f.writeUInt32LE(type(c), B + 32770 + i * 1076 + 28));
  f.write(inside, B + 53761, 'latin1');
  return seal(f);
}
/** a cover shoot's file: the same container, 1,048,612 bytes */
const cover = n => { const d = new Uint8Array(1048612); d.set(enc.encode('20CM')); d[40] = n.length; return d; };
const z = files => zip(Object.entries(files).map(([name, data]) => ({ name, data: typeof data === 'string' ? enc.encode(data) : data })));
const sorted = a => [...a].sort();
const paths = r => sorted(r.entries.map(e => e.path));

test('bStringHash gives the car type hashes the game data holds (CarTypeInfo +0xd0)', () => {
  assert.equal(P.bStringHash('PEUGOT'), 0x72b2e513);
  assert.equal(P.bStringHash('240SX'), 0x0150fb80);
  assert.equal(P.bStringHash('IMPREZAWRX'), 0xcf4458f8);
  assert.equal(P.bStringHash('TAXI'), 0x001d1775);
});

test('modCars: none among the game\'s own cars; a car type past them, by index or by hash', () => {
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A')), 0);
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { career: [] })), 0, 'no career car yet');
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { career: ['240SX', 'SKYLINE', 'RX8'], custom: ['GOLF'] })), 0);
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { career: ['240SX', 0x1badcafe] })), 1, 'a career car of an unknown type');
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { custom: [0xdeadbeef, 'MIATA'] })), 1, 'a customized one');
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { career: ['TAXI'] })), 0, 'a traffic car is one of the game\'s car types');
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { career: ['HATCHBACK02', 'FIRETRUCK'], custom: ['BUS'] })), 0);
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { stock: 46 })), 0, 'stock cars of every car type, traffic too');
  assert.equal(P.modCars(profile('A', { stock: 48 })), 2, 'two car types past the game\'s 46');
});

/** a GARAGE.DAT (slots 6-10, runtime/garage.c): its head, then 5 career cars; cars: [car type, owned] of each */
function garage(cars = []) {
  const f = Buffer.alloc(32 + 5 * 2034);
  f.writeUInt32LE(0x4147324E, 0); f.writeUInt32LE(1, 4);
  cars.forEach(([c, owned], i) => { f.writeUInt32LE(typeof c === 'number' ? c : P.bStringHash(c), 32 + i * 2034 + 28); f[32 + i * 2034 + 1073] = owned ? 1 : 0; });
  return new Uint8Array(f.buffer, f.byteOffset, f.length);
}

test('garageModCars: slots 6-10 of a car type the game does not have', () => {
  assert.equal(P.garageModCars(undefined), 0);
  assert.equal(P.garageModCars(garage([['RX7', 1], ['TAXI', 1]])), 0);
  assert.equal(P.garageModCars(garage([['RX7', 1], [0x1badcafe, 1], [0x5ec0ffee, 0]])), 1, 'an empty slot\'s leftovers are no car');
  const v2 = garage([[0x1badcafe, 1]]); v2[4] = 2;
  assert.equal(P.garageModCars(v2), 0, 'another version: not read');
  assert.equal(P.garageModCars(garage([[0x1badcafe, 1]]).subarray(0, 100)), 0);
});

test('profileName: the checks of a profile from elsewhere, and why one is refused', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(profile('Velkira')), { name: 'Velkira', edited: false });
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('Velkira')); edited[0xA16A] ^= 0x40;      // a save editor's money change
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(edited), { name: 'Velkira', edited: true });
  const head = Buffer.from(profile('Velkira')); head[16] ^= 1;                 // block A's checksum alone
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(head), { name: 'Velkira', edited: true });
  const old = profile('Velkira', { version: 0x10C }); old[0xA16A] ^= 0x40;
  assert.match(P.profileName(old).bad, /another version/, 'another version stays out, edited or not');
  assert.match(P.profileName(profile('Velkira', { version: 0x10C })).bad, /another version/);
  assert.match(P.profileName(profile('X', { inside: 'SIXTEENLETTERSXX' })).bad, /not one the game makes/);
  for (const inside of ['a  b', ' ab', 'ab ', 'a.b', 'Zoë', 'ab DVD 1'])
    assert.match(P.profileName(profile('X', { inside })).bad, /not one the game makes/, inside);
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(profile('X', { inside: 'Big Bad__Wolf-2' })), { name: 'Big Bad__Wolf-2', edited: false }, '15 with spaces');
  assert.match(P.profileName(profile('Velkira').subarray(0, 54000)).bad, /54000 bytes/);
});

test('sealed: an edited profile\'s checksums made again, its bytes kept; the game\'s own file comes out as it was', () => {
  const good = profile('Velkira');
  assert.deepEqual([...P.sealed(good)], [...good]);
  const edited = Buffer.from(good); edited[0xA16A] ^= 0x40; edited[16] ^= 1; edited[24] ^= 0xff;
  const s = P.sealed(new Uint8Array(edited));
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(s), { name: 'Velkira', edited: false });
  assert.deepEqual(P.readSaveMode(s, 'Velkira'), { mode: 'off' }, 'the page\'s own checks take it from now on');
  const changed = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) if (s[i] !== edited[i]) changed.push(i);
  assert.ok(changed.every(i => i >= 16 && i < 28), `only the checksums change: ${changed}`);
  assert.equal(s[0xA16A], edited[0xA16A], 'the edit stays');
  assert.equal(edited[16], good[16] ^ 1, 'the original is not touched');
});

test('a PC save\'s profiles are found wherever the zip has them', async () => {
  const folder = await readBackup(z({
    [at('Velkira')]: profile('Velkira'), [at('Velkira DVD 1')]: cover('a'), [at('Velkira Magazine 1')]: cover('b'),
    [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH'), [`${DIR}/desktop.ini`]: '[.ShellClassInfo]\n',
  }));
  assert.equal(folder.kind, 'profiles');
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(folder.profiles), ['MEH', 'Velkira']);
  assert.deepEqual(paths(folder), sorted([at('MEH'), at('Velkira'), at('Velkira DVD 1'), at('Velkira Magazine 1')]));
  assert.deepEqual(folder.skipped, [`${DIR}/desktop.ini`]);
  assert.deepEqual([folder.refused, folder.modded, folder.edited], [[], [], []]);

  const one = await readBackup(z({ 'Velkira/Velkira': profile('Velkira') }));
  assert.deepEqual([one.kind, paths(one)], ['profiles', [at('Velkira')]], 'one profile folder, zipped');
  const two = await readBackup(z({ 'A1/A1': profile('A1'), 'B2/B2': profile('B2'), 'B2 DVD 3/B2 DVD 3': cover('c') }));
  assert.deepEqual(paths(two), sorted([at('A1'), at('B2'), at('B2 DVD 3')]), 'profile folders at the top');
  const deep = await readBackup(z({ 'backup/AppData/Local/NFS Underground 2/A1/A1': profile('A1') }));
  assert.deepEqual(paths(deep), sorted([at('A1')]));
  const cased = await readBackup(z({ 'velkira/velkira': profile('Velkira'), 'velkira DVD 1/velkira DVD 1': cover('d') }));
  assert.deepEqual(paths(cased), sorted([at('Velkira'), at('Velkira DVD 1')]), 'named as inside, covers too');
  const orphan = await readBackup(z({ 'A1/A1': profile('A1'), 'OTHER DVD 1/OTHER DVD 1': cover('e') }));
  assert.deepEqual([paths(orphan), orphan.skipped], [[at('A1')], ['OTHER DVD 1/OTHER DVD 1']], 'a cover shoot without its profile');

  const file = await readBackup(profile('Velkira'), 'Velkira (1)');
  assert.deepEqual([file.kind, paths(file), file.profiles], ['profiles', [at('Velkira')], ['Velkira']], 'a profile\'s own file');
  const lone = await readBackup(cover('x'), 'Velkira DVD 1');
  assert.deepEqual([lone.profiles, lone.refused, lone.skipped], [[], [], ['Velkira DVD 1']], 'a cover shoot alone: no profile, nothing refused');
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('Velkira')); edited[5000] ^= 1;
  const editedFile = await readBackup(new Uint8Array(edited), 'Velkira');
  assert.deepEqual([editedFile.profiles, editedFile.edited, editedFile.refused], [['Velkira'], ['Velkira'], []], 'an edited profile\'s own file');
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(editedFile.entries[0].data), { name: 'Velkira', edited: false }, 'sealed again');
  const old = await readBackup(profile('Velkira', { version: 0x10C }), 'Velkira');
  assert.deepEqual([old.profiles, old.refused.map(x => x.name)], [[], ['Velkira']]);
  await assert.rejects(readBackup(enc.encode('just some text'), 'notes.txt'), /not a zip/);
});

test('a profile the game would not load is left out with why, its covers too; an edited one and a mod\'s cars warn', async () => {
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('EDIT')); edited[0xA16A] ^= 0x40;
  const r = await readBackup(z({
    [at('EDIT')]: new Uint8Array(edited), [at('EDIT DVD 1')]: cover('f'),
    [at('OLDV')]: profile('OLDV', { version: 0x10C }), [at('OLDV DVD 1')]: cover('o'),
    [at('MOD')]: profile('MOD', { career: ['240SX', 0x5ec0ffee] }), [at('OK')]: profile('OK'),
  }));
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(r.profiles), ['EDIT', 'MOD', 'OK']);
  assert.deepEqual([r.modded, r.edited], [['MOD'], ['EDIT']]);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(r.refused.map(x => [x.name, x.why])), { OLDV: 'saved by another version of the game (version 268, not 269)' });
  assert.deepEqual(paths(r), sorted([at('EDIT'), at('EDIT DVD 1'), at('MOD'), at('OK')]));
  assert.deepEqual(r.skipped, [at('OLDV DVD 1')]);
  const e = r.entries.find(x => x.path === at('EDIT')).data;
  assert.deepEqual([P.profileName(e), e[0xA16A]], [{ name: 'EDIT', edited: false }, edited[0xA16A]], 'sealed again, the edit kept');
  const none = await readBackup(z({ [at('OLDV')]: profile('OLDV', { version: 0x10C }) }));
  assert.deepEqual([none.kind, none.entries, none.refused.length], ['profiles', [], 1]);
});

test('a backup of the page\'s restores in place, without a profile the game would not load', async () => {
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('EDIT')); edited[9000] ^= 2;
  const r = await readBackup(z({
    'registry.txt': 'NotFirstTime=1\n', 'settings.ini': 'movies = off\n', 'nfsu2000.tga': new Uint8Array(40), 'autosave-profiles.txt': 'frik\n',
    [at('frik')]: profile('frik'), [at('frik DVD 1')]: cover('g'),
    [at('BAD')]: profile('BAD', { version: 0x10C }), [at('BAD Magazine 1')]: cover('h'), [at('MOD')]: profile('MOD', { custom: [0x12345678] }),
    [at('EDIT')]: new Uint8Array(edited), [`${DIR}/frik/GARAGE.DAT`]: garage([['GOLF', 1]]),
  }));
  assert.equal(r.kind, 'backup');
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(r.profiles), ['EDIT', 'MOD', 'frik'], 'a cover shoot is no profile');
  assert.deepEqual([r.modded, r.edited], [['MOD'], ['EDIT']]);
  const g = await readBackup(z({ 'registry.txt': 'x', [at('SIX')]: profile('SIX'), [`${DIR}/SIX/GARAGE.DAT`]: garage([['GOLF', 1], [0x0ddba11, 1]]) }));
  assert.deepEqual(g.modded, ['SIX'], 'a car in slots 6-10 a mod added');
  assert.deepEqual(r.refused.map(x => x.name), ['BAD']);
  assert.deepEqual(paths(r), sorted([at('EDIT'), at('MOD'), at('frik'), at('frik DVD 1'), `${DIR}/frik/GARAGE.DAT`, 'autosave-profiles.txt', 'nfsu2000.tga', 'registry.txt', 'settings.ini']));
  const e = r.entries.find(x => x.path === at('EDIT')).data;
  assert.deepEqual([P.profileName(e), e[9000]], [{ name: 'EDIT', edited: false }, edited[9000]], 'sealed again, the edit kept');
  // another name inside than its folder's: its folder's written inside (it used to be left out)
  const inside = await readBackup(z({ 'registry.txt': 'x', [at('NAMEA')]: profile('NAMEB') }));
  assert.deepEqual([inside.profiles, inside.refused, inside.repaired], [['NAMEA'], [], [{ name: 'NAMEA', to: 'NAMEA' }]]);
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(inside.entries.find(e => e.path === at('NAMEA')).data), { name: 'NAMEA', edited: false });
});

/** the save folder in memory, as savefs.ts filesOf gives it */
function folder(files) {
  const m = new Map(Object.entries(files));
  const writes = [];
  return {
    m, writes,
    listFiles: async () => [...m.keys()].sort().map(p => ({ path: p })),
    readBytes: async p => { if (!m.has(p)) throw new Error(`no ${p}`); const v = m.get(p); return typeof v === 'string' ? enc.encode(v) : v; },
    readText: async p => { const v = m.get(p); return v === undefined ? null : typeof v === 'string' ? v : new TextDecoder().decode(v); },
    writeFile: async (p, d) => { writes.push(p); m.set(p, d); },
    remove: async p => { writes.push(`-${p}`); for (const k of [...m.keys()]) if (k === p || k.startsWith(p + '/')) m.delete(k); },
  };
}

test('adding: a profile of the same name goes with its covers (in any case), all else stays', async () => {
  const tobi = profile('TOBI'), seen = '# the page\'s notes\nvelkira\nTOBI\n';
  const fs = folder({
    [at('velkira')]: profile('velkira'), [at('velkira DVD 1')]: cover('old1'), [at('velkira DVD 2')]: cover('old2'),
    [at('TOBI')]: tobi, [at('TOBI DVD 1')]: cover('t'), 'registry.txt': 'NotFirstTime=1\n', 'settings.ini': 'movies = off\n',
    [P.AUTOSAVE_SEEN]: seen,
  });
  const vel = profile('Velkira'), c1 = cover('new1');
  const r = await readBackup(z({ 'Velkira/Velkira': vel, 'Velkira DVD 1/Velkira DVD 1': c1, 'MEH/MEH': profile('MEH') }));
  await addProfiles(fs, r);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(fs.m.keys()), sorted([at('MEH'), at('TOBI'), at('TOBI DVD 1'), at('Velkira'), at('Velkira DVD 1'),
    P.AUTOSAVE_SEEN, 'registry.txt', 'settings.ini']));
  assert.deepEqual([...fs.m.get(at('Velkira'))], [...vel]);
  assert.deepEqual([...fs.m.get(at('Velkira DVD 1'))], [...c1]);
  assert.equal(fs.m.get(at('TOBI')), tobi);
  assert.equal(fs.m.get('settings.ini'), 'movies = off\n');
  assert.equal(fs.m.get(P.AUTOSAVE_SEEN), '# the page\'s notes\nTOBI\n', 'Autosave comes to it as to a new profile');
  assert.equal(fs.writes.findIndex(w => w.startsWith('-')), r.entries.length, `the new folders are written before the old ones go: ${fs.writes.join(', ')}`);
  assert.deepEqual(fs.writes.slice(r.entries.length), [`-${DIR}/velkira DVD 1`, `-${DIR}/velkira DVD 2`, `-${DIR}/velkira`, P.AUTOSAVE_SEEN]);

  // the same name exactly: the file is written over, an old cover shoot of it goes
  const fs2 = folder({ [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { career: ['RX7'] }), [at('MEH Magazine 2')]: cover('m') });
  const meh = profile('MEH');
  await addProfiles(fs2, await readBackup(meh, 'MEH'));
  assert.deepEqual([...fs2.m.keys()], [at('MEH')]);
  assert.deepEqual([...fs2.m.get(at('MEH'))], [...meh]);
  assert.deepEqual(fs2.writes, [at('MEH'), `-${DIR}/MEH Magazine 2`]);

  // ...and the old one's MPWINS.DAT goes with it (its career wins waiting for its garage are not the new one's); its
  // GARAGE.DAT stays (its fingerprint keeps it aside for a profile of other cars), and so do its MODPARTS.DAT and
  // MODPARTS.NEW when the restore brings none (each part there is put back only on the car of its fingerprint)
  const fs3 = folder({ [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { career: ['RX7'] }), [`${DIR}/MEH/MPWINS.DAT`]: 'N2MW', [`${DIR}/MEH/GARAGE.DAT`]: 'G',
    [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]: 'N2MP', [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.NEW`]: 'N2MP' });
  await addProfiles(fs3, await readBackup(meh, 'MEH'));
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(fs3.m.keys()), sorted([at('MEH'), `${DIR}/MEH/GARAGE.DAT`, `${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`, `${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.NEW`]));
  assert.deepEqual(fs3.writes, [at('MEH'), `-${DIR}/MEH/MPWINS.DAT`], 'the new profile is written before the old wins go; its mod parts stay');
  // a restore that brings its own MODPARTS.DAT (a zip of the PC game's folder): the one here and its MODPARTS.NEW go
  const fs4 = folder({ [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { career: ['RX7'] }), [`${DIR}/MEH/modparts.dat`]: 'N2MP old', [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.NEW`]: 'N2MP old' });
  await addProfiles(fs4, await readBackup(z({ [at('MEH')]: meh, [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]: 'N2MP new' })));
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(fs4.m.keys()), sorted([at('MEH'), `${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]));
  assert.equal(new TextDecoder().decode(fs4.m.get(`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`)), 'N2MP new');
});

test('the PC game\'s folder zipped (Compress-Archive, either slash) or a profile alone: its folder\'s GARAGE.DAT and MODPARTS.DAT come with it', async () => {
  const g = garage([['GOLF', 1], [0x0ddba11, 1]]);
  for (const sep of ['/', '\\']) {
    const r = await readBackup(z({
      [['NFS Underground 2', 'MEH', 'MEH'].join(sep)]: profile('MEH'), [['NFS Underground 2', 'MEH', 'GARAGE.DAT'].join(sep)]: g,
      [['NFS Underground 2', 'MEH', 'modparts.dat'].join(sep)]: 'N2MP', [['NFS Underground 2', 'MEH', 'MPWINS.DAT'].join(sep)]: 'N2MW',
      [['NFS Underground 2', 'OTHER', 'MODPARTS.DAT'].join(sep)]: 'N2MP of none',
    }));
    assert.equal(r.kind, 'profiles');
    assert.deepEqual(paths(r), sorted([at('MEH'), `${DIR}/MEH/GARAGE.DAT`, `${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]), `the side files, named as the game names them (${sep})`);
    assert.deepEqual(sorted(r.skipped), sorted([`${DIR}/MEH/MPWINS.DAT`, `${DIR}/OTHER/MODPARTS.DAT`]), 'a side file without its profile stays out');
    assert.deepEqual(r.modded, ['MEH'], 'its GARAGE.DAT\'s car a mod added: the warning');
  }
  // a profile mended (its name inside not one the game makes) takes its folder's side files under its new name
  const m = await readBackup(z({ [`${DIR}/MEH/MEH`]: profile('MEH', { inside: 'BAD NAME!' }), [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]: 'N2MP' }));
  assert.deepEqual(paths(m), sorted([at(m.profiles[0]), `${DIR}/${m.profiles[0]}/MODPARTS.DAT`]));
  // the profile's own file alone (picked, or at the zip's top): nothing beside it, and the MODPARTS.DAT here stays
  const lone = await readBackup(profile('MEH'), 'MEH');
  assert.deepEqual(paths(lone), [at('MEH')]);
  const fs5 = folder({ [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { career: ['RX7'] }), [`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`]: 'N2MP here' });
  await addProfiles(fs5, lone);
  assert.equal(fs5.m.get(`${DIR}/MEH/MODPARTS.DAT`), 'N2MP here', 'not written over, not removed');
  const top = await readBackup(z({ MEH: profile('MEH'), 'MODPARTS.DAT': 'N2MP' }));
  assert.deepEqual(paths(top), [at('MEH')], 'a MODPARTS.DAT at the zip\'s top is no profile folder\'s');
});

// The game's new-profile box in Chinese starts with its text D6 8B 89 (LANGPACKS/chinese, 0x818F0385), the field
// keeps what is typed after it: a profile named so, its folder as the I/O worker decodes the path (U+FFFD).
const ZH = Buffer.from([0xd6, 0x8b, 0x89]).toString('latin1') + 'ads';
const ZH_DIR = new TextDecoder().decode(Buffer.from(ZH, 'latin1'));
const nameOf = f => { let n = ''; for (let i = B + 53761; f[i]; i++) n += String.fromCharCode(f[i]); return n; };
/** the bytes two profile files differ in */
const diff = (a, b) => { const d = []; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) d.push(i); return d; };
const same = (a, b) => Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(a), Buffer.from(b)) === 0;
const nameOrSums = i => (i >= 20 && i < 28) || (i >= B + 53761 && i < B + 53761 + 32);

test('fixedName: its own name when the game makes it, else its letters and digits, the name inside\'s, or Profile; never one taken', () => {
  const none = new Set();
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('TOBI', ZH, none), 'TOBI');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName(ZH_DIR, ZH, none), 'ads', 'the folder\'s letters and digits');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('名稱', ZH, none), 'ads', 'the name inside\'s ASCII letters and digits (its other bytes are the game\'s font\'s)');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName(ZH_DIR, ZH, new Set(['ads'])), 'ads2', 'digits at the end of the first, when all are taken');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('名稱', '\x88\xa3\xd4', none), 'Profile', 'nothing of a name in either');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('Zoë-Racer 2', '', none), 'ZoeRace', 'seven of them at most');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('ads', ZH, new Set(['ads', 'oads', 'profile'])), 'ads2', 'digits at the end');
  assert.equal(P.fixedName('ABCDEFG', '', new Set(['abcdefg', 'profile', 'abcdef2'])), 'ABCDEF3');
});

test('a backup or a cloud version: a profile whose name inside the game does not make comes in mended, its folder\'s files and covers with it', async () => {
  const zh = profile('X', { inside: ZH }), garage = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]), dvd = cover('zh');
  const files = {
    'settings.ini': 'movies = off\n', [at('frik')]: profile('frik'),
    [at(ZH_DIR)]: zh, [`${DIR}/${ZH_DIR}/GARAGE.DAT`]: garage, [at(`${ZH_DIR} DVD 1`)]: dvd,
  };
  for (const [how, r] of [['backup', await readBackup(z({ 'registry.txt': 'x', ...files }))], ['cloud', await readVault(z(files))]]) {
    assert.equal(r.kind, 'backup', how);
    assert.deepEqual([sorted(r.profiles), r.refused, r.repaired, r.edited], [['ads', 'frik'], [], [{ name: ZH_DIR, to: 'ads' }], []], how);
    const covers = how === 'cloud' ? [] : [at('ads DVD 1')];          // covers stay in the browser that took them (vault.ts kept)
    assert.deepEqual(paths(r).filter(p => p.startsWith(DIR)), sorted([at('ads'), `${DIR}/ads/GARAGE.DAT`, ...covers, at('frik')]), how);
    const got = r.entries.find(e => e.path === at('ads')).data;
    assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(got), { name: 'ads', edited: false }, `${how}: the name written inside, the checksums made again`);
    assert.ok(diff(zh, got).every(nameOrSums), `${how}: nothing else changes`);
    assert.ok(got.subarray(B + 53761 + 3, B + 53761 + 32).every(b => b === 0), 'NUL-padded');
    assert.ok(same(r.entries.find(e => e.path === `${DIR}/ads/GARAGE.DAT`).data, garage), `${how}: slots 6-10 go with it`);
    if (covers.length) assert.ok(same(r.entries.find(e => e.path === at('ads DVD 1')).data, dvd), 'its cover shoot too');
    assert.ok(backupItems(r, how === 'cloud').includes(`${ZH_DIR}: its name inside was broken, so it comes in as ads.`), `${how}: the question says so`);
  }
  assert.equal(nameOf(zh), ZH, 'the file read is not touched');

  // a name taken already: the next one; a save editor's change too: sealed, with its warning; a profile of another
  // version stays out as before
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('X', { inside: ZH })); edited[0xA16A] ^= 0x40;
  const r = await readVault(z({ [at('ads')]: profile('ads'), [at(ZH_DIR)]: new Uint8Array(edited), [at('OLDV')]: profile('OLDV', { version: 0x10C }) }));
  assert.deepEqual([sorted(r.profiles), r.repaired, r.edited, r.refused.map(x => x.name)], [['ads', 'ads2'], [{ name: ZH_DIR, to: 'ads2' }], ['ads2'], ['OLDV']]);
  const e = r.entries.find(x => x.path === at('ads2')).data;
  assert.deepEqual([P.profileName(e), e[0xA16A]], [{ name: 'ads2', edited: false }, edited[0xA16A]]);
  // the folder's name when the game makes it; heap bytes of a failed cover save (2026-10-27) as well
  const heap = Buffer.from('a09c1d25f846232520d8252528d82525c4501e2530d82525cc501e25a89c1d25', 'hex').toString('latin1');
  const two = await readVault(z({ [at('DRIFTER')]: profile('X', { inside: ZH }), [at('TOBI')]: profile('X', { inside: heap }) }));
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(two.repaired.map(x => `${x.name}>${x.to}`)), ['DRIFTER>DRIFTER', 'TOBI>TOBI']);
  assert.deepEqual(paths(two), [at('DRIFTER'), at('TOBI')]);

test('the PC game\'s profiles: one whose name inside the game does not make comes in under its file\'s name, never one here', async () => {
  const zh = profile('X', { inside: ZH });
  const one = await readBackup(zh, 'DRIFTER');
  assert.deepEqual([one.kind, one.profiles, one.repaired, one.refused, paths(one)], ['profiles', ['DRIFTER'], [{ name: 'DRIFTER', to: 'DRIFTER' }], [], [at('DRIFTER')]]);
  assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(one.entries[0].data), { name: 'DRIFTER', edited: false });
  const here = await readBackup(zh, 'DRIFTER', ['drifter', 'TOBI']);
  assert.deepEqual([here.profiles, here.repaired], [['ads'], [{ name: 'DRIFTER', to: 'ads' }]], 'a profile here keeps its name: no replacing it');
  const named = await readBackup(zh, `${ZH_DIR} (1)`);
  assert.deepEqual(named.profiles, ['ads1'], 'the letters and digits of its file\'s name');
  const pc = await readBackup(z({ [`${DIR}/${ZH_DIR}/${ZH_DIR}`]: zh, [`${DIR}/${ZH_DIR} DVD 2/${ZH_DIR} DVD 2`]: cover('c'), 'MEH/MEH': profile('MEH') }));

  assert.deepEqual(paths(pc), sorted([at('MEH'), at('ads'), at('ads DVD 2')]), 'its cover shoot with it');
  // added beside the profiles here: nothing of theirs goes
  const fs = folder({ [at('TOBI')]: profile('TOBI'), [at('TOBI DVD 1')]: cover('t') });
  await addProfiles(fs, await readBackup(zh, 'TOBI', ['TOBI']));
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(fs.m.keys()), sorted([at('TOBI'), at('TOBI DVD 1'), at('ads')]));
});

test('the saves back in a save folder the browser deleted during a game: the cloud\'s with this device\'s own, or the start\'s', async () => {
  const dec = new TextDecoder(), text = (fs, p) => { const v = fs.m.get(p); return typeof v === 'string' ? v : dec.decode(v); };
  // the folder as the game's start had it: two profiles, this device's settings, the graphics options, the LAN file
  const start = [
    { path: at('TOP'), data: profile('TOP', { career: ['RX7'] }) }, { path: at('OLD'), data: profile('OLD') },
    { path: 'settings.ini', data: enc.encode('roam_name = Old\nfps = 120\n') }, { path: 'registry.txt', data: enc.encode('Res=1\n') },
    { path: 'gamefile.bin', data: new Uint8Array([7, 7]) }, { path: `${DIR}/TOP/GARAGE.DAT`, data: enc.encode('g-start') },
  ];
  // the cloud's version: newer TOP, a profile from another browser, its settings (none of the device's)
  const topFile = profile('TOP', { career: ['SKYLINE'] });
  const cloud = (await readVault(z({ [at('TOP')]: topFile, [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH'), [`${DIR}/TOP/GARAGE.DAT`]: 'g-cloud',
    'settings.ini': 'roam_name = Cloud\n' }))).entries;
  // the game wrote its profile already (the page answered late): it stays, the newest
  const mine = profile('TOP', { career: ['GTO'] });
  const absent = fs => async (p, d) => { if (fs.m.has(p)) return false; await fs.writeFile(p, d); return true; };
  const fs = folder({ [at('TOP')]: mine }); fs.writeIfAbsent = absent(fs);
  assert.deepEqual(await refillSaves(fs, cloud, start), { written: 6, failed: [] });
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(fs.m.keys()), sorted([at('TOP'), at('MEH'), at('OLD'), `${DIR}/TOP/GARAGE.DAT`, 'settings.ini', 'registry.txt', 'gamefile.bin']));
  assert.equal(fs.m.get(at('TOP')), mine, 'never over a file the folder has');
  assert.equal(text(fs, `${DIR}/TOP/GARAGE.DAT`), 'g-cloud');
  assert.match(text(fs, 'settings.ini'), /roam_name = Cloud/, 'the cloud\'s settings');
  assert.match(text(fs, 'settings.ini'), /^fps\s*=\s*120$/m, 'this device\'s own from the start');
  assert.doesNotMatch(text(fs, 'settings.ini'), /Old/);
  assert.deepEqual([text(fs, 'registry.txt'), [...fs.m.get('gamefile.bin')]], ['Res=1\n', [7, 7]], 'what a keyphrase never keeps, from the start');
  assert.equal(fs.m.get(at('OLD')), start[1].data, 'every file of the start the cloud lacks comes too (never one lost)');
  // no cloud saves: the start's, all of it
  const fs2 = folder({}); fs2.writeIfAbsent = absent(fs2);
  assert.deepEqual(await refillSaves(fs2, null, start), { written: start.length, failed: [] });
  for (const f of start) assert.equal(fs2.m.get(f.path), f.data, f.path);
  // a write that fails is tried again after the others; one that fails twice is said, the rest written
  const fs3 = folder({}), tries = {};
  fs3.writeIfAbsent = async (p, d) => { tries[p] = (tries[p] ?? 0) + 1; if (p === at('OLD') || (p === at('TOP') && tries[p] === 1)) throw new Error(`no room for ${p}`); return absent(fs3)(p, d); };
  const r3 = await refillSaves(fs3, null, start);
  assert.deepEqual([r3.written, r3.failed.map(f => f.path)], [start.length - 1, [at('OLD')]]);
  assert.ok(fs3.m.has(at('TOP')) && !fs3.m.has(at('OLD')));
  // the start follows the game's saves (shell.ts onSaved), but a file written to be renamed (registry.txt.tmp)
  const snap = start.slice(), newer = profile('OLD', { career: ['SUPRA'] });
  await snapshotFile(snap, 'x', at('OLD'), newer);
  await snapshotFile(snap, 'x', at('NEW'), profile('NEW'));
  await snapshotFile(snap, 'x', 'registry.txt.tmp', enc.encode('Res=2\n'));
  await snapshotFile(snap, 'x', 'nfsu2000.tga', new Uint8Array(9));
  assert.deepEqual(snap.map(f => f.path), [...start.map(f => f.path), at('NEW')]);
  assert.equal(snap.find(f => f.path === at('OLD')).data, newer);
});

// A phone's graphics (web/src/app/phonegraphics.ts): a new phone's registry is the built-in seed with six options
// off and the mark; a phone from before gets them once while every graphics option still has the seed's value, and
// only the mark when one was changed; a marked registry is left alone.  A new computer's registry has Full Scene
// Anti-Aliasing on; a tablet's is the seed.  A registry from before it (-1) is asked about it once.
//   node --test web/test/phonegraphics.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(ROOT, 'web/src/app/phonegraphics.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false })).outputFiles[0].text;
const { PHONE_GRAPHICS, PHONE_MARK, COMPUTER_GRAPHICS, FSAA_MARK, deviceSeed, fsaaAnswer, fsaaAsk, phoneSeed, phoneUpgrade, withDwords } = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(js).toString('base64'));
const SEED = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/registry-defaults.txt'), 'utf8');

const values = text => Object.fromEntries([...text.matchAll(/^d ([^=\n]+)=(\d+)\r?$/gm)].map(m => [m[1], +m[2]]));
const OFF = Object.keys(PHONE_GRAPHICS);

test('the six options are in the seed, and on there', () => {
  const v = values(SEED);
  assert.equal(OFF.length, 6);
  for (const k of OFF) assert.ok(v[k] > 0, k);
});

test("a new phone's registry: the seed with the six off and the mark", () => {
  const out = phoneSeed(SEED), v = values(out), s = values(SEED);
  for (const k of OFF) assert.equal(v[k], 0, k);
  assert.equal(v[PHONE_MARK], 1);
  for (const k of Object.keys(s)) if (!OFF.includes(k)) assert.equal(v[k], s[k], k);
  assert.equal(out.split('\n').length, SEED.split('\n').length + 1);
  assert.equal(phoneUpgrade(out, SEED), null);
});

test("a phone from before, graphics untouched: lowered once, the game's other lines kept", () => {
  const before = withDwords(SEED, { g_RacingResolution: 1, HornVolume: 70 }) + 's DI_Keyboard_0=12\n';
  const up = phoneUpgrade(before, SEED);
  assert.equal(up.lowered, true);
  const v = values(up.text);
  for (const k of OFF) assert.equal(v[k], 0, k);
  assert.equal(v[PHONE_MARK], 1);
  assert.equal(v.g_RacingResolution, 1);
  assert.equal(v.HornVolume, 70);
  assert.match(up.text, /^s DI_Keyboard_0=12$/m);
  assert.equal(phoneUpgrade(up.text, SEED), null);
});

test('a phone from before where a graphics option was changed: only the mark', () => {
  const before = withDwords(SEED, { g_LightStreaksEnable: 0 });
  const up = phoneUpgrade(before, SEED);
  assert.equal(up.lowered, false);
  assert.deepEqual(values(up.text), { ...values(before), [PHONE_MARK]: 1 });
  // set back to the seed's values later: still the player's
  assert.equal(phoneUpgrade(withDwords(up.text, { g_LightStreaksEnable: 1 }), SEED), null);
});

test('a registry the game made itself (seed_registry = off) is not the seed', () => {
  const own = 'd NotFirstTime=1\nd g_CarEnvironmentMapEnable=1\nd g_RoadReflectionEnable=2\nd g_PerformanceLevel=3\n';
  assert.equal(phoneUpgrade(own, SEED).lowered, false);
  assert.equal(phoneUpgrade('', SEED).text, `d ${PHONE_MARK}=1\n`);
});

test('CRLF lines keep their line ends', () => {
  const crlf = SEED.replace(/\n/g, '\r\n'), out = phoneSeed(crlf);
  assert.doesNotMatch(out.replace(/\r\n/g, ''), /\n/);
  assert.equal(values(out).g_RoadReflectionEnable, 0);
});

test("a new computer's registry: the seed with Full Scene Anti-Aliasing on; a tablet's the seed; a phone's its own", () => {
  const s = values(SEED), pc = deviceSeed('pc', SEED), v = values(pc);
  assert.equal(s.g_FSAALevel, 4294967295, "the seed's: off (-1), as the Mac app and tablets start");
  assert.deepEqual(COMPUTER_GRAPHICS, { g_FSAALevel: 1 });
  assert.equal(v.g_FSAALevel, 1);
  for (const k of Object.keys(s)) if (k !== 'g_FSAALevel') assert.equal(v[k], s[k], k);
  assert.equal(pc.split('\n').length, SEED.split('\n').length, 'the line replaced where it is');
  assert.equal(deviceSeed('tablet', SEED), SEED);
  assert.equal(deviceSeed('phone', SEED), phoneSeed(SEED));
});

test('a registry from before FSAA (-1) is asked once: on or kept off, marked either way; others are not asked', () => {
  const before = withDwords(SEED, { g_RacingResolution: 1 }) + 's DI_Keyboard_0=12\n';
  assert.equal(fsaaAsk(before), true);
  const on = fsaaAnswer(before, true), off = fsaaAnswer(before, false);
  assert.equal(values(on).g_FSAALevel, 1); assert.equal(values(on)[FSAA_MARK], 1);
  assert.equal(values(off).g_FSAALevel, 4294967295); assert.equal(values(off)[FSAA_MARK], 1);
  assert.ok(on.includes('s DI_Keyboard_0=12') && off.includes('s DI_Keyboard_0=12'), "the game's other lines kept");
  assert.equal(fsaaAsk(on), false); assert.equal(fsaaAsk(off), false);
  assert.equal(fsaaAsk(deviceSeed('pc', SEED)), false, "a new computer's: on already");
  assert.equal(fsaaAsk(withDwords(SEED, { g_FSAALevel: 0 })), false, 'turned off in the game: its choice');
});

// Photo mode's panel helpers (web/src/app/photolook.ts): the focus slider's scale both ways, every crop's kept part
// (the middle of the picture, its own width over height, inside the picture), every filter a full look.
//   node --test web/test/photolook.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(ROOT, 'web/src/app/photolook.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false })).outputFiles[0].text;
const { CROPS, FILTERS, cropRect, focusM, focusV, FOCUS_MIN, FOCUS_MAX } = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(js).toString('base64'));

test('the focus slider: its ends, and back and forth', () => {
  assert.equal(focusM(0), FOCUS_MIN);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(focusM(1000) - FOCUS_MAX) < 1e-9);
  for (const m of [0.5, 1, 3.7, 12, 80, 500]) assert.ok(Math.abs(focusM(focusV(m)) / m - 1) < 0.01, String(m));
  assert.equal(focusV(0.01), 0);
  assert.equal(focusV(1e6), 1000);
});

test('each crop keeps the middle of the picture, at its own width over height', () => {
  for (const aspect of [16 / 9, 4 / 3, 21 / 9, 9 / 16, 1.5]) {
    for (const [name, r] of Object.entries(CROPS)) {
      const [l, t, rt, b] = cropRect(r, aspect);
      assert.ok(l >= 0 && t >= 0 && rt <= 1 && b <= 1 && l < rt && t < b, `${name} at ${aspect}`);
      assert.ok(Math.abs((l + rt) / 2 - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.abs((t + b) / 2 - 0.5) < 1e-9, `${name} in the middle`);
      if (!r) { assert.deepEqual([l, t, rt, b], [0, 0, 1, 1]); continue; }
      assert.ok(Math.abs((rt - l) * aspect / (b - t) - r) < 1e-9, `${name} at ${aspect}: ${(rt - l) * aspect / (b - t)}`);
      assert.ok(rt - l === 1 || b - t === 1, `${name} as large as it fits`);
    }
  }
});

test('a crop like the picture, or a picture of no size, keeps all of it', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(cropRect(16 / 9, 16 / 9), [0, 0, 1, 1]);
  assert.deepEqual(cropRect(1, 0), [0, 0, 1, 1]);
  assert.deepEqual(cropRect(1, NaN), [0, 0, 1, 1]);
});

test('every filter is a whole look; none leaves the picture as it is', () => {
  for (const [k, f] of Object.entries(FILTERS)) {
    assert.equal(typeof f.contrast, 'number', k); assert.equal(typeof f.saturation, 'number', k);
    assert.equal(f.tint.length, 3, k); assert.ok(f.fade >= 0 && f.fade < 0.5, k);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(FILTERS.none, { contrast: 1, saturation: 1, tint: [1, 1, 1], fade: 0 });
  assert.equal(FILTERS.bw.saturation, 0);
});

  assert.deepEqual(texts.slice(0, 16), ['Hey!', 'Nice car!', 'Thanks!', 'Bye!', 'Yes', 'No', 'Sorry!', 'lol',
    'Follow me!', 'Wait up!', 'Let\'s go!', 'Nice!', 'Race?', 'Join my race!', 'gg', 'One more?'], 'the first sixteen, as before');
  assert.ok(texts.length >= 152 && texts.length <= 256, `a number is a byte on the wire (${texts.length})`);
  const digest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(texts.slice(0, 152).join('\n')).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
  assert.equal(digest, '84085c069dc067dc', 'phrases 0-151 moved or changed: add new ones at the end instead');
  assert.equal(texts[99], 'Outrun?'); assert.equal(texts[151], 'On my phone!');
  assert.equal(new Set(texts).size, texts.length, 'no phrase twice');
  const cats = new Set(Q.CATS.map(c => c.id));
  for (const p of Q.PHRASES) assert.ok(cats.has(p.cat), `${p.text}: a category the groups can take`);
  for (const c of Q.CATS) assert.ok(Q.PHRASES.some(p => p.cat === c.id), `${c.id}: not empty`);
  assert.equal(Q.COUNTDOWN, 152); assert.equal(texts[152], 'Countdown');
  assert.equal(Q.PHRASES[152].special, 'countdown', 'the countdown is the special one (roam_game.c SAY_COUNTDOWN 152)');
  assert.deepEqual(Q.PHRASES.filter(p => p.special).map(p => p.text), ['Countdown'], 'no other special phrase');
  assert.deepEqual(texts.slice(153, 164), ['I need NOS!', 'Dude, I almost had you!', 'You almost had me?',

test('settings.ini: the two lines', () => {

// The server's /players (how many play on this server now, for the start page's Multiplayer settings) and the
// line the page makes of it:
//   node --test web/test/players.test.mjs
// Against the real server when the game folder is there: the three counts, whether it is full, how many wait in line
// and whether free roam is busy, nothing else in the body, never cached, the Host check of every route, null with
// --online off and --roam-hub off, full with --max-peers 1 (a page of before refused, a page of now in line).  The online count itself (logged in, or racing an online race) is in the
// online crate's tests (web/server-rs/crates/online/src/tests/lobby.rs), the free-roam one (driving there, or paused)
// in the roam crate's (web/server-rs/crates/roam/tests/roam_hub.rs).
// Ports: NFSU2_TEST_PLAYERS_PORT1 (8530), NFSU2_TEST_PLAYERS_PORT2 (8630).
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import http from 'node:http';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { WebSocket } from 'ws';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';
import { serverCommand } from '../tools/server-cmd.mjs';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const DATA = process.env.NFSU2_DATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'projects/nsfu2/Need for Speed - Underground 2');
const P1 = +(process.env.NFSU2_TEST_PLAYERS_PORT1 || 8530), P2 = +(process.env.NFSU2_TEST_PLAYERS_PORT2 || 8630);
const SKIP = !fs.existsSync(path.join(DATA, 'SPEED2.EXE')) && 'no game folder (NFSU2_DATA)';
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
/** what a wait gives, or a failure after ms (a message that never comes fails the test, and the server still stops) */
const within = (ms, what, p) => {
  let t;
  return Promise.race([p, new Promise((_, rej) => { t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`no ${what} in ${ms} ms`)), ms); })]).finally(() => clearTimeout(t));
};

async function server(port, extra = []) {
  const st = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || os.tmpdir(), 'nfsu2-players-test-'));
  const srv = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--http-port', String(port), '--state', st, ...extra]),
    { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start: ' + out)), 15000);
    srv.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    srv.on('exit', c => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error('server exited ' + c + ' ' + out)); });
  });
  return {
    get: (p, host = `localhost:${port}`) => new Promise((res, rej) => {
      http.get({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, path: p, headers: { host } }, r => {
        let body = ''; r.on('data', d => { body += d; }); r.on('end', () => res({ status: r.statusCode, headers: r.headers, body }));
      }).on('error', rej);
    }),
    // a browser's game on the switch: its welcome, then its hello
    player: name => within(5000, `welcome for ${name}`, new Promise(res => {
      const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${port}/lan`);
      ws.on('message', (d, bin) => { if (!bin && JSON.parse(String(d)).t === 'welcome') { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'hello', name })); res(ws); } });
    })),
    stop: async () => {
      const gone = srv.exitCode !== null || srv.signalCode !== null ? null : new Promise(res => srv.once('exit', res));
      srv.kill(); await gone;
      fs.rmSync(st, { recursive: true, force: true });
    },
  };
}

test('the page\'s numbers and lines', async () => {
  const out = await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(HERE, '../src/app/players.ts')], bundle: true, write: false, format: 'esm', platform: 'neutral' });
  const { countText, fullLine, queueText, roomHash, roomFold, worldCounts } = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(out.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));
  // the room's hash as roam_core.c makes it (tests/roam_unit.c checks the same names): capitals, blanks and invisible
  // characters do not count
  assert.equal(roomHash('blueroom'), 0x160fba32);
  assert.equal(roomHash(' Blue Room\t'), 0x160fba32);
  assert.equal(roomHash(''), 0);
  assert.equal(roomHash('   '), 0);
  assert.equal(roomHash(' ​　'), 0, 'Unicode\'s blanks and the zero-width space are blanks');
  const fnv = s => { let h = 0x811c9dc5; for (const b of new TextEncoder().encode(s)) h = Math.imul(h ^ b, 0x01000193) >>> 0; return h || 1; };
  for (const same of [['blueroom', 'Blue Room', 'Blue​Room﻿', 'ＢＬＵＥ　Ｒｏｏｍ'], ['комната', 'КОМНАТА', 'Комната', 'ком ната'],
    ['zoë', 'ZOË', 'Zoë', 'z o ë'], ['istanbul', 'İSTANBUL', 'ıstanbul', 'Istanbul'], ['ομαδασ', 'ΟΜΑΔΑΣ', 'ομαδας', 'ΟΜΑ­ΔΑΣ'], ['łóź', 'ŁÓŹ', 'Łóź', 'łóź']]) {
    for (const n of same) assert.equal(roomHash(n), roomHash(same[0]), `${n} is ${same[0]}`);
    assert.equal(roomHash(same[0]), fnv(same[0]), `${same[0]}: small and without blanks already, its bytes' FNV-1a`);
  }
  assert.notEqual(roomHash('Zoe'), roomHash('Zoë'));
  assert.notEqual(roomHash('straße'), roomHash('strasse'));
  assert.equal(roomHash('Ό'), roomHash('ό'));
  assert.equal(roomHash('Café'), roomHash('café'), 'an accent typed after its letter: the same name (NFC)');
  // every character from U+0001 to U+2FFFF (but the surrogates) alone, as the game hashes it (without the page's NFC):
  // the same sum as tests/roam_unit.c's ROOM_FOLD_SUM, so the two tables agree on every one
  let sum = 0;
  for (let c = 1; c < 0x30000; c++) {
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdfff) continue;
    const f = roomFold(c), h = f ? fnv(String.fromCodePoint(f)) : 0;
    sum = (Math.imul(sum, 31) + h) >>> 0;
  }
  assert.equal(sum.toString(16), '198373d3');
  // the Playing now panel's numbers (grouped as the page's language writes them; '–' for one the server does not give),
  // the World list's counts by hash and the line under the numbers while the server is full
  assert.deepEqual([7592, 0, 3, null, undefined, -1, 1.5].map(countText), ['7,592', '0', '3', '–', '–', '–', '–']);
  assert.deepEqual([...worldCounts({ players: 3, online: 1, roam: 2, rooms: [1, 0, 1] }, [0, 7, 9])], [[0, 1], [7, 0], [9, 1]]);
  assert.deepEqual([...worldCounts({ players: 3, online: 1, roam: 2, rooms: [1, -1] }, [0, 7])], [[0, 1]], 'only counts');
  assert.deepEqual([...worldCounts({ players: 3, online: 1, roam: 2 }, [0, 7])], [], 'an older server: no counts');
  assert.equal(fullLine({ players: 3, online: 1, full: false }), '');
  assert.equal(fullLine({ players: 3, online: 1 }), '');
  assert.equal(fullLine({ players: 128, online: 9, roam: 100, full: true }), 'The server is full: multiplayer starts when a place frees up.');
  assert.equal(fullLine({ players: 5000, online: 300, roam: 1800, full: true, queue: 120 }),
    'The server is full, with 120 in line. At Play you can wait in line (playing alone until your turn) or play offline.');
  assert.match(fullLine({ players: 5000, online: 300, full: true, queue: 1 }), /full, with 1 in line/);
  assert.match(fullLine({ players: 5000, online: 300, full: true, queue: 0 }), /full: multiplayer starts when a place frees up\.$/);
  // the line over a game that waits for a place
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 1, of: 40 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: next.');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 1, of: 40, eta: 20 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: next (less than a minute).');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 2, of: 40, eta: 150 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: 2nd of 40 (about 3 min).');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 13, of: 40 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: 13th of 40.');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 23, of: 40, eta: 2 * 3600 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: 23rd of 40 (about 2 h).');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 101, of: 140 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: 101st of 140.');
  assert.equal(queueText({ pos: 112, of: 140 }), 'The server is full. In line for a place: 112th of 140.');
});

{"id": "AT001938", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/test/playtime.test.mjs", "originalBytes": 5720, "originalSha256": "c1f250077507bc3949ccbad0c0dd105a5edfe15224dbfb1ea98630a9f5d45e57", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 5720, "utf8TotalBytes": 5720}

// The app's play counter (web/src/app/playtime.ts) on a fake clock: two hours of play with some input in sight ask
// the game for our message on its phone, again in each game until the game's status says the inbox has it; then
// never again.  Idle and hidden time does not count; the count carries over to the next game (localStorage).  The
// start page's figures: the latest game's play (kept as it goes), the whole, and "at least" for a count from before
// the page showed it (decided once).
//   node --test web/test/playtime.test.mjs
import { test, mock } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(ROOT, 'web/src/app/playtime.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false })).outputFiles[0].text;
const { PlayTime, SMS_AFTER_MS, lastGameMs, playedMs, playedAtLeast, playedText } = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(js).toString('base64'));

const MIN = 60_000;
let t = 1000;
Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'performance', { value: { now: () => t }, configurable: true });
const store = new Map();
globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: k => store.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)) };
globalThis.document = { hidden: false };

// a game: its input (the last input, the requests for our message) and its status
function game() {
  mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setInterval'] });
  const g = { last: t, asked: [], sms: 0, logs: [] };
  const s = {
    input: { lastInput: () => g.last, sms: id => { g.asked.push(id); return true; } },
    status: { read: () => new Map([['sms', g.sms]]) },
  };
  g.pt = new PlayTime(s, SMS_AFTER_MS, l => g.logs.push(l));
  g.play = ms => { for (let k = 0; k < ms; k += 5000) { t += 5000; g.last = t; mock.timers.tick(5000); } };
  g.idle = ms => { for (let k = 0; k < ms; k += 5000) { t += 5000; mock.timers.tick(5000); } };
  g.end = () => { g.pt.stop(); mock.timers.reset(); };
  return g;
}

test('two hours over two games ask for the message, until the inbox has it; then never again', () => {
  store.clear();
  const a = game();
  a.play(70 * MIN);
  a.end();
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, [], 'not after 70 min');
  const b = game();
  b.play(49 * MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(b.asked, [], 'not after 119 min');
  b.play(MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(b.asked, [1], 'at two hours');
  b.play(30 * MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(b.asked, [1], 'once a game');
  b.end();
  const c = game();
  c.play(5000);
  assert.deepEqual(c.asked, [1], 'again in the next game: its inbox does not have it yet');
  c.sms = 1;
  c.play(5000);
  assert.ok(c.logs.some(l => /in the game's inbox/.test(l)));
  c.end();
  const d = game();
  d.play(60 * MIN);
  d.end();
  assert.deepEqual(d.asked, [], 'never again');
});

test('a hundred hours ask for the second message, in a game after the first; then never again', () => {
  store.clear();
  store.set('nfsu2.play.ms', String(100 * 60 * MIN - 2 * MIN));     // the first message not had yet
  const a = game();
  a.play(5 * MIN);
  a.sms = 1;
  a.play(5 * MIN);
  a.end();
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, [1], 'past 100 h without the first: the first only, not both in one game');
  const b = game();
  b.play(5000);
  assert.deepEqual(b.asked, [2], 'the next game: the second');
  b.sms = 2;
  b.play(5000);
  assert.ok(b.logs.some(l => /message 2 is in the game's inbox/.test(l)));
  b.end();
  assert.equal(store.get('nfsu2.play.sms'), '2');
  const c = game();
  c.play(60 * MIN);
  c.end();
  assert.deepEqual(c.asked, [], 'never again');
  store.clear();
  store.set('nfsu2.play.ms', String(100 * 60 * MIN - 2 * MIN));
  store.set('nfsu2.play.sms', '1');                                  // as kept before the second message
  const d = game();
  d.play(MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(d.asked, [], 'not before 100 h');
  d.play(MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(d.asked, [2], 'at 100 h');
  d.end();
});

test('idle and hidden time does not count', () => {
  store.clear();
  const a = game();
  a.play(60 * MIN);
  a.idle(4 * MIN);                       // still counts: input less than 5 min ago
  a.idle(120 * MIN);                     // the rest does not
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, []);
  globalThis.document.hidden = true;
  a.play(120 * MIN);
  globalThis.document.hidden = false;
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, []);
  a.play(55 * MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, [], 'not at 119 min of play');
  a.play(2 * MIN);
  assert.deepEqual(a.asked, [1]);
  a.end();
});

test('the start page\'s figures: the latest game, the whole, and "at least" for a count from before', () => {
  store.clear();
  assert.equal(playedAtLeast(), false, 'no count yet: all of it counted from here');
  const a = game();
  a.play(30 * MIN);
  assert.equal(lastGameMs(), 30 * MIN, 'kept as the game goes (a page stopped now keeps it)');
  a.end();
  const b = game();
  assert.equal(lastGameMs(), 0, 'a new game starts its own');
  b.play(80 * MIN);
  b.idle(20 * MIN);
  b.end();
  assert.equal(lastGameMs(), 85 * MIN - 5000, 'its play, and input less than 5 min ago');
  assert.equal(playedMs(), 30 * MIN + 85 * MIN - 5000);
  assert.equal(playedAtLeast(), false, 'decided once');
  store.clear();
  store.set('nfsu2.play.ms', String(3 * 3600_000));
  assert.equal(playedAtLeast(), true, 'a count from before: it may miss play');
  store.set('nfsu2.play.ms', '0');
  assert.equal(playedAtLeast(), true, 'decided once');
  assert.deepEqual([59_999, 60_000, 45 * MIN + 59_000, 60 * MIN, 200 * MIN].map(playedText), ['', '1 min', '45 min', '1 h 0 min', '3 h 20 min']);
});

{"id": "AT001939", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/test/poselog_unit.c", "originalBytes": 1854, "originalSha256": "5522ff625685168f50551c4f203ee7ec536c2934ce53ac9997de79d5c5ff6fd2", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 1854, "utf8TotalBytes": 1854}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/* poselog_unit.c -- the free-roam pose log's buffer in the browser
 * (runtime/roam_host.h rh_fopen): every stdio flush there is a synchronous
 * round trip to the I/O worker and an OPFS write, so roam_game.c's periodic
 * rh_fflush every 240 frames must be the only one.  Writes 240 frames of
 * rows as roam_game.c does (one L row for our car, one R row per friend's car
 * shown, 147 bytes as the longest of the perf track's logs) for 1 and for 5
 * friends' cars, and checks that nothing reached the file before the flush.
 * Run by web/test/roam-wasm.test.mjs with a directory at /tmp. */
#include "roam_host.h"
#include <sys/stat.h>

long autotest_frame(void){ return 0; }
uint32_t win32_heap_live(void){ return 0; }
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr){ (void)c; (void)addr; }

static long size_of(const char *p){ struct stat st; return stat(p, &st) == 0 ? (long)st.st_size : -1; }

int main(void){
    int fails = 0;
    for (int cars = 1; cars <= 5; cars += 4){
        char path[64]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/tmp/pose-%d.csv", cars);
        rh_file *f = rh_fopen(path);
        if (!f){ printf("poselog: cannot open %s\n", path); return 1; }
        long held = 0;
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 240; frame++)
            for (int r = 0; r <= cars; r++)
                held += rh_fprintf(f, "%c,%0136d,%07d\n", r ? 'R' : 'L', 0, frame);   /* 147 bytes */
        long before = size_of(path);
        rh_fflush(f);
        long after = size_of(path);
        int ok = before == 0 && after == held;
        printf("  %s  %d friend car(s): %ld bytes in 240 frames, %ld in the file before the periodic flush, %ld after\n",
               ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", cars, held, before, after);
        fails += !ok;
        fclose(f);
    }
    printf("poselog_unit: %s\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "passed");
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}

// The page's way into localStorage and sessionStorage (web/src/app/prefs.ts): it never throws, with no store, a store
// that refuses, or one that is full; and the keys are spelled as players' kept choices are (a key changed loses them).
//   node --test web/test/prefs.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const P = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from((await esbuild.build({
  entryPoints: [path.join(ROOT, 'web/src/app/prefs.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false })).outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));

const mapStore = (full = false) => {
  const data = new Map();
  return { data, getItem: k => data.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => { if (full) throw new Error('QuotaExceededError'); data.set(k, String(v)); },
    removeItem: k => data.delete(k) };
};
const refusing = { getItem() { throw new Error('SecurityError'); }, setItem() { throw new Error('SecurityError'); }, removeItem() { throw new Error('SecurityError'); } };
const put = (name, s) => Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, { value: s, configurable: true, writable: true });

test('a store that works: read, write, JSON, remove', () => {
  const s = mapStore();
  put('localStorage', s);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.usable(), true);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('a'), null);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.set('a', '1'), true);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('a'), '1');
  assert.equal(P.localStore.setJSON('j', { x: [1, 2] }), true);
  assert.equal(s.data.get('j'), '{"x":[1,2]}');
  assert.deepEqual(P.localStore.getJSON('j'), { x: [1, 2] });
  s.data.set('bad', '{not json');
  assert.equal(P.localStore.getJSON('bad'), null);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.getJSON('none'), null);
  P.localStore.remove('a');
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('a'), null);
});

test('no store, or one that refuses: null, false, nothing thrown; failed hears why', () => {
  for (const s of [undefined, refusing]) {
    if (s) put('sessionStorage', s); else delete globalThis.sessionStorage;
    const why = [];
    assert.equal(P.sessionStore.usable(), false);
    assert.equal(P.sessionStore.get('a'), null);
    assert.equal(P.sessionStore.getJSON('a'), null);
    assert.equal(P.sessionStore.set('a', '1', e => why.push(e)), false);
    assert.equal(P.sessionStore.setJSON('a', [1], e => why.push(e)), false);
    assert.doesNotThrow(() => P.sessionStore.remove('a'));
    assert.equal(why.length, 2);
  }
});

test('a full store: reads go on, writes say not kept; a value with no JSON is not kept either', () => {
  const s = mapStore(true);
  s.data.set('k', 'v');
  put('localStorage', s);
  let why = '';
  assert.equal(P.localStore.usable(), true);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('k'), 'v');
  assert.equal(P.localStore.set('k', 'w', e => { why = String(e); }), false);
  assert.match(why, /QuotaExceededError/);
  put('localStorage', mapStore());
  assert.equal(P.localStore.setJSON('n', 1n, e => { why = String(e); }), false);
  assert.match(why, /BigInt/);
});

test('the store is looked up at each call (blocked later, or a test\'s own)', () => {
  put('localStorage', mapStore());
  P.localStore.set('a', '1');
  put('localStorage', refusing);
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('a'), null);
  put('localStorage', mapStore());
  assert.equal(P.localStore.get('a'), null);
});

  assert.deepEqual(keys, {

test('a name stays known after its line left the log, and the kept copy is scrubbed', () => {
  const p = new Privacy('salt');
  const log = new LogRing(4096, false, 1, 64);
  log.onLine = s => p.learn(s);
  log.keep('=== NFSU2 web, a game ===');
  log.add('[4!] [roam] JOIN: Quietstorm joined (peer 7)');
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) log.add(`[4!] [status] f=${i} t=${i}.0s fps=60.0`);
  log.add('[4!] [roam] f=999 slot 1: Quietstorm\'s car removed (gone)');
  const text = log.text();
  assert.ok(!text.includes('JOIN: Quietstorm'), 'the JOIN line was dropped');
  assert.ok(!p.scrub(text).includes('Quietstorm'));
  // the copy a stopped page keeps (lastgame.ts)
  const store = new Map();
  globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: k => store.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)) };
  globalThis.document = { hidden: false };
  const k = new LastGameKeeper('save', log, () => {}, t => p.scrub(t));
  k.start('abc1234');
  const kept = JSON.parse(store.get('nfsu2.lastgame.save'));
  k.end(0, 'exit');                       // its timer
  assert.equal(kept.scrubbed, true);
  assert.ok(kept.log.includes("slot 1: player-") && !kept.log.includes('Quietstorm'));
});

/** a /vault of its own: one keyphrase file per token, If-Match / If-None-Match as the server has them */
function server() {
  const kept = new Map(), s = { now: Date.parse('2026-11-03T12:00:00Z'), kept };
  const tag = n => `"${n.toString(16).padStart(16, '0')}"`;
  let revs = 1;
  const head = v => ({ etag: tag(v.rev), 'x-vault-saved': String(v.saved) });
  s.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    const h = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(init.headers ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
    const token = (h.authorization ?? '').replace(/^Bearer /, '');
    if (!token) return new Response('token', { status: 401 });
    const k = kept.get(token), method = init.method ?? 'GET';
    if (method === 'GET') {
      const v = k?.cur;
      if (!v || url.endsWith('?earlier')) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
      if (h['if-none-match'] === tag(v.rev)) return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers: head(v) });
      return new Response(v.body, { status: 200, headers: head(v) });
    }
    if (method === 'PUT') {
      if (h['if-none-match'] === '*' ? k : !k || h['if-match'] !== tag(k.cur.rev)) return new Response('Changed', { status: 412, headers: k ? head(k.cur) : {} });
      s.now += 60_000;
      const v = { rev: revs++, saved: s.now, body: new Uint8Array(init.body) };
      kept.set(token, { cur: v });
      return new Response('Saved', { status: k ? 200 : 201, headers: head(v) });
    }
    return new Response('no', { status: 405 });
  };
  return s;
}
/** a browser on save folder dir: vault-ui.ts's files() and restore() */
function browser(srv, dir) {
  const b = { link: null, taken: 0 };
  const deps = {
    files: async (o = {}) => {
      const want = o.was ? V.keptBy(o.was) : V.keeps, out = [];
      for (const f of await M.listFiles(dir)) if (want(f.path)) out.push({ path: f.path, data: await M.readBytes(dir, f.path), mtime: f.mtime });
      return V.kept(out, o.was);
    },
    restore: async (zipped, still) => M.restoreVault(dir, await M.readVault(zipped), still),
    load: () => b.link && JSON.parse(b.link), save: l => { b.link = l && JSON.stringify(l); },
    fetch: srv.fetch, log: () => {},
    leftOut: files => M.leftOut(files), named: files => M.profilesComing(files),
    folder: () => M.readBeside(`${dir}~folder`), mark: id => M.writeBeside(`${dir}~folder`, id),
  };
  b.sync = new V.VaultSync(deps);
  b.sync.onTaken = () => b.taken++;
  return b;
}
/** A makes a keyphrase of its saves, B loads it (as vault-ui.ts's "Use this keyphrase") */
async function pair(srv) {
  const a = browser(srv, 'A'), b = browser(srv, 'B');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  const got = await b.sync.peek(phrase);
  await M.restoreVault('B', await M.readVault(got.zip));
  await b.sync.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  return { a, b };
}

// - the countdown (the special phrase, in the default sixteen's last place): its stopwatch in the picker, 5 to 1 and
//   GO! big for the one who said it and a friend within 50 m, over the car for one farther; while one is on and 30 s
//   after, another's is not shown and the player's own waits (a far one holds back only far ones); in a race dimmed,
//   and it says nothing there
// - the countdown where the game's "nocount" says it is not the player's to start (a car meet, not stayed): dimmed,
//   picked it says only that it is not allowed here and nothing goes to the game; the game's own refusal the same
// The module is bundled from web/src with esbuild into a blank page.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { pickBrowser } from '../tools/browser.mjs';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({
  stdin: { contents: `export * from './web/src/app/quickchat.ts'; export { DEFAULT_PHRASES, DEFAULT_GROUPS } from './web/src/app/phrases.ts';`,
    resolveDir: ROOT, loader: 'ts' },
  bundle: true, format: 'iife', globalName: 'M', write: false, platform: 'browser',
})).outputFiles[0].text;

const browser = await chromium.launch({ ...pickBrowser(), headless: true });
test.after(() => browser.close());

/** a blank page with the module and a QuickChat; the game's status is w.st, what it was asked to say w.said, the keys
 *  that reached the game (the canvas) w.game */
async function page() {
  const p = await browser.newPage();
  await p.clock.install();
  await p.setContent('<div id="stage" style="position:relative;width:640px;height:480px"><canvas id="game" tabindex="0"></canvas></div>');
  await p.addScriptTag({ content: js });
  await p.evaluate(() => {
    const w = /** @type {any} */ (window);
    w.st = {}; w.said = []; w.game = [];
    document.getElementById('game').addEventListener('keydown', e => w.game.push(e.code));
    w.qc = new w.M.QuickChat(document.getElementById('stage'), { line() {}, lobby() {}, place() {}, log() {} });
    w.session = { status: { read: () => new Map(Object.entries(w.st)) }, net: { say: (p, race) => { w.said.push([p, race]); return true; } },
      viewRect: () => ({ x: 0, y: 0, w: 640, h: 480 }) };
  });
  await p.clock.runFor(1000);           // (the page's clock is the test's: past the status's 100 ms between reads)
  return p;
}
/** a game started: quick chat on or off, free roam on or off, the game's "drive" and "netrace" */
const game = (p, on, roam, drive, netrace = 0) => p.evaluate(([on, roam, drive, netrace]) => {
  const w = /** @type {any} */ (window);
  w.qc.stop();
  w.st = { drive, netrace }; w.said = []; w.game = [];
  w.qc.start(w.session, on, roam, w.M.DEFAULT_PHRASES, w.M.DEFAULT_GROUPS);
}, [on, roam, drive, netrace]);
/** a key pressed on the game: whether it went on (not kept from the game) */
const key = (p, code) => p.evaluate(c => document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(
  new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: c, key: c, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })), code);
const open = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.state().open);
const said = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).said);
const keys = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).game);
/** the right stick flicked (up, or to x, y) and back: whether the picker took it */
const flick = (p, x = 0, y = -1) => p.evaluate(([x, y]) => {
  const q = /** @type {any} */ (window).qc; const took = q.stick(x, y); q.stick(0, 0); return took;
}, [x, y]);
/** the right stick pressed in: whether the picker took it */
const click = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.click());
const touch = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.toggle());

test('free roam with free roam on: keys, Esc, the stick', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, true, 2);
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 0, '1 opens the first group');
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[0, false]], 'its first phrase, in free roam');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  await key(p, 'Digit2');
  assert.equal(await key(p, 'Escape'), false, 'Esc closes the picker, not the game');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  assert.equal(await flick(p), false, 'a flick alone opens nothing: the game looks round with the stick');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  assert.equal(await click(p), true, 'the stick\'s click opens it');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 5, 'the four groups');
  assert.deepEqual(await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.qc-row')].map(r => r.textContent)),
    ['↑Hi', '→Reply', '↓Drive', '←Race'], 'each with its flick');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => {
    const q = /** @type {any} */ (window).qc; q.stick(0, 0); return q.stick(0.5, 0);
  }), true, 'back at rest, then part way out: the picker\'s still (the game gets it at rest)');
  assert.equal(await flick(p, 1, 0), true, 'a flick right opens the second group');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 1);
  assert.equal(await flick(p, 0, 1), true, 'a flick down says its third phrase');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[0, false], [6, false]]);
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  assert.deepEqual(await p.evaluate(() => {
    const q = /** @type {any} */ (window).qc;
    q.click(); q.stick(0, 0); q.stick(0, -1); q.stick(0, 0);
    const out = [q.stick(0, -1), q.state().open, q.stick(0, -0.9), q.stick(0, 0), q.stick(0, -1)];
    q.stick(0, 0);
    return out;
  }), [true, -1, true, false, false], 'the flick that says the phrase stays the picker\'s until back at rest (else the game '
    + 'took it as a tap of the headlights), then the stick is the game\'s again');
  assert.deepEqual((await said(p)).length, 3);
  assert.equal(await click(p), true);
  assert.equal(await click(p), true, 'a second click closes it');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  await p.close();
});

test('the career\'s free roam with free roam off: no picker, the keys and the stick stay the game\'s', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, false, 2);
  for (const k of ['Digit1', 'Digit2', 'Numpad3', 'Digit4']) {
    assert.equal(await key(p, k), true, k);
    assert.equal(await open(p), -1, `${k} opens no picker`);
  }
  assert.equal(await key(p, 'Escape'), true, 'Esc goes to the game (its pause menu)');
  assert.deepEqual(await keys(p), ['Digit1', 'Digit2', 'Numpad3', 'Digit4', 'Escape']);
  assert.equal(await flick(p), false, 'the stick stays the game\'s');
  assert.equal(await click(p), false, 'and its click (a car\'s hydraulics)');
  await touch(p);
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1, 'nor the touch button');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {HTMLElement} */ (document.querySelector('.qc-picker')).hidden), true);
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), []);
  await p.close();
});

test('a right stick the game\'s controls read (the game\'s "rstick"): its click is the game\'s, 1-4 still open it', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, true, 2);
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.rstick = 1; });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);                                     // (the status is read again)
  assert.equal(await click(p), false, 'the click goes to the game (its hydraulics), no picker');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  assert.equal(await flick(p, 1, 0), false, 'the stick stays the game\'s (its steering)');
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 0, 'the keys still open it');
  assert.equal(await click(p), false, 'and a click there is still the game\'s');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 0, 'the picker stays open');
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[0, false]]);
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.rstick = 0; });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);
  assert.equal(await click(p), true, 'the stick the look\'s again: the click opens the picker');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 5);
  await p.close();
});

test('one of the game\'s controls on 1 or on the stick\'s click (the game\'s "keys", "rstick" 2): those are the game\'s', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, true, 2);
  // 1 and Numpad 3 have a control of the game's (runtime/dinput_kbd.c PAGE_KEYS: 1 is bit 2, Numpad 3 bit 8)
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.keys = (1 << 2) | (1 << 8); });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);                                     // (the status is read again)
  assert.equal(await key(p, 'Digit1'), true, 'the game gets 1');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1, 'no picker');
  assert.deepEqual(await keys(p), ['Digit1']);
  await key(p, 'Numpad3');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1, 'nor by Numpad 3');
  await key(p, 'Digit2');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 1, '2 still opens its group');
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 1, 'and 1 picks nothing in it');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), []);
  await key(p, 'Numpad1');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[4, false]], 'Numpad 1 does');
  // the stick's click with a control of the game's other than its Hydraulic Bounce on it (dinput_pad.c ours_from)
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.rstick = 2; });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);
  assert.equal(await click(p), false, 'the click goes to the game');
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1);
  await p.evaluate(() => { const w = /** @type {any} */ (window); w.st.rstick = 0; w.st.keys = 0; });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);
  assert.equal(await click(p), true, 'ours again');
  await key(p, 'Escape');
  await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.equal(await open(p), 0, '1 too');
  await p.close();
});

test('a race between players with free roam off: the picker, the phrase to the race', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  for (const [drive, netrace] of [[1, 1], [0, 2]]) {   // driving, the results
