    await key(p, 'Digit3');
    assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[6, true]], `netrace ${netrace}: its third phrase, in the race`);
  }
  await game(p, true, false, 1, 1);
  await touch(p);
  assert.equal(await open(p), 4, 'the touch button shows all sixteen');
  await p.close();
});

test('quick chat off: no picker', async () => {

  for (const [roam, drive, netrace] of [[true, 2, 0], [false, 1, 1]]) {
    await game(p, false, roam, drive, netrace);

/** what the game sends back (roam_game.c say_page): a phrase said by player id */
const from = (p, o) => p.evaluate(o => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.said(JSON.stringify(o)), o);
const count = p => p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.state().count);
const text = (p, sel) => p.evaluate(sel => document.querySelector(sel)?.textContent ?? null, sel);

test('the countdown: big near, over the car far, one at a time, not in a race', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, true, 2);
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-row svg.qc-watch').length), 1, 'the fourth group shows it with its stopwatch');
  assert.equal(await text(p, '.qc-row:nth-of-type(4) .qc-text'), 'Countdown', 'in the last place (the default sixteen)');
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[152, false]], 'said as a phrase, in free roam');
  await from(p, { id: 1, name: 'Me', p: 152, me: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(await count(p), { id: 1, big: true, text: '5' }, 'the player\'s own: big');
  assert.equal(await text(p, '.qc-count'), '5');
  for (const n of ['4', '3', '2', '1', 'GO!']) {
    await p.clock.runFor(1000);
    assert.equal((await count(p))?.text, n);
  }
  await from(p, { id: 2, name: 'Ann', p: 152, d: 10 });
  assert.equal((await count(p))?.id, 1, 'another\'s while one is on: not shown');
  await p.clock.runFor(1000);
  assert.equal(await count(p), null, 'gone after GO!');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-count').length), 0);
  await from(p, { id: 2, name: 'Ann', p: 152, d: 10 });
  await p.clock.runFor(20000);
  await from(p, { id: 2, name: 'Ann', p: 152, d: 10 });
  assert.equal(await count(p), null, 'nor within 30 s after');
  await key(p, 'Digit4'); await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[152, false]], 'the player\'s own waits too');
  assert.equal(await text(p, '.qc-wait'), 'Wait a moment');
  await p.clock.runFor(10000);
  await from(p, { id: 3, name: 'Bo', p: 152, d: 80 });
  assert.deepEqual(await count(p), { id: 3, big: false, text: '5' }, 'past 50 m: over the car');
  assert.deepEqual(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.state().lines), [3]);
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-line svg.qc-watch').length), 1, 'its line with the stopwatch');
  await from(p, { id: 5, name: 'Dee', p: 152, d: 90 });
  assert.equal((await count(p))?.id, 3, 'another far one while it is on: not shown');
  await from(p, { id: 4, name: 'Cy', p: 152, d: 50 });
  assert.deepEqual(await count(p), { id: 4, big: true, text: '5' }, 'within 50 m: big, a far one holds back no near one');
  assert.deepEqual(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).qc.state().lines), [], 'the far one\'s line gone');
  await p.clock.runFor(35000);
  await from(p, { id: 6, name: 'Eve', p: 152, d: 20 });
  assert.equal(await count(p), null, 'nor another near one 35 s after the near one\'s start');
  await p.clock.runFor(1000);
  await from(p, { id: 6, name: 'Eve', p: 152, d: 20 });
  assert.equal((await count(p))?.id, 6, '36 s after: shown');
  await game(p, true, false, 1, 1);
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-row .qc-off svg.qc-watch').length), 1, 'in a race: dimmed');
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [], 'and it says nothing there');
  await p.close();
});

test('the countdown at a car meet where the player has not stayed: dimmed, not allowed, nothing said', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await game(p, true, true, 2);
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.nocount = 1; });
  await p.clock.runFor(200);                                     // (the status is read again)
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-row .qc-off svg.qc-watch').length), 1, 'dimmed');
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [], 'nothing goes to the game');
  assert.equal(await text(p, '.qc-no'), 'You are not allowed to start a countdown here');
  await p.clock.runFor(4100);
  assert.equal(await open(p), -1, 'the message closes as the picker does');
  await key(p, 'Digit1'); await key(p, 'Digit1');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[0, false]], 'other phrases go as ever');
  // the game's own refusal (a pick as the status changed): the same message, no countdown
  await from(p, { id: 1, name: 'Me', p: 152, me: 1, no: 1 });
  assert.equal(await count(p), null, 'no countdown');
  assert.equal(await text(p, '.qc-no'), 'You are not allowed to start a countdown here');
  // stayed (or the meet gone): its own again
  await p.evaluate(() => { /** @type {any} */ (window).st.nocount = 0; });
  await p.clock.runFor(4200);
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qc-row .qc-off').length), 0, 'not dimmed');
  await key(p, 'Digit4');
  assert.deepEqual(await said(p), [[0, false], [152, false]], 'said');
  await p.close();
});

const CTL = 16 + 48 * 24, RING = 1 << 12, TAG = 44, TEXT = CTL + RADIO_WORDS.length * 4;
const settle = async () => { for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) await new Promise(r => setImmediate(r)); };
const pcm = frames => ({ numberOfChannels: 2, getChannelData: c => new Float32Array(frames).fill(c ? 0.5 : 0.25) });

const handle = name => ({ kind: 'file', name, getFile: async () => ({ size: 1, arrayBuffer: async () => new ArrayBuffer(1) }) });
const bad = () => { throw new Error('bad file'); };

function setup(names, decode = async () => pcm(RING * 2)) {
  mock.timers.reset();
  mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setInterval'] });
  globalThis.OfflineAudioContext = function () { this.decodeAudioData = decode; };
  const memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 4, maximum: 4, shared: true });
  const w = new Int32Array(memory.buffer, CTL, RADIO_WORDS.length), log = [];
  w[W.ring] = 0x8000; w[W.ring_frames] = RING;
  const radio = new Radio(() => new RadioLink(memory, 0), l => log.push(l));
  radio.setFolder({ files: names.map(handle), name: 'Music' });
  const game = async (place, seq) => { w[W.req_index] = place; w[W.req_seq] = seq; mock.timers.tick(50); await settle(); };
  const started = async () => { await radio.start(); await settle(); };
  return { memory, w, radio, log, game, started };
}

test('the shared words are in the order of radio_proto.h', () => {
  const h = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'runtime/web/radio_proto.h'), 'utf8');
  const body = h.slice(h.indexOf('uint32_t radio_magic'), h.indexOf('} HostStatusRadio;'));

test('a game whose block is short or not the radio\'s gets no link', () => {
  const memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 4, maximum: 4, shared: true });
  const words = (magic, version) => { const w = new Int32Array(memory.buffer, CTL, 2); w[0] = magic; w[1] = version; };
  assert.equal(RadioLink.open(memory, 0), null);
  words(RADIO_MAGIC, RADIO_VERSION);
  assert.ok(RadioLink.open(memory, 0));
  words(RADIO_MAGIC, RADIO_VERSION + 1);
  assert.equal(RadioLink.open(memory, 0), null);
  for (const ptr of [memory.buffer.byteLength - 8, -4, 2, 1e12, NaN]) assert.equal(RadioLink.open(memory, ptr), null);
});

test('the rings take a track across their end and across the 32-bit counters; nothing is published without rings', () => {
  const memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 4, maximum: 4, shared: true });
  const w = new Int32Array(memory.buffer, CTL, RADIO_WORDS.length), link = new RadioLink(memory, 0);
  assert.equal(link.serve(1, 100), false);
  assert.equal(link.push(new Float32Array(4), new Float32Array(4)), false);
  w[W.ring] = 0x8000; w[W.ring_frames] = RING;
  w[W.written] = w[W.read] = 0x7ffffffb;
  const left = Float32Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, k) => k + 1);
  assert.equal(link.push(left, left.map(v => -v)), true);
  const ring = ch => new Float32Array(memory.buffer, 0x8000 + 4 * RING * ch, RING);
  assert.deepEqual([...ring(0).subarray(RING - 5), ...ring(0).subarray(0, 5)], [...left]);
  assert.deepEqual([...ring(1).subarray(0, 5)], [-6, -7, -8, -9, -10]);
  assert.deepEqual([w[W.written], link.room()], [0x7ffffffb + 10 | 0, RING - 10]);
});

test('a song is served from the queue of its place, the next track is offered, and a track is let go of when its last frame is in', async () => {
  const s = setup(['a.mp3', 'b.mp3', 'c.mp3']);
  await s.started();
  await s.game(0, 1);
  assert.deepEqual([s.w[W.ready_seq], s.w[W.written], text(s.memory, 0, 1), text(s.memory, 1, 1)], [1, RING, 'b', 'a']);
  s.w[W.read] = RING; await s.game(0, 1);
  assert.deepEqual([s.radio.song, s.w[W.written]], [null, RING * 2]);

test('songs that change quickly decode one track at a time: the one under way, then only the latest', async () => {
  let running = 0, most = 0, decodes = 0;
  const done = [];
  const s = setup(['a.mp3', 'b.mp3', 'c.mp3'], () => new Promise(r => { decodes++; most = Math.max(most, ++running); done.push(() => { running--; r(pcm(RING * 2)); }); }));
  await s.started();
  await s.game(0, 1);
  await s.game(0, 2);
  await s.game(1, 3);
  assert.equal(done.length, 1);
  done.shift()(); await settle();
  assert.deepEqual([done.length, s.w[W.ready_seq]], [1, 0]);
  done.shift()(); await settle();
  assert.deepEqual([most, decodes, s.w[W.ready_seq], s.radio.song?.at], [1, 2, 3, RING]);
});

test('ID3 text frames: UTF-16 by its BOM (big-endian when none), a doubled BOM and a UTF-8 BOM', async () => {
  const be = t => Buffer.concat([...t].map(c => Buffer.from([c.charCodeAt(0) >> 8, c.charCodeAt(0) & 255]))), le = t => Buffer.from(t, 'utf16le');
  const frame = (id, ...body) => { const b = Buffer.concat(body.map(x => Buffer.from(x))), h = Buffer.alloc(10); h.write(id); h.writeUInt32BE(b.length, 4); return Buffer.concat([h, b]); };
  const file = (...frames) => { const f = Buffer.concat(frames), h = Buffer.alloc(10); h.write('ID3'); h[3] = 3; h[6] = (f.length >> 21) & 127; h[7] = (f.length >> 14) & 127; h[8] = (f.length >> 7) & 127; h[9] = f.length & 127; return Buffer.concat([h, f]); };
  const read = async buf => tagsOf({ name: 'x.mp3', getFile: async () => ({ slice: () => ({ arrayBuffer: async () => buf.buffer.slice(buf.byteOffset, buf.byteOffset + buf.length) }) }) });
  assert.deepEqual(await read(file(
    frame('TIT2', [1, 0xfe, 0xff, 0xfe, 0xff], be('ヤラララ')), frame('TPE1', [1, 0xff, 0xfe], le('Zoë')), frame('TALB', [1], be('Alb')))),
    { title: 'ヤラララ', artist: 'Zoë', album: 'Alb' });
  assert.equal((await read(file(frame('TIT2', [3, 0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf], 'Ünï', [0], 'junk')))).title, 'Ünï');
});

    s.radio.stop();
  }

// The render check (web/src/app/rendercheck.ts) on a fake clock and a fake game: a phone at 75% that keeps its
// rate with GPU time to spare starts at 100% from its next game; one without the room stays; at 100% a phone that
// falls behind goes back to 75%.  Only driving at the game's own rate counts, after the warm-up.
//   node --test web/test/rendercheck.test.mjs
import { test, mock } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(ROOT, 'web/src/app/rendercheck.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false })).outputFiles[0].text;
const { RenderCheck, RENDER_CHECK_TIMES } = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(js).toString('base64'));

const KEY = 'nfsu2.device.render';
const SEC = 1000, MIN = 60 * SEC;

// the page: localStorage, a document that may be hidden; the game: its status block (counted every 250 ms) and
// the renderer's GPU times
function setup(render, stored = null) {
  mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setInterval'] });
  const store = new Map(stored ? [[KEY, stored]] : []);
  globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: k => store.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: k => store.delete(k) };
  globalThis.document = { hidden: false };
  const g = { frames: 0, t: 5000, rate: 60, drive: 0, done: [], logs: [] };
  const s = {
    status: { read: () => new Map([['frames', g.frames], ['frames_t', g.t], ['rate', g.rate], ['drive', g.drive]]) },
    renderer: { doneMs: () => { const d = g.done; g.done = []; return d; } },
  };
  const check = new RenderCheck(s, render, RENDER_CHECK_TIMES, l => g.logs.push(l));
  // ms of play: fps frames a second, each taking gpu ms on the GPU
  const play = (ms, { fps = 60, gpu = 5, drive = 1, rate = 60 } = {}) => {
    g.drive = drive; g.rate = rate;
    for (let k = 0; k < ms; k += 250) {
      const n = fps / 4;
      g.frames += n; g.t += 250;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) g.done.push(gpu);
      mock.timers.tick(250);
    }
  };
  return { g, check, play, store };
}
const done = (x) => { x.check.stop(); mock.timers.reset(); };

test('75%, the rate kept and GPU time to spare: 100% from the next game, decided after 3 min of driving', () => {
  const x = setup('scale:0.75');
  try {
    x.play(MIN, { gpu: 40, fps: 30 });                  // the warm-up: hitches and slow frames do not count
    x.play(2 * MIN - 5 * SEC, { gpu: 5 });
    assert.equal(x.check.state().verdict, null, 'not before 3 min of driving');
    assert.equal(x.store.get(KEY), undefined);
    x.play(10 * SEC, { gpu: 5 });
    assert.match(x.check.state().verdict, /^room to spare/);
    assert.equal(x.store.get(KEY), 'backing');
    assert.match(x.g.logs.at(-1), /render check after 3\.0 min of driving at 75%: \d+ frames of \d+ \(100%\), a frame 16\.7 ms, GPU p50 5\.0 \/ p90 5\.0 ms \(8\.9 ms at 100%\): room to spare/);
    x.play(MIN, { gpu: 50, fps: 20 });
    assert.equal(x.g.logs.length, 1, 'one verdict a game');
  } finally { done(x); }
});

test('75%, no room: GPU time that would not fit at 100%, or frames missed, keep it at 75%', () => {

function profile(name) {

  f.set(enc.encode('20CM')); v.setUint32(4, 54966, true); v.setUint32(8, 8, true); v.setUint32(12, 54930, true);

}

test('screenshots never crowd out the profile, registry.txt or settings.ini', async () => {

  assert.ok(z.length > 512 * 1048576, `backup ${z.length} bytes`);
  const r = await readBackup(z);
  const paths = r.entries.map(e => e.path);
  for (const p of ['NFS Underground 2/ROTEST/ROTEST', 'registry.txt', 'settings.ini']) assert.ok(paths.includes(p), `${p} kept`);
  assert.deepEqual(r.profiles, ['ROTEST']);
  const shots = paths.filter(isScreenshot);
  assert.equal(shots.length, 22, 'the first 512 MiB of screenshots');
  assert.deepEqual(r.skipped, ['nfsu2022.tga', 'nfsu2023.tga']);
  console.log(`backup ${(z.length / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB, ${r.entries.length} entries kept, skipped ${r.skipped.join(', ')}`);
});

test('a backup within the budget restores whole', async () => {
  const r = await readBackup(backup(3));
  assert.equal(r.entries.length, 6);
  assert.deepEqual(r.skipped, []);
});

/* roam_hubwire.c -- the C side of the hub's tests (web/server-rs/crates/roam/tests/roam_hub.rs, roam_ahead.rs): what
 * runtime/roam_core.c sends the server's free-roam hub, and what it makes of
 * the hub's answer.
 *   roam_hubwire hello|snap|bye   one datagram, as roam_core encodes it, in hex
 *   roam_hubwire peers <hex>      a PEERS datagram decoded: "ok <n> a.b.c.d:port:id ..." or "err <code>"
 *   roam_hubwire map <hex>...     a session that hears the hub (10.77.0.253:47210) asks for the world map
 *                                 ("ask <hex>": its MAPREQ) and takes these datagrams from the hub (each "ask"
 *                                 among them: it asks again, a second on); then "map <gen> <total> <n>
 *                                 id:x,y,h,vx,vy ..." (what it holds)
 *   roam_hubwire mapwide <hex>... the same, asking as the game does (RC_MAPREQ_PARKED | RC_MAPREQ_WIDE)
 *   roam_hubwire near <hex>...    the same for the minimap (its NEARREQ for 64 within 300 m, the hub's NEARDs);
 *                                 then "near <gen> <total> <n> id:x,y,h,vx,vy ..."
 *   roam_hubwire lobby            a race lobby's advert to the hub (to 0), as roam_core encodes it, in hex
 *   roam_hubwire lobbycareer      the same of a lobby whose race counts in its host's career, its host at stage 2
 *   roam_hubwire lobbies <hex>... a session that takes race lobbies asks for the world map as above and takes
 *                                 these datagrams; then "lobbies <gen> <n> x,y,race,n,max,state,flags,hstage ..."
 *   roam_hubwire racerep          a race's report to the hub, as roam_core encodes it, in hex
 *   roam_hubwire hellocrew [n] [id]  a session's HELLO to the hub, in hex: its crews "Blue Room" and "Night Owls"
 *                                 (rc_room_hash) after the ids of the two players the hub listed, who said hello
 *                                 (with n: then the n links it wants, rc_config.links; with id, hex: then the
 *                                 other player of its outrun, rc_set_duel)
 *   roam_hubwire hubcrew <hex>    a session in those two crews takes this list from the hub; then each player
 *                                 listed as "a.b.c.d:port:crew" (rc_peer_crew: 0 or 1, -1 for none), "f" after
 *                                 it for a friend (rc_peer_friend) */
#include "roam_core.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static void unhex(const char *h, uint8_t *b, int *n){
    *n = 0;
    for (; h[0] && h[1] && *n < RC_MAX_DGRAM; h += 2){ unsigned v; sscanf(h, "%2x", &v); b[(*n)++] = (uint8_t)v; }
}
static void sent(void *user, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    (void)user;
    if (ip != 0x0A4D00FDu || port != 47210 || len < 6 || (buf[5] != RC_MSG_MAPREQ && buf[5] != RC_MSG_NEARREQ)) return;
    printf("ask ");
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) printf("%02x", buf[i]);
    printf("\n");
}
/* the last HELLO a session sent the hub (hellocrew) */
static uint8_t hub_hello[RC_MAX_DGRAM];
static int hub_hello_n;
static void sent_hello(void *user, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    (void)user;
    if (ip != 0x0A4D00FDu || port != 47210 || len < 6 || len > RC_MAX_DGRAM || buf[5] != RC_MSG_HELLO) return;
    memcpy(hub_hello, buf, (size_t)len); hub_hello_n = len;
}
static rc_session S;

int main(int argc, char **argv){
    if (argc < 2) return 2;
    rc_msg m; memset(&m, 0, sizeof m);

        c.links = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 0;
        rc_io io; memset(&io, 0, sizeof io); io.send = sent_hello;
        rc_session_init(&S, &c, &io);

        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++){ m.u.peers.e[k].ip = ip[k]; m.u.peers.e[k].port = 47210; m.u.peers.e[k].id = id[k]; }

            h.u.hello.core_ver = RC_CORE_VER; h.u.hello.platform = RC_PLAT_MAC; h.u.hello.status = RC_ST_ROAM;

        printf("\n");

                    crew = rc_peer_crew(&S, i); friend = rc_peer_friend(&S, i);
                }
            printf(" %u.%u.%u.%u:%u:%d%s", ip >> 24, (ip >> 16) & 255u, (ip >> 8) & 255u, ip & 255u, m.u.peers.e[k].port, crew, friend ? "f" : "");

/** builds tests/<name>.c with its head's flags into out/web/test, runs it; its PASS lines and its output */
function run(name, flags) {
  const exe = path.join(OUT, name);
  const b = spawnSync('clang', [...flags, '-Iruntime', '-o', exe, `tests/${name}.c`], { cwd: REPO, encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.equal(b.status, 0, `tests/${name}.c builds:\n${b.stderr}`);
  const r = spawnSync(exe, [], { cwd: REPO, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 60000 });
  const out = (r.stdout ?? '') + (r.stderr ?? '');
  assert.doesNotMatch(out, /^FAIL /m, out);
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, out);
  return { out, pass: [...out.matchAll(/^PASS (\S+):/mg)].map(m => m[1]) };
}

class FFile {
  constructor(name, parent) { this.kind = 'file'; this.name = name; this.parent = parent; this.data = new Uint8Array(0); this.mtime = Date.now(); }
  alive() { return this.parent.alive() && this.parent.kids.get(this.name) === this; }
  path() { return [...this.parent.trail(), this.name].join('/'); }
  async getFile() {
    if (!this.alive()) throw notFound();

    await fsx.hooks.wait?.('getFile', this.path());   // a call the browser takes long to answer, or never
    const d = this.data, m = this.mtime;
    return { size: d.length, lastModified: m, arrayBuffer: async () => d.slice().buffer, text: async () => dec.decode(d) };
  }
  async createWritable() {
    if (!this.alive()) throw notFound();
    fault('write', this.path());
    const parts = [], f = this;
    return {
      async write(x) { parts.push(typeof x === 'string' ? enc.encode(x) : x instanceof Blob ? new Uint8Array(await x.arrayBuffer()) : new Uint8Array(x)); },
      async close() {
        await fsx.hooks.write?.(f.path());           // a slow or full disk
        if (!f.alive()) throw notFound();
        fault('close', f.path());
        const n = parts.reduce((a, p) => a + p.length, 0), d = new Uint8Array(n);
        let o = 0; for (const p of parts) { d.set(p, o); o += p.length; }
        f.data = d; f.mtime = Date.now();
        await fsx.hooks.written?.(f.path());         // the next file not begun yet
      },
    };
  }
}
class FDir {
  constructor(name, parent) { this.kind = 'directory'; this.name = name; this.parent = parent; this.kids = new Map(); }
  alive() { return this.parent ? this.parent.alive() && this.parent.kids.get(this.name) === this : this === fsx.root; }
  trail() { return this.parent ? [...this.parent.trail(), this.name].filter(Boolean) : []; }
  async getDirectoryHandle(n, o = {}) {
    if (!this.alive()) throw notFound();
    fault(o.create ? 'create' : 'dir', [...this.trail(), n].join('/'));
    let k = this.kids.get(n);
    if (k?.kind === 'file') throw new DOMException('', 'TypeMismatchError');
    if (!k) { if (!o.create) { fsx.hooks.missing?.([...this.trail(), n].join('/')); throw notFound(); } k = new FDir(n, this); this.kids.set(n, k); }
    return k;
  }
  async getFileHandle(n, o = {}) {
    if (!this.alive()) throw notFound();
    fault(o.create ? 'create' : 'file', [...this.trail(), n].join('/'));
    let k = this.kids.get(n);
    if (k?.kind === 'directory') throw new DOMException('', 'TypeMismatchError');
    if (!k) {
      if (!o.create) { fsx.hooks.missing?.([...this.trail(), n].join('/')); throw notFound(); }
      k = new FFile(n, this); this.kids.set(n, k);
    }
    return k;
  }
  async removeEntry(n, o = {}) {
    if (!this.alive()) throw notFound();
    fault('remove', [...this.trail(), n].join('/'));
    const k = this.kids.get(n); if (!k) throw notFound();
    if (k.kind === 'directory' && k.kids.size && !o.recursive) throw new DOMException('', 'InvalidModificationError');
    this.kids.delete(n);
  }
  async *entries() { if (!this.alive()) throw notFound(); fault('list', this.trail().join('/')); for (const e of [...this.kids]) yield e; }

}

async function put(p, data) {
  let d = await fsx.root.getDirectoryHandle(SAVE, { create: true });
  const parts = p.split('/');
  for (const x of parts.slice(0, -1)) d = await d.getDirectoryHandle(x, { create: true });
  const f = await d.getFileHandle(parts.at(-1), { create: true });
  f.data = typeof data === 'string' ? enc.encode(data) : data; f.mtime = Date.now();
}
/** put() at once, in the same task (a write of the game's landing between two steps of the page's) */
function putNow(p, data) {
  let d = fsx.root.kids.get(SAVE);
  if (!d) { d = new FDir(SAVE, fsx.root); fsx.root.kids.set(SAVE, d); }
  const parts = p.split('/');
  for (const x of parts.slice(0, -1)) { let k = d.kids.get(x); if (!k) { k = new FDir(x, d); d.kids.set(x, k); } d = k; }
  const f = d.kids.get(parts.at(-1)) ?? new FFile(parts.at(-1), d);
  d.kids.set(parts.at(-1), f); f.data = data; f.mtime = Date.now();
}
/** the browser clears the site's data: OPFS and localStorage (Storage.clearDataForOrigin, all) */
function wipe() { fsx.root = new FDir('', null); store.clear(); }

// ---- /vault in memory (vault.test.mjs's server), with gates: a request held until its gate opens
function server() {
  const kept = new Map(), DAY = 86400000;
  const s = { now: Date.parse('2026-11-02T12:00:00Z'), kept, refuse: 0, gates: [], puts: 0 };
  const tag = n => `"${n.toString(16).padStart(16, '0')}"`;
  let revs = 1;
  const head = (v, earlier) => ({ etag: tag(v.rev), 'x-vault-saved': String(v.saved), ...(earlier ? { 'x-vault-earlier': String(earlier.saved) } : {}) });
  s.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    const h = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(init.headers ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
    const token = (h.authorization ?? '').replace(/^Bearer /, ''), method = init.method ?? 'GET';
    if (!token) return new Response('A keyphrase\'s token is needed', { status: 401 });
    const g = s.gates.find(x => x.method === method && !x.used);
    if (g) { g.used = true; g.reach(); await g.opened; }
    if (s.refuse) return new Response('no', { status: s.refuse });
    const k = kept.get(token);
    if (method === 'GET') {
      const v = url.endsWith('?earlier') ? k?.earlier : k?.cur;
      if (!v) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
      if (!url.endsWith('?earlier') && h['if-none-match'] === tag(v.rev)) return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers: head(v, k.earlier) });
      return new Response(v.body, { status: 200, headers: head(v, url.endsWith('?earlier') ? null : k.earlier) });
    }
    if (method === 'PUT') {
      if (h['if-none-match'] === '*' ? k : !k || h['if-match'] !== tag(k.cur.rev))
        return new Response('Changed elsewhere', { status: 412, headers: k ? head(k.cur, k.earlier) : {} });
      s.puts++;
      const v = { rev: revs++, saved: s.now, body: new Uint8Array(init.body) };
      const n = !k ? { cur: v, earlier: null } : Math.floor(k.cur.saved / DAY) !== Math.floor(s.now / DAY) ? { cur: v, earlier: k.cur } : { cur: v, earlier: k.earlier };
      kept.set(token, n);
      s.now += 1000;
      if (s.loseNext) { s.loseNext = false; throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch'); }   // kept, its answer lost (issue 33)
      return new Response('Saved', { status: k ? 200 : 201, headers: head(v, n.earlier) });
    }
    return new Response('no', { status: 405 });
  };
  s.hold = method => { const g = gate(); g.method = method; s.gates.push(g); return g; };
  return s;
}
/** the cloud's current version's files: path -> bytes */
async function cloudFiles(srv, phrase) {
  const k = await V.keysOf(phrase), v = srv.kept.get(k.token).cur;
  return Object.fromEntries((await unzip(await V.unpack(await V.unseal(k.key, v.body)))).map(e => [e.name, e.data]));
}

/** a fresh browser: an empty OPFS and localStorage, the server, and the start page's VaultPanel owning the saves */
async function page(srv, o = {}) {
  globalThis.fetch = (u, i) => srv.fetch(u, i);
  const logs = [];
  const st = { playing: !!o.playing };
  const asked = [];                                          // the questions the player was asked, answered yes / the first
  const answers = { confirm: true, choose: 'ok' };           // (a test may answer otherwise: choose '' is Esc)
  const panel = new VaultPanel({ querySelector: (() => { const m = new Map(); return s => m.get(s) ?? (m.set(s, el()), m.get(s)); })() }, {
    saveDir: SAVE, owner: () => true, playing: () => st.playing, busy: () => st.playing,
    confirm: async (title, body, ok, danger) => { asked.push({ title, body: textOf(body), ok, danger: !!danger }); return answers.confirm; },
    choose: async (title, body, ok, cancel, danger) => { asked.push({ title, body: textOf(body), ok, cancel, danger: !!danger }); return answers.choose; },
    onRestored() {}, onLink() {}, log: s => logs.push(s),
  });
  await panel.start();
  await panel.ownerNow();
  const sync = () => panel.sync;
  // what check() started (a pull, then a push) has ended
  const settle = async () => { await sync().pull().catch(() => {}); await sync().push().catch(() => {}); };
  await settle();
  return { panel, sync, settle, logs, st, asked, answers };
}
const reset = () => { fsx.root = new FDir('', null); fsx.hooks = {}; store.clear(); };

test('baseline: linked, nothing pending, the wipe: the cloud\'s back, the game\'s save on top goes to the cloud', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);            // Play
  wipe();
  const r = await p.panel.refill(start);
  assert.equal(r.from, 'cloud');
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 2000));           // the game's save, after save-ready
  await p.sync().push({ playing: true });
  const c = await cloudFiles(srv, phrase);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(c).sort(), [at('MEH'), at('TOP'), 'settings.ini']);
  assert.equal(moneyOf(c[at('TOP')]), 2000);
  assert.ok(store.get(`nfsu2-keyphrase:${SAVE}`), 'the link kept again');
});

test('loses: sends failed for a while (server full, offline), then the wipe: the cloud\'s older copy replaces this browser\'s newer one', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  // days of play here while every send fails (VAULT-TOO-LARGE, 507, no connection): TOP earns money, MEH is made here
  srv.refuse = 507;
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 9000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 4000));
  await p.sync().push().catch(() => {});
  assert.equal(p.sync().state.s, 'error');
  srv.refuse = 0;
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);            // Play: TOP 9000 and MEH are here
  wipe();
  const r = await p.panel.refill(start);
  const after = await folder();
  // what pull() would never do by itself (the files here changed since the link): the cloud's taken over them
  assert.ok(after[at('MEH')], `MEH, made here and never sent, is back (refill took '${r.from}': ${Object.keys(after).join(', ')})`);
  assert.equal(moneyOf(after[at('TOP')]), 9000, 'TOP as this browser had it, not the cloud\'s older copy');
  void phrase;
});

test('loses: the server went back (a lost write): the wipe takes a version older than this browser\'s link, which pull() refuses', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  const k = await V.keysOf(phrase), v1 = srv.kept.get(k.token).cur;
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 5000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 700));
  await p.sync().push();
  assert.notEqual(srv.kept.get(k.token).cur.rev, v1.rev);
  // the server's disk restored from the day before: it has v1 again
  srv.kept.set(k.token, { cur: v1, earlier: null });
  // pull() alone: an 'older' conflict, nothing replaced
  await p.sync().pull();
  assert.equal(p.sync().state.s, 'conflict');
  assert.equal(p.sync().state.why, 'older');
  p.sync().reopen();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  wipe();
  await p.panel.refill(start);
  const after = await folder();
  assert.ok(after[at('MEH')], 'MEH (sent, then lost by the server) is back from this browser\'s start');
  assert.equal(moneyOf(after[at('TOP')]), 5000);
});

test('loses: the game\'s save lands before the refill ends (12 s passed): linked as the cloud\'s version, never sent, then replaced by another browser\'s without a conflict', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  const slow = srv.hold('GET');                            // the server answers the refill's GET late (under 8 s)
  wipe();
  const refill = p.panel.refill(start);
  await slow.hit;
  // the I/O worker gave up waiting (SAVE_WAIT_MS): the game's save goes into the new folder now
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 7000));
  slow.open();
  assert.equal((await refill).from, 'cloud');
  assert.equal(moneyOf((await folder())[at('TOP')]), 7000, 'the game\'s file is not written over');
  const puts = srv.puts;
  await p.sync().push({ playing: true });                  // the game's save's send (10 s after it)
  const sent = srv.puts > puts;
  // the player's other browser (a phone) loads the passphrase and plays MEH there
  const bf = new Map();
  const b = new V.VaultSync({ files: async () => V.kept([...bf].map(([path, data]) => ({ path, data }))), restore: async () => {},
    load: () => null, save: () => {}, fetch: srv.fetch });
  const got = await b.peek(phrase);
  for (const e of await unzip(got.zip)) bf.set(e.name, e.data);
  await b.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  bf.set(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 900));
  await b.push();
  // back here, the game ends: newer saves from the other browser come in
  p.st.playing = false;
  await p.sync().pull();
  await p.sync().push();
  const here = await folder(), cloud = await cloudFiles(srv, phrase);
  assert.equal(moneyOf(here[at('TOP')]), 7000, `TOP as this browser's game saved it, here (the game's save was ${sent ? '' : 'never '}sent; state ${p.sync().state.s})`);
  assert.equal(moneyOf(cloud[at('TOP')]), 7000, 'and in the cloud');
});

test('loses: the game writes its profile between the refill\'s look and its write (12 s passed): the cloud\'s older copy lands over it', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  wipe();

  let raced = false;
  fsx.hooks.missing = pth => { if (!raced && `${SAVE}/${at('TOP')}`.startsWith(pth)) { raced = true; putNow(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 7000)); } };
  await p.panel.refill(start);
  assert.ok(raced);
  assert.equal(moneyOf((await folder())[at('TOP')]), 7000, 'the game\'s newer save stays');
});

test('loses: a send queued before the hold runs during it (the server slow, the 8 s fallback): the folder half written goes to the cloud', { timeout: 30000 }, async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  // the game saved twice, a burst apart: the first send's PUT is slow (a bad connection), the second waits behind it
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 2000));
  const slowPut = srv.hold('PUT');
  const first = p.sync().push({ playing: true });
  await slowPut.hit;
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 3000));
  const second = p.sync().push({ playing: true });         // called before the wipe: held is still false
  wipe();
  // the refill: the cloud's GET waits behind both sends, so after 8 s it writes the start's files; the disk is slow
  let n = 0;
  fsx.hooks.written = async () => { if (++n === 1) { slowPut.open(); await first.catch(() => {}); await second.catch(() => {}); } };
  const r = await p.panel.refill(start);
  assert.equal(r.from, 'start');
  const c = await cloudFiles(srv, phrase);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(c).sort(), [at('MEH'), at('TOP'), 'settings.ini'], 'the cloud keeps both profiles: nothing is sent while held');
});

test('loses: a refill that stops halfway (no room), with a send answered during it: after a reload the next push drops the cloud\'s other profile', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  let p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  // a save's send in flight when the browser clears the site's data; its answer comes after
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 2000));
  const slowPut = srv.hold('PUT');
  const inflight = p.sync().push({ playing: true });
  await slowPut.hit;
  wipe();
  fsx.hooks.write = async () => { throw new DOMException('No space available for this operation', 'QuotaExceededError'); };
  const refill = p.panel.refill(start).then(() => 'back', e => `failed: ${e.name}`);
  slowPut.open(); await inflight;
  assert.equal(await refill, 'failed: QuotaExceededError');
  // process.ts posts save-ready anyway: the game saves its profile into the empty folder, which the disk takes now
  fsx.hooks.write = undefined;
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 3000));
  assert.ok(store.get(`nfsu2-keyphrase:${SAVE}`), 'the send\'s answer put the link back into localStorage');
  // the player reloads the page (the toast said the saves could not be put back)
  p = await page(srv);
  assert.ok(p.sync().link);
  const c = await cloudFiles(srv, phrase);
  // (the failed write left MEH's file empty: getFileHandle({ create }) made it before the write failed)
  const sizes = Object.entries(c).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.length}`).join(', ');
  assert.equal(c[at('MEH')]?.length, 54966, `the cloud still has MEH whole (it has ${sizes})`);
  assert.equal(moneyOf(c[at('MEH')]), 500);
});

test('a refill whose cloud write fails falls back to nothing: the start\'s profiles (only in memory) are not written either', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  await p.sync().create();
  p.st.playing = true;
  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  wipe();
  // one write refused (a transient error: the game's handle on that file, a hiccup of the disk), the rest would go
  let n = 0;
  fsx.hooks.write = async () => { if (++n === 1) throw new DOMException('busy', 'NoModificationAllowedError'); };
  const r = await p.panel.refill(start).then(x => x.from, e => `failed: ${e.name}`);
  const after = await folder(), sizes = Object.entries(after).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.length}`).join(', ') || 'empty';
  assert.ok(Object.values(after).every(v => v.length > 0), `no empty file left by the failed write (folder: ${sizes})`);
  assert.ok(after[at('MEH')]?.length && after[at('TOP')]?.length, `both profiles back after one failed write (refill: ${r}; folder: ${sizes})`);
});

test('loses: a conflict waiting when the wipe comes (another browser sent meanwhile): settled for the cloud unasked, with no copy kept (Put back)', async () => {
  reset();

  const phrase = await p.sync().create();

  const bf = new Map();
  const b = new V.VaultSync({ files: async () => V.kept([...bf].map(([path, data]) => ({ path, data }))), restore: async () => {},
    load: () => null, save: () => {}, fetch: srv.fetch });
  const got = await b.peek(phrase);
  for (const e of await unzip(got.zip)) bf.set(e.name, e.data);
  await b.adopt(phrase, got.remote);

  const start = await SU.snapshotSaves(SAVE);
  wipe();
  await p.panel.refill(start);
  const after = await folder();
  const kept = fsx.root.kids.get(`${SAVE}~replaced`);
  assert.ok(after[at('MEH')] || kept, `MEH (only here) back, or kept for Put back (state now ${p.sync().state.s}; folder ${Object.keys(after).join(', ')})`);
  assert.equal(p.sync().state.s, 'conflict', 'the conflict still waits for the player');
});

test('second pass: the "wiped" and "fewer" questions say what Keep this browser\'s deletes in the cloud, its button red', async () => {
  const problems = [];
  // wiped: the site's data cleared while the page sat open, then a game made a new profile
  {
    reset();
    const srv = server();
    await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 90000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
    const p = await page(srv);
    await p.sync().create(); await tick(10);
    wipe();
    await put(at('NEWBIE'), profile('NEWBIE', 0));
    await p.sync().push();
    assert.equal(p.sync().state.why, 'wiped');
    await p.panel.askAtPlay();                             // answered with its first button
    const atPlay = p.asked.find(a => 'cancel' in a);
    if (!/Cloud\s[^·]*TOP/.test(atPlay.body)) problems.push(`wiped, Play's question shows none of the cloud's profiles: "${atPlay.body}" (first button: ${atPlay.ok})`);
    const q = p.asked.find(a => a.ok && /Keep this browser/.test(a.ok) && 'danger' in a);
    if (!q) problems.push('wiped: no confirm for Keep this browser\'s');
    else {
      if (!/TOP/.test(q.body)) problems.push(`wiped, Keep this browser's: the cloud's TOP and MEH it deletes are not named: "${q.body}"`);
      if (!q.danger) problems.push('wiped, Keep this browser\'s: not red');
    }
  }
  // fewer: MEH torn here (a crash during its save), the cloud's MEH whole
  {
    reset();
    const srv = server();
    await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
    const p = await page(srv);
    await p.sync().create();
    await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500).slice(0, 30000));
    await p.sync().push();
    assert.equal(p.sync().state.why, 'fewer');
    await p.panel.keepMine();
    const q = p.asked.at(-1);
    if (!/Cloud\s[^·]*\bMEH \$500/.test(q.body)) problems.push(`fewer, Keep this browser's: the cloud's side (its whole MEH) is not shown: "${q.body}"`);
    if (!q.danger) problems.push('fewer, Keep this browser\'s: not red');
  }
  assert.deepEqual(problems, []);
});

test('third pass: a "thin" question (an older page\'s version without MEH): Use the cloud\'s says it deletes MEH here, and Keep this browser\'s (which keeps it) is not the one marked dangerous', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# settings\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  const phrase = await p.sync().create();
  // the player's other device, on an older page (no zip comment), sends a version without MEH: its folder was deleted
  // and the game saved TOP since, which that page sent by itself
  const k = await V.keysOf(phrase), cur = srv.kept.get(k.token).cur;
  const files = (await unzip(await V.unpack(await V.unseal(k.key, cur.body)))).filter(e => e.name !== at('MEH')).map(e => ({ path: e.name, data: e.data }));
  const tag = `"${cur.rev.toString(16).padStart(16, '0')}"`;
  const r = await srv.fetch('/vault', { method: 'PUT', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${k.token}`, 'if-match': tag }, body: await V.seal(k.key, await V.pack(files)) });
  assert.equal(r.status, 200);
  await p.sync().pull();
  assert.equal(p.sync().state.why, 'thin');
  const problems = [];
  p.answers.choose = '';                                   // Play's question: Esc, back to the page
  await p.panel.askAtPlay();
  const q = p.asked.find(a => 'cancel' in a);
  if (q.danger) problems.push(`Play's question marks Keep this browser's (which keeps MEH) red, and its focused Use the cloud's deletes MEH here: "${q.body}"`);
  await p.panel.takeTheirs();                              // the Saves tab's Use the cloud's
  const c = p.asked.at(-1);
  if (!/\bMEH\b[^.]*\b(deleted|removed|lost|goes|gone)\b/i.test(c.body)) problems.push(`Use the cloud's: its confirm does not say MEH is deleted here: "${c.body}"`);
  assert.deepEqual(problems, []);
});

test('review 4: a Put back that fails (no room to stage) keeps the saves it was to put back', async () => {

  await p.panel.goBack();                                  // the player goes back a day: 5000 kept for Put back

    const z = await unzip(fsx.root.kids.get(`${SAVE}~replaced`).kids.get('saves.zip').data);
    return moneyOf(z.find(e => e.name === at('TOP')).data);

// ---- fourth pass (cae4d8df) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

test('fourth pass, loses: a restore whose undo stops halfway (a move back refused) is undone again later, and that deletes the profiles the first undo put back', async () => {
  reset();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', 500)); await put('settings.ini', '# old\n');
  // a backup restore (or a cloud take): TOP, MEH and settings.ini, all new
  const files = [{ path: at('TOP'), data: profile('TOP', 2000) }, { path: at('MEH'), data: profile('MEH', 2500) },
    { path: 'settings.ini', data: enc.encode('# new\n') }];
  // (this OPFS has no move(): savefs copies, as in a browser without it) settings.ini's move into place is refused
  // once (a file held open), and then, once, the undo's move of MEH back (the disk full, a hiccup)
  let refuseSettings = true, refuseMehBack = false;
  fsx.hooks.write = async pth => {
    if (pth === `${SAVE}/settings.ini` && refuseSettings) { refuseSettings = false; refuseMehBack = true; throw new DOMException('held', 'NoModificationAllowedError'); }
    if (pth === `${SAVE}/${at('MEH')}` && refuseMehBack) { refuseMehBack = false; throw new DOMException('No space available for this operation', 'QuotaExceededError'); }
  };
  await assert.rejects(SF.writeTogether(SAVE, files));
  fsx.hooks.write = undefined;
  const between = await folder();
  // the next restore, or the next page's start, undoes what is left (savefs.ts settleStaged)
  await SF.settleStaged(SAVE);
  const after = await folder();
  const money = f => f ? (f.length === 54966 ? moneyOf(f) : `${f.length} bytes`) : 'gone';
  assert.deepEqual([money(after[at('TOP')]), money(after[at('MEH')]), after['settings.ini'] && dec.decode(after['settings.ini'])],
    [1000, 500, '# old\n'], `the saves as they were (after the first undo: TOP ${money(between[at('TOP')])}, MEH ${money(between[at('MEH')])})`);
});

test('review 6: a Put back cut during its moves keeps the copy it was putting back, whichever of the page start\'s settles comes first', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put('settings.ini', '# then\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  await p.sync().create();
  // a kept copy: TOP 1000 (# then), replaced since by TOP 5000 (# here) (since 2026-11-02 written with its restore)
  const copy = await p.panel.replacedCopy();
  await SF.writeTogether(SAVE, [{ path: at('TOP'), data: profile('TOP', 5000) }, { path: 'settings.ini', data: '# here\n' }], copy.files);
  await p.panel.loadReplaced();                            // (as the panel has it after a restore of its own)
  const zipped = async () => {
    const z = await unzip(fsx.root.kids.get(`${SAVE}~replaced`).kids.get('saves.zip').data);
    return moneyOf(z.find(e => e.name === at('TOP')).data);
  };
  assert.equal(await zipped(), 1000, 'the copy to put back');
  // Put back; the page closes during the moves: TOP 1000 is moved in, then nothing more runs (every write fails)
  let intoSave = 0;
  fsx.hooks.write = path => { if (intoSave) throw new DOMException('closed', 'AbortError'); if (path.startsWith(`${SAVE}/`)) intoSave++; };
  await p.panel.putBack();
  fsx.hooks = {};
  assert.equal(moneyOf((await folder())[at('TOP')]), 1000, '(the moves cut halfway: TOP moved in, settings.ini not)');
  // the next page: its VaultPanel starts (the server answered fast) before the shell's settleStaged has undone the moves
  globalThis.fetch = (u, i) => srv.fetch(u, i);
  const q = new VaultPanel({ querySelector: (() => { const m = new Map(); return s => m.get(s) ?? (m.set(s, el()), m.get(s)); })() }, {
    saveDir: SAVE, owner: () => true, playing: () => false, busy: () => false, confirm: async () => true, choose: async () => 'ok',
    onRestored() {}, onLink() {}, log: () => {},
  });
  await q.start();
  await SF.settleStaged(SAVE);
  assert.equal(moneyOf((await folder())[at('TOP')]), 5000, 'the moves undone');
  assert.equal(await zipped(), 1000, 'the copy it was putting back is still the kept one');
});

test('review 7: Put back twice swaps back and forth, its copy fresh each time; a Put back that fails changes neither', async () => {
  reset();
  const srv = server();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1000)); await put('settings.ini', '# then\n');
  const p = await page(srv);
  await p.sync().create();
  // a kept copy (TOP 1000), the saves here TOP 5000
  const copy = await p.panel.replacedCopy();
  await SF.writeTogether(SAVE, [{ path: at('TOP'), data: profile('TOP', 5000) }, { path: 'settings.ini', data: '# here\n' }], copy.files);
  await p.panel.loadReplaced();
  const keptMoney = async () => moneyOf((await unzip(fsx.root.kids.get(`${SAVE}~replaced`).kids.get('saves.zip').data)).find(e => e.name === at('TOP')).data);
  const here = async () => moneyOf((await folder())[at('TOP')]);
  const seen = [[await here(), await keptMoney()]];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { await p.panel.putBack(); seen.push([await here(), await keptMoney()]); }
  assert.deepEqual(seen, [[5000, 1000], [1000, 5000], [5000, 1000], [1000, 5000]]);
  assert.ok(Date.now() - p.panel.replaced.at < 60_000, 'the copy kept now, not the first one\'s time (30 days from now)');
  assert.ok(p.panel.replaced.side.profiles.some(x => x.money === 5000), 'Put back offers what it keeps');
  // no room to stage: nothing changes, the copy stays
  fsx.hooks.write = path => { if (path.includes('~incoming')) throw new DOMException('quota', 'QuotaExceededError'); };
  await p.panel.putBack();
  fsx.hooks = {};
  assert.deepEqual([await here(), await keptMoney()], [1000, 5000]);
});

// The save folder that does not answer (Firefox 159 on a Mac, Discord 2026-11-04: "UnknownError: Unknown failure" from
// every call there, after a Firefox restart too; the day before, from a second into the game, "NotFoundError: Entry
// not found" for every file new to its storage).  savefs.ts took any error for "not there": a settings.ini that did not
// read was written over with the template, a file whose look-up failed was removed after a failed write, a listing that
// stopped halfway was a backup or a cloud version without the rest.  On b735d26a the first four fail, the checkSaves ones
// too (it had none); the refill one passes there as well (writeIfAbsent looked again before it wrote).

const under = path => (op, p) => p.startsWith(path) ? unknown() : undefined;
const bytes = async p => (await folder())[p];

test('unanswered storage: reads throw its error, never "not there" (null, false, no files, no profiles)', async () => {
  reset();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP')); await put('settings.ini', '# mine\nhorn = train\n'); await put('registry.txt', 'd PowerUnits=1\n');
  fsx.hooks.fail = under(SAVE);
  for (const [what, call] of [['readText', () => SF.readText(SAVE, 'settings.ini')], ['exists', () => SF.exists(SAVE, 'registry.txt')],
    ['listFiles', () => SF.listFiles(SAVE)], ['listProfiles', () => SF.listProfiles(SAVE)], ['readBytes', () => SF.readBytes(SAVE, at('TOP'))]])
    await assert.rejects(call(), { name: 'UnknownError' }, `${what} answered as if nothing were there`);
  fsx.hooks = {};
  // a file or folder that is not there still reads as none, and a read makes no folder
  assert.equal(await SF.readText(SAVE, 'nothing.ini'), null);
  assert.equal(await SF.exists(SAVE, 'nothing.txt'), false);
  assert.equal(await SF.readText('no-such-folder', 'settings.ini'), null);
  assert.deepEqual(await SF.listFiles('no-such-folder'), []);
  assert.equal(fsx.root.kids.has('no-such-folder'), false, 'a read made the folder');
});

test('loadSettings\'s path (shell.ts): a settings.ini whose read fails while writes still work is never replaced by the template', async () => {
  reset();
  const mine = '# mine\nintro = off\nhorn = train\nroam = on\n';
  await put('settings.ini', mine);
  // the shell's loadSettings and editSettings, as they read and write (the template only where there is no file)
  const loadSettings = async () => { const text = await SF.readText(SAVE, 'settings.ini'); if (text === null) await SF.writeFile(SAVE, 'settings.ini', '# the template\n'); return text; };
  const editSettings = async edit => SF.writeFile(SAVE, 'settings.ini', edit(await SF.readText(SAVE, 'settings.ini') ?? '# the template\n'));
  // the file's read fails (a lock, Chrome's NotReadableError on a file changed under the read, Firefox's UnknownError);
  // a write would go through
  fsx.hooks.fail = (op, p) => op === 'getFile' && p === `${SAVE}/settings.ini` ? unknown() : undefined;
  await assert.rejects(loadSettings(), { name: 'UnknownError' });
  await assert.rejects(editSettings(s => s + 'roam = off\n'), { name: 'UnknownError' });     // the free-roam question's answer
  fsx.hooks = {};
  assert.equal(dec.decode(await bytes('settings.ini')), mine);
});

test('a write that fails over a file whose look-up failed leaves that file (it was removed: a profile, settings.ini)', async () => {
  reset();
  await put(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 7000)); await put('settings.ini', '# mine\n');
  // the files' look-up (getFileHandle without create) and their write fail; removing them would work
  const files = [`${SAVE}/${at('TOP')}`, `${SAVE}/settings.ini`];
  fsx.hooks.fail = (op, p) => (op === 'file' || op === 'write') && files.includes(p) ? unknown() : undefined;
  await assert.rejects(SF.writeFile(SAVE, at('TOP'), profile('TOP', 1)));
  await assert.rejects(SF.writeFile(SAVE, 'settings.ini', '# the template\n'));

  assert.equal(dec.decode(await bytes('settings.ini')), '# mine\n', 'settings.ini was removed');

  fsx.hooks = {};

});

  fsx.hooks.fail = (op, p) => op === 'getFile' && (p === `${SAVE}/settings.ini` || p.endsWith('/BBB/BBB')) ? notFound() : undefined;
  const loadSettings = async () => { const text = await SF.readText(SAVE, 'settings.ini'); if (text === null) await SF.writeFile(SAVE, 'settings.ini', '# the template\n'); return text; };
  await assert.rejects(loadSettings(), { name: 'NotFoundError' });

// getFile() (size, lastModified, arrayBuffer, text), createWritable() (write, close: the file changes at close, as
// OPFS's swap file does).  failAfter: that many more writes succeed, then each throws QuotaExceededError.
const opfs = { failAfter: Infinity, clock: 1_700_000_000_000, held: new Set() };   // held: files a worker holds open
const err = name => new DOMException(name, name);
class FileH {
  constructor(name, parent) { this.kind = 'file'; this.name = name; this.parent = parent; this.data = new Uint8Array(0); this.mtime = opfs.clock; }
  /** as Chrome 156 and Firefox 157 do (checked, rv-move.mjs): over an existing file; refused over one held open, and
   *  for one held open itself (Chrome 156 checked: sr-chromecheck2.mjs) */
  async move(a, b) {
    const dest = typeof a === 'string' ? this.parent : a, name = typeof a === 'string' ? a : b, there = dest.kids.get(name);
    if (there && there.kind !== 'file') throw err('TypeMismatchError');
    if (there && opfs.held.has(there) || opfs.held.has(this)) throw err('NoModificationAllowedError');
    this.parent.kids.delete(this.name); this.name = name; this.parent = dest; dest.kids.set(name, this);
  }
  async getFile() { const d = this.data, m = this.mtime; return { size: d.length, lastModified: m, arrayBuffer: async () => d.slice().buffer, text: async () => dec.decode(d) }; }
  async createWritable() {
    const parts = [];
    return {
      write: async x => {
        if (opfs.failAfter-- <= 0) throw err('QuotaExceededError');
        parts.push(typeof x === 'string' ? enc.encode(x) : x instanceof Blob ? new Uint8Array(await x.arrayBuffer()) : new Uint8Array(x.buffer ? x.buffer.slice(x.byteOffset, x.byteOffset + x.byteLength) : x));
      },
      close: async () => { this.data = Buffer.concat(parts.map(p => Buffer.from(p))); this.data = new Uint8Array(this.data); this.mtime = opfs.clock += 1000; },
    };
  }
}

  constructor(name) { this.kind = 'directory'; this.name = name; this.kids = new Map(); }
  async getDirectoryHandle(n, { create = false } = {}) {

    if (k) { if (k.kind !== 'directory') throw err('TypeMismatchError'); return k; }
    if (!create) throw err('NotFoundError');

test('a cloud take or a backup restore that stops halfway (no room) leaves the profiles here', async () => {
  const incoming = await readVault(z({ 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('NEW1')]: profile('NEW1'), [at('NEW2')]: profile('NEW2') }));
  for (const [how, run] of [['cloud', () => restoreVault('Q', incoming)], ['backup', () => restoreSaves('Q', incoming)]]) {
    await seedOpfs({ Q: { 'settings.ini': '# mine\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 123456 }) } });
    opfs.failAfter = 1;
    await assert.rejects(run(), /QuotaExceeded/);
    opfs.failAfter = Infinity;
    const left = await folderOf('Q');
    const whole = ['NEW1', 'NEW2'].every(n => left.has(at(n)) && left.get(at(n)).length === 54966);
    assert.ok(left.has(at('TOP')) || whole, `${how}: TOP gone and the restore not complete: ${JSON.stringify([...left.keys()])}`);
  }
});

test('a cloud take that stops halfway is never sent over the cloud\'s version', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }) }, B: {} });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A'), b = browser(srv, 'B');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  const got = await b.sync.peek(phrase);
  await restoreVault('B', await readVault(got.zip));
  await b.sync.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 2 }));
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', { money: 2 }));
  await a.sync.push();
  const rev = a.sync.link.rev;
  // B takes it, and its writes stop after the first
  opfs.failAfter = 1;
  await b.sync.pull().catch(() => {});
  opfs.failAfter = Infinity;
  await b.sync.push().catch(() => {});
  assert.equal(srv.revOf(phrase, a), rev, 'the cloud keeps A\'s version');
  // (written all or none: savefs.ts writeTogether) B's saves are its own version still, whole, and A's comes in next
  const before = await folderOf('B');
  assert.deepEqual([money(before.get(at('TOP'))), money(before.get(at('MEH')))], [1, 1], 'B\'s version whole: nothing of A\'s written');
  assert.equal([...before.keys()].some(k => k.endsWith('.incoming')), false, 'no file left half way');
  await b.sync.pull();
  const after = await folderOf('B');
  assert.deepEqual([money(after.get(at('TOP'))), money(after.get(at('MEH'))), b.sync.state.s], [2, 2, 'synced'], 'A\'s version at the next pull');
});

test('real profiles with a broken name come in mended from a cloud version, a backup and the PC game: name and checksums only', { skip: !real && 'RV_REAL_DIR not set' }, async () => {
  for (const [n, f] of Object.entries(real)) {
    assert.deepEqual(P.profileName(f).name, n, `${n} is whole`);
    // the Chinese NAME in front, a lone font byte in front, and another name than its folder's
    for (const [inside, dir] of [[ZH, ZH_DIR], ['\x8B' + n.slice(0, 6), folderFor('\x8B' + n.slice(0, 6))], ['OTHER', n]]) {
      const broken = withInside(f, inside);
      const vault = await readVault(z({ [at(dir)]: broken, [`${DIR}/${dir}/GARAGE.DAT`]: new Uint8Array([3]) }));
      const pc = await readBackup(broken, `${dir}`, []);
      for (const [how, r] of [['cloud', vault], ['pc', pc]]) {
        if (how === 'pc' && P.isProfileName(inside)) { assert.deepEqual([r.repaired, r.profiles], [[], [inside]], `${n}/${how}: found by the name inside`); continue; }
        if (how === 'cloud') assert.ok(r.entries.some(e => e.path === `${DIR}/${r.profiles[0]}/GARAGE.DAT`), `${n}: GARAGE.DAT goes with it`);
        assert.equal(r.profiles.length, 1, `${n}/${how}`);
        const to = r.profiles[0], got = r.entries.find(e => e.path === at(to)).data;
        assert.ok(P.isProfileName(to), `${n}/${how}: ${to}`);
        assert.ok(diff(f, got).every(nameOrSums), `${n}/${how}: only the name and the checksums change`);
        assert.equal(P.readSaveMode(got, to).bad, undefined, `${n}/${how}: Autosave and Rename take it as it came in`);
        assert.deepEqual(got.subarray(B, B + 39230), f.subarray(B, B + 39230), `${n}/${how}: GARAGE.DAT's fingerprint part`);
      }
    }
  }
});

test('real profiles: rename mends a broken name in the save folder, its cover with it; an edited one stays refused', { skip: !real && 'RV_REAL_DIR not set' }, async () => {
  for (const [n, f] of Object.entries(real)) {
    const broken = withInside(f, ZH);
    await seedOpfs({ W: { [at(ZH_DIR)]: broken, [`${DIR}/${ZH_DIR}/GARAGE.DAT`]: new Uint8Array([5]), [at(`${ZH_DIR} DVD 1`)]: realCover } });
    const to = n.slice(0, 7).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '') || 'X';
    assert.deepEqual(await P.renameProfile(filesOf('W'), DIR, ZH_DIR, to), { files: 3 }, n);
    const left = await folderOf('W');
    assert.deepEqual(sorted(left.keys()), sorted([at(to), `${DIR}/${to}/GARAGE.DAT`, at(`${to} DVD 1`)]), n);
    assert.ok(diff(f, left.get(at(to))).every(nameOrSums), `${n}: only the name and the checksums`);
    assert.deepEqual(left.get(at(`${to} DVD 1`)), realCover);
    const edited = Buffer.from(broken); edited[0xA16A] ^= 0x40;
    await seedOpfs({ W: { [at(ZH_DIR)]: new Uint8Array(edited) } });
    assert.match((await P.renameProfile(filesOf('W'), DIR, ZH_DIR, to)).refused ?? '', /checksums/, `${n}: an edited one is not repaired by a rename`);
  }
});

// ----------------------------------------------------------- the fake server, browsers --

function server() {
  const kept = new Map(), s = { now: Date.parse('2026-11-02T12:00:00Z'), kept };
  const tag = n => `"${n.toString(16).padStart(16, '0')}"`;
  let revs = 1;
  const head = v => ({ etag: tag(v.rev), 'x-vault-saved': String(v.saved) });
  s.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    const h = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(init.headers ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
    const token = (h.authorization ?? '').replace(/^Bearer /, '');
    if (!token) return new Response('token', { status: 401 });
    const k = kept.get(token), method = init.method ?? 'GET';
    if (method === 'GET') {
      const v = k?.cur;
      if (!v || url.endsWith('?earlier')) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
      if (h['if-none-match'] === tag(v.rev)) return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers: head(v) });
      return new Response(v.body, { status: 200, headers: head(v) });
    }
    if (method === 'PUT') {
      if (h['if-none-match'] === '*' ? k : !k || h['if-match'] !== tag(k.cur.rev)) return new Response('Changed', { status: 412, headers: k ? head(k.cur) : {} });
      s.now += 60_000;
      const v = { rev: revs++, saved: s.now, body: new Uint8Array(init.body) };
      kept.set(token, { cur: v });
      return new Response('Saved', { status: k ? 200 : 201, headers: head(v) });
    }
    return new Response('no', { status: 405 });
  };
  s.revOf = (phrase, b) => { for (const v of kept.values()) return tag(v.cur.rev); };
  return s;
}

/** a browser on save folder `dir` of the OPFS: vault-ui.ts's files() and restore() (readVault, restoreVault) */
function browser(srv, dir) {
  const b = { link: null, taken: 0 };
  b.deps = {
    files: async (o = {}) => {
      const want = o.was ? V.keptBy(o.was) : V.keeps, out = [];
      for (const f of await listFiles(dir)) if (want(f.path)) out.push({ path: f.path, data: await readBytes(dir, f.path), mtime: f.mtime });
      return V.kept(out, o.was);
    },
    restore: async (zipped, still) => restoreVault(dir, await readVault(zipped), still),
    load: () => b.link && JSON.parse(b.link),
    save: l => { b.link = l && JSON.stringify(l); },
    fetch: srv.fetch,
    log: () => {},
    leftOut: files => leftOut(files), named: files => profilesComing(files),
    folder: () => readBeside(`${dir}~folder`), mark: id => writeBeside(`${dir}~folder`, id),
  };
  b.sync = new V.VaultSync(b.deps);
  b.sync.onTaken = () => b.taken++;
  return b;
}

// ----------------------------------------------- the cloud never takes or gets less by itself --

test('a version another browser sent with a profile this one cannot take in: asked, never taken by itself', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 7 }) }, B: {} });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A'), b = browser(srv, 'B');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  const got = await b.sync.peek(phrase);
  await restoreVault('B', await readVault(got.zip));
  await b.sync.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  // B gets a profile of another version of the game (a copy from elsewhere put in its folder) and sends it
  const old = Buffer.from(profile('OLDV')); old.writeUInt32LE(0x10C, 28);
  await filesOf('B').writeFile(at('OLDV'), new Uint8Array(old));
  await filesOf('B').writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 8 }));
  await b.sync.push();
  // (B sends no profile that is not whole by itself either: its player keeps B's, or an older page sent it)
  assert.deepEqual([b.sync.state.s, b.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'fewer']);
  await b.sync.keepMine();
  assert.deepEqual(leftOut((await unzip((await b.sync.peek(phrase)).zip)).map(e => ({ path: e.name, data: e.data }))), ['OLDV']);
  const before = await folderOf('A');
  await a.sync.pull();
  assert.deepEqual([a.sync.state.s, a.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'drops']);
  const after = await folderOf('A');
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(after.keys()), sorted(before.keys()), 'nothing here changed');
  assert.equal(money(after.get(at('TOP'))), 7);
});

test('a save folder deleted since it synced (its mark gone) is never sent by itself; profiles deleted or renamed on purpose are', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }),
    [at('ZED')]: profile('ZED', { money: 1 }) } });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  await a.sync.markFolder();
  assert.ok(a.sync.link.folder && await readBeside('A~folder') === a.sync.link.folder, 'the folder marked');
  // a profile the game deleted (its own Delete: the I/O worker's 'removed', shell.ts onRemoved): sent
  let rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  await filesOf('A').remove(`${DIR}/ZED`);
  a.sync.removed();
  await a.sync.push();
  assert.notEqual(srv.revOf(phrase), rev, 'the deletion went out');
  assert.equal(a.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  // one gone without a word of it: asked once, and sent as the player keeps it
  rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  await filesOf('A').remove(`${DIR}/MEH`);
  await a.sync.push();
  assert.deepEqual([srv.revOf(phrase), a.sync.state.why], [rev, 'fewer']);
  await a.sync.keepMine();
  assert.notEqual(srv.revOf(phrase), rev);
  assert.equal(a.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  // a rename on the Saves tab (VaultPanel.changedSaves): sent
  rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  assert.deepEqual(await P.renameProfile(filesOf('A'), DIR, 'TOP', 'BOB'), { files: 1 });
  a.sync.intended();
  await a.sync.push();
  assert.notEqual(srv.revOf(phrase), rev, 'the rename went out');
  // the browser deletes the site's data (the folder and its mark); the game saves one profile into a new folder
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('MEH'), profile('MEH', { money: 2 }));
  await a.sync.push();
  rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  await removeSaveDir('A'); await root.removeEntry('A~folder');
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('BOB'), profile('BOB', { money: 3 }));
  await a.sync.push();
  assert.equal(srv.revOf(phrase), rev, 'the one profile does not replace the cloud\'s two');
  assert.deepEqual([a.sync.state.s, a.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'wiped']);
  assert.deepEqual(a.sync.state.cloud.profiles.map(x => x.name).sort(), ['BOB', 'MEH'], 'the question shows the cloud\'s side');
  // Use the cloud's: both back, the new mark taken
  await a.sync.takeTheirs();
  const left = await folderOf('A');
  assert.deepEqual(sorted([...left.keys()].filter(k => k.startsWith(DIR))), sorted([at('BOB'), at('MEH')]));
  assert.equal(a.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
  assert.equal(await readBeside('A~folder'), a.sync.link.folder);
});

test('the saves back after a folder deleted during a game (shell.ts saveGone): the folder marked again, sends go on', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  const start = { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }) };
  await seedOpfs({ A: start });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  await a.sync.markFolder();
  const rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  // deleted during the game; the start's saves back (VaultPanel.refill without the cloud), the mark with them
  await removeSaveDir('A'); await root.removeEntry('A~folder');
  a.sync.hold(true);
  for (const [path, d] of Object.entries(start)) await filesOf('A').writeFile(path, typeof d === 'string' ? enc.encode(d) : d);
  await a.sync.keepLink();
  a.sync.hold(false);
  // the game's save on top
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 9 }));
  await a.sync.push();
  assert.notEqual(srv.revOf(phrase), rev);
  assert.equal(a.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  const sent = await unzip((await a.sync.peek(phrase)).zip);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(sent.map(e => e.name).filter(n => n.startsWith(DIR))), sorted([at('MEH'), at('TOP')]));
  assert.equal(money(sent.find(e => e.name === at('TOP')).data), 9);
});

// ------------------------------------------------- second pass (34f8145a, 942c80d0) --

/** A and B linked to one passphrase, A's folder as given (B loads it); B's then changed by change() and sent */
async function twoBrowsers(aFiles, change) {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: aFiles, B: {} });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A'), b = browser(srv, 'B');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  await a.sync.markFolder();
  const got = await b.sync.peek(phrase);
  await restoreVault('B', await readVault(got.zip));
  await b.sync.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  await b.sync.markFolder();
  await change(filesOf('B'), b);
  return { srv, a, b, phrase };
}

test('a version that removed a profile (the game\'s own Delete elsewhere) is taken by itself: no \'drops\'', async () => {
  const { a, b } = await twoBrowsers({ 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP'), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH') }, async (fs, b) => {
    await fs.remove(`${DIR}/MEH`); b.sync.removed();
    await fs.writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 5 }));
    await b.sync.push();
  });
  assert.equal(b.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  await a.sync.pull();
  assert.equal(a.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  const left = await folderOf('A');
  assert.deepEqual([left.has(at('MEH')), money(left.get(at('TOP')))], [false, 5]);
});

test('leftOut is empty for every profile a restore takes in: edited, heap-named, Chinese NAME, case twins, an orphan folder beside', () => {
  const edited = Buffer.from(profile('ED')); edited[0xA16A] ^= 1;

    [at('ED'), new Uint8Array(edited)], [at(HEAP_DIR), profile(HEAP)], [`${DIR}/${HEAP_DIR}/GARAGE.DAT`, new Uint8Array([1])],

});

test('an automatic take that stops halfway leaves no profile with another version\'s GARAGE.DAT', async () => {

    async (fs, b) => {

test('Use the cloud\'s on a \'drops\' conflict keeps this browser\'s copy of the profile the cloud\'s cannot bring, and its covers', async () => {
  const { a } = await twoBrowsers({ 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('XYZ')]: profile('XYZ', { money: 4242 }),
    [at('XYZ DVD 1')]: cover(3) }, async (fs, b) => {
    // B's XYZ becomes one this game cannot load (another version's, as a copy from elsewhere), its player keeps B's
    const old = Buffer.from(profile('XYZ')); old.writeUInt32LE(0x10C, 28);
    await fs.writeFile(at('XYZ'), new Uint8Array(old));
    await fs.writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 2 }));
    await b.sync.push();
    await b.sync.keepMine();
  });
  await a.sync.pull();
  assert.deepEqual([a.sync.state.s, a.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'drops']);
  await a.sync.takeTheirs();
  const left = await folderOf('A');
  assert.equal(money(left.get(at('TOP'))), 2, 'the cloud\'s TOP came in');
  assert.equal(left.has(at('XYZ')) && money(left.get(at('XYZ'))), 4242, `XYZ's career stays here: ${JSON.stringify([...left.keys()])}`);
  assert.ok(left.has(at('XYZ DVD 1')), 'and its cover');
});

test('a mended profile\'s covers moved by a cloud take never overwrite a cover already here', async () => {

});

test('a backup restore and a cloud take at once leave the saves of one of them whole', async () => {
  const backup = await readBackup(z({ 'registry.txt': 'r', 'settings.ini': '# b\n', [at('BAK1')]: profile('BAK1'), [at('BAK2')]: profile('BAK2') }));
  const cloud = await readVault(z({ 'settings.ini': '# c\n', [at('CLD1')]: profile('CLD1'), [at('CLD2')]: profile('CLD2') }));
  await seedOpfs({ T: { 'settings.ini': '# t\n', [at('OLD')]: profile('OLD') } });
  // the Saves tab's restore confirmed while an automatic take (VaultSync.pull at the page's start) writes: nothing
  // makes one wait for the other (SavesPanel.busy, VaultPanel.restore)
  const ends = (await Promise.allSettled([restoreSaves('T', backup), restoreVault('T', cloud)])).map(x => x.status === 'rejected' ? String(x.reason?.name ?? x.reason) : 'done');
  const ps = (await listProfiles('T')).map(p => p.name);
  const whole = n => ['1', '2'].every(i => ps.includes(n + i));
  assert.ok(whole('BAK') || whole('CLD'), `restore ${ends[0]}, take ${ends[1]}; profiles left: ${JSON.stringify(ps)}`);
});

test('a version from an older page (no GUARDED note) that lacks a profile here is asked, never taken by itself', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }) } });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  // another device's cached page of before this note sends TOP alone (its folder deleted, a new career)
  const k = await V.keysOf(phrase), cur = [...srv.kept.values()][0].cur;
  const thin = await V.seal(k.key, await V.pack([{ path: 'settings.ini', data: enc.encode('# s\n') }, { path: at('TOP'), data: profile('TOP', { money: 0 }) }]));
  const put = await srv.fetch('/vault', { method: 'PUT', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${k.token}`, 'if-match': `"${cur.rev.toString(16).padStart(16, '0')}"` }, body: thin });
  assert.equal(put.status, 200);
  await a.sync.pull();
  assert.deepEqual([a.sync.state.s, a.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'thin']);
  const left = await folderOf('A');
  assert.deepEqual([money(left.get(at('TOP'))), left.has(at('MEH'))], [1, true], 'nothing here replaced');
  // the same from this page (its note on it) is taken: a profile deleted on purpose there
  await seedOpfs({ A2: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }) }, B2: {} });
  const a2 = browser(srv, 'A2'), b2 = browser(srv, 'B2');
  const p2 = await a2.sync.create();
  const got = await b2.sync.peek(p2);
  await restoreVault('B2', await readVault(got.zip)); await b2.sync.adopt(p2, got.remote);
  await filesOf('B2').remove(`${DIR}/MEH`); b2.sync.removed();   // the game's own Delete there
  await b2.sync.push();
  await a2.sync.pull();
  assert.equal(a2.sync.state.s, 'synced');
  assert.equal((await folderOf('A2')).has(at('MEH')), false);
});

test('an automatic take decided before a Saves-tab restore wrote is not written over it: the restore stays, the next push asks', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }) }, B: {} });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A'), b = browser(srv, 'B');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  const got = await b.sync.peek(phrase);
  await restoreVault('B', await readVault(got.zip)); await b.sync.adopt(phrase, got.remote);
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('TOP'), profile('TOP', { money: 2 }));
  await a.sync.push();
  // B's pull reads its saves (unchanged since it synced: A's version is taken), and the player's backup restore is
  // confirmed just then: it writes first
  const backup = await readBackup(z({ 'settings.ini': '# b\n', [at('BAK')]: profile('BAK', { money: 9 }) }));
  const files = b.deps.files;
  let restoring = null;
  b.deps.files = async o => { const f = await files(o); if (!restoring) restoring = restoreSaves('B', backup); return f; };
  await b.sync.pull();
  await restoring;
  b.deps.files = files;
  const left = await folderOf('B');
  assert.deepEqual([money(left.get(at('BAK'))), left.has(at('TOP'))], [9, false], 'the backup the player restored stays');
  assert.equal(b.taken, 0, 'nothing taken');
  b.sync.intended();                                             // (VaultPanel.changedSaves after the restore)
  await b.sync.push();
  assert.deepEqual([b.sync.state.s, b.sync.state.why], ['conflict', 'both'], 'asked: the cloud has A\'s newer version');
});

test('profiles deleted on purpose are kept in the link: a send that failed and a reload ask nothing', async () => {
  const srv = server();
  await seedOpfs({ A: { 'settings.ini': '# s\n', [at('TOP')]: profile('TOP', { money: 1 }), [at('MEH')]: profile('MEH', { money: 1 }) } });
  const a = browser(srv, 'A');
  const phrase = await a.sync.create();
  const rev = srv.revOf(phrase);
  await filesOf('A').remove(`${DIR}/MEH`);
  a.sync.removed();                                              // the game's own Delete (shell.ts onRemoved)
  const fetch = srv.fetch;
  a.deps.fetch = async () => { throw new TypeError('offline'); };
  await a.sync.push().catch(() => {});
  assert.equal(srv.revOf(phrase), rev, 'nothing sent (offline)');
  // the page reloads: a new VaultSync on the link it kept
  a.deps.fetch = fetch;
  const again = new V.VaultSync(a.deps);
  assert.equal(again.link.dropped, 1);
  await again.push();
  assert.equal(again.state.s, 'synced', `${again.state.s} ${again.state.why ?? ''}`);
  assert.notEqual(srv.revOf(phrase), rev, 'the deletion went out');
  assert.equal(again.link.dropped, undefined, 'and the count starts again');
  // a profile emptied after that (a failed write) still asks
  await filesOf('A').writeFile(at('TOP'), new Uint8Array(0));
  await again.push();
  assert.deepEqual([again.state.s, again.state.why], ['conflict', 'fewer']);
});

/** the handle of a file of a save folder (the mock's), to hold it open as a worker would */
async function handleOf(dir, path) {
  let d = await root.getDirectoryHandle(dir);
  const p = path.split('/');
  for (const x of p.slice(0, -1)) d = await d.getDirectoryHandle(x);
  return d.getFileHandle(p[p.length - 1]);
}

test('a take whose staging stops (no room) changes nothing and leaves nothing staged, with move() as the browsers have it', async () => {
