#!/usr/bin/env node
// DXT1 as ASTC (web/src/gpu/astc.ts) checked on a real GPU: random DXT1 blocks of every kind go up as ASTC 4x4
// (dxt1ToAstc) and as BC1, a compute pass reads every texel back (textureLoad), and each is compared with the CPU's
// unpacking (dxt.ts unpackDxt, what a GPU without BC shows now):
//   node web/tools/astc-check.mjs [--browser chrome|webkit|both] [--blocks N]
// Exits 1 when a texel is further off than the transcoding allows: four-colour blocks 2 of 255 (BC1's thirds against
// ASTC's 21 and 43 of 64), three-colour 1 (the midpoint rounded), alpha exact; dual-plane blocks (a transparent
// texel in a texture already ASTC) 3 (7-bit endpoints), their transparent texels alpha 0.  BC1 on the same GPU is
// printed beside it: how far a GPU's own BC1 is from the CPU's unpacking.
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';
import { webkit, chromium } from 'playwright';
import { pickBrowser } from './browser.mjs';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const arg = (k, d) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(k); return i > 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : d; };
const which = arg('--browser', 'both'), BLOCKS = Number(arg('--blocks', 16384));

const entry = `export { unpackDxt } from './web/src/gpu/dxt.ts'; export { dxt1ToAstc, dxt1HasPunch } from './web/src/gpu/astc.ts';`;
const lib = (await esbuild.build({ stdin: { contents: entry, resolveDir: ROOT, loader: 'ts' }, bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false, platform: 'neutral' })).outputFiles[0].text;

// runs in the page: lib's exports as L
async function inPage({ BLOCKS }) {
  const L = window.L, DXT1 = 0x31545844;
  const adapter = await navigator.gpu?.requestAdapter();
  if (!adapter) return { skip: 'no WebGPU adapter' };
  if (!adapter.features.has('texture-compression-astc')) return { skip: 'no texture-compression-astc' };
  const bc = adapter.features.has('texture-compression-bc');
  const device = await adapter.requestDevice({ requiredFeatures: ['texture-compression-astc', ...(bc ? ['texture-compression-bc'] : [])] });
  const errs = []; device.addEventListener('uncapturederror', e => errs.push(e.error.message));

  // the blocks: a fixed pseudo-random sequence, every kind of block in turn
  let seed = 12345;
  const rnd = () => (seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0) >>> 8;
  const bw = 128, bh = Math.ceil(BLOCKS / bw), W = bw * 4, H = bh * 4, src = new Uint8Array(bw * bh * 8);
  const kinds = new Uint8Array(bw * bh);     // 0 four colours, 1 three (no hole), 2 three with holes, 3 one colour
  for (let i = 0; i < bw * bh; i++) {
    const kind = i % 4, extreme = (i >> 2) % 7 === 0;
    let c0 = extreme ? [0, 0xFFFF, 0xF800, 0x07E0, 0x001F][rnd() % 5] : rnd() & 0xFFFF;
    let c1 = extreme ? [0, 0xFFFF, 0xF800, 0x07E0, 0x001F][rnd() % 5] : rnd() & 0xFFFF;
    if (kind === 3) c1 = c0;
    else if (c0 === c1) c1 = c0 ^ 1;
    if ((kind === 0) !== (c0 > c1) && kind !== 3) [c0, c1] = [c1, c0];
    let idx = (rnd() << 8 ^ rnd()) >>> 0;
    if (kind === 1 || kind === 3) { let m = 0; for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) if (((idx >>> 2 * t) & 3) === 3) m |= 1 << 2 * t; idx = (idx & ~m) >>> 0; }
    if (kind === 2 && !L.dxt1HasPunch(new Uint8Array([c0, c0 >> 8, c1, c1 >> 8, idx, idx >> 8, idx >> 16, idx >>> 24]), 0, 8, 1, 1)) idx = (idx | 3) >>> 0;
    if (kind === 3 && c0 > c1) c0 = c1;     // one colour: c0 = c1, three-colour mode
    src.set([c0 & 255, c0 >> 8, c1 & 255, c1 >> 8, idx & 255, (idx >> 8) & 255, (idx >> 16) & 255, idx >>> 24], i * 8);
    kinds[i] = kind;
  }
  const want = L.unpackDxt(DXT1, src, 0, bw * 8, W, H);           // BGRA
  const punch = { blocks: 0 };
  const astc = L.dxt1ToAstc(src, 0, bw * 8, bw, bh, undefined, punch);

  const read = async (format, data, bytesPerRow) => {
    const tex = device.createTexture({ size: [W, H], format, usage: GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING | GPUTextureUsage.COPY_DST });
    device.queue.writeTexture({ texture: tex }, data, { bytesPerRow, rowsPerImage: bh }, [W, H, 1]);
    const out = device.createBuffer({ size: W * H * 4, usage: GPUBufferUsage.STORAGE | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_SRC });
    const rb = device.createBuffer({ size: W * H * 4, usage: GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    const mod = device.createShaderModule({ code: `
      @group(0) @binding(0) var t: texture_2d<f32>;
      @group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> o: array<u32>;
      @compute @workgroup_size(8, 8) fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) g: vec3u) {
        if (g.x >= ${W}u || g.y >= ${H}u) { return; }
        o[g.y * ${W}u + g.x] = pack4x8unorm(textureLoad(t, vec2i(g.xy), 0));
      }` });
    const pipe = device.createComputePipeline({ layout: 'auto', compute: { module: mod, entryPoint: 'main' } });
    const bg = device.createBindGroup({ layout: pipe.getBindGroupLayout(0), entries: [{ binding: 0, resource: tex.createView() }, { binding: 1, resource: { buffer: out } }] });
    const e = device.createCommandEncoder(), p = e.beginComputePass();
    p.setPipeline(pipe); p.setBindGroup(0, bg); p.dispatchWorkgroups(W / 8, H / 8); p.end();
    e.copyBufferToBuffer(out, 0, rb, 0, W * H * 4); device.queue.submit([e.finish()]);
    await rb.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ);
    return new Uint8Array(rb.getMappedRange().slice(0));         // RGBA
  };
  const compare = (got) => {
    // per kind: the largest colour difference, alpha mismatches; holes: their alpha only
    const r = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => ({ maxColour: 0, alphaWrong: 0, holeAlphaWrong: 0, sumColour: 0, n: 0 }));
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const i = y * W + x, k = kinds[(y >> 2) * bw + (x >> 2)], s = r[k];
      const wr = want[4 * i + 2], wg = want[4 * i + 1], wb = want[4 * i], wa = want[4 * i + 3];
      const gr = got[4 * i], gg = got[4 * i + 1], gb = got[4 * i + 2], ga = got[4 * i + 3];
      if (wa === 0) { if (ga !== 0) s.holeAlphaWrong++; continue; }
      if (ga !== wa) s.alphaWrong++;
      const d = Math.max(Math.abs(gr - wr), Math.abs(gg - wg), Math.abs(gb - wb));
      s.maxColour = Math.max(s.maxColour, d); s.sumColour += d; s.n++;
    }
    return r.map(s => ({ maxColour: s.maxColour, meanColour: +(s.sumColour / Math.max(1, s.n)).toFixed(3), alphaWrong: s.alphaWrong, holeAlphaWrong: s.holeAlphaWrong }));
  };
  const res = { blocks: bw * bh, dualPlane: punch.blocks, astc: compare(await read('astc-4x4-unorm', astc, bw * 16)) };
  if (bc) res.bc1 = compare(await read('bc1-rgba-unorm', src, bw * 8));
  await device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone();
  res.errors = errs;
  return res;
}

const LIMIT = [{ maxColour: 2 }, { maxColour: 1 }, { maxColour: 3 }, { maxColour: 0 }];
const KIND = ['four colours', 'three colours', 'three with holes (dual plane)', 'one colour'];
let failed = false;
for (const name of which === 'both' ? ['chrome', 'webkit'] : [which]) {
  const browser = name === 'chrome'
    ? await chromium.launch({ ...pickBrowser(), headless: true, args: ['--enable-unsafe-webgpu'] })
    : await webkit.launch({ headless: false });
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.route('https://astc.test/', r => r.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/html', body: '<!doctype html><title>astc</title>' }));
  await page.goto('https://astc.test/');
  await page.addScriptTag({ type: 'module', content: lib.replace(/export\s*\{([^}]*)\};?\s*$/, (_, names) => `window.L = { ${names.replace(/(\w+) as (\w+)/g, '$2: $1')} };`) });
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.L);
  const r = await page.evaluate(inPage, { BLOCKS });
  await browser.close();
  if (r.skip) { console.log(`${name}: skipped (${r.skip})`); continue; }
  console.log(`${name}: ${r.blocks} blocks, ${r.dualPlane} dual-plane${r.errors.length ? `, WebGPU errors: ${r.errors.join('; ')}` : ''}`);
  r.astc.forEach((s, k) => {
    const bad = s.maxColour > LIMIT[k].maxColour || s.alphaWrong || s.holeAlphaWrong;
    if (bad) failed = true;
    const bc1 = r.bc1 ? `   BC1 on this GPU: max ${r.bc1[k].maxColour} mean ${r.bc1[k].meanColour}` : '';
    console.log(`  ${bad ? 'FAIL' : 'ok  '} ${KIND[k].padEnd(30)} ASTC: max ${s.maxColour} mean ${s.meanColour}, alpha wrong ${s.alphaWrong}, holes not transparent ${s.holeAlphaWrong}${bc1}`);
  });
  if (r.errors.length) failed = true;
}
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);

async function play(step, script, ms, env = []) {

  if (/^https?:/.test(wasm)) { const u = new URL(wasm); base = u.origin; wasm = u.pathname; }
  q.set('wasm', wasm);
  for (const [k, v] of new URLSearchParams(extra ?? '')) if (k === 'env') q.append(k, v); else q.set(k, v);
  q.append('arg', '/data/SPEED2.EXE'); q.set('w', String(W)); q.set('h', String(H));
  q.set('gputime', ''); q.set('bench', '');
  q.set('save', `perf-bench-${process.pid}-${saveN++}`); q.set('fresh', '');
  q.set('reg', '/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt'); q.set('script', o.script);
  const env = { ...SUITE_ENV, NFSU2_FPS: fps, ...Object.fromEntries(o.env.map(e => [e.slice(0, e.indexOf('=')), e.slice(e.indexOf('=') + 1)])) };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(env)) q.append('env', `${k}=${v}`);
  return `${base}/test/play.html?${q}`;
}

// the machine's load: the 1-minute load average on macOS; elsewhere the busy cores since the last sample
// (os.cpus() times: Windows has no load average), this run's own Chrome included in both
let cpusLast = null;
const load1 = () => {
  if (process.platform === 'darwin') { try { return +execFileSync('sysctl', ['-n', 'vm.loadavg'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).replace(/[{}]/g, '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0]; } catch { return NaN; } }
  const c = os.cpus().map(x => [x.times.user + x.times.nice + x.times.sys + x.times.irq, x.times.idle]), z = cpusLast;
  cpusLast = c;
  if (!z || z.length !== c.length) return NaN;
  let busy = 0, all = 0;
  c.forEach(([b, i], k) => { busy += b - z[k][0]; all += b + i - z[k][0] - z[k][1]; });
  return all > 0 ? busy / all * c.length : NaN;
};
const uptime = () => { try { return execFileSync('uptime', { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); } catch { return ''; } };

// ---- DevTools CPU profiler on the page's dedicated workers (flat CDP sessions over a raw socket) ----
class Cdp {
  constructor(ws) { this.ws = ws; this.id = 0; this.wait = new Map(); this.handlers = [];
    ws.on('message', d => { const m = JSON.parse(d); if (m.id && this.wait.has(m.id)) { const w = this.wait.get(m.id); this.wait.delete(m.id); m.error ? w.rej(new Error(JSON.stringify(m.error))) : w.res(m.result); } else for (const h of this.handlers) h(m); }); }
  send(method, params = {}, sessionId) { const id = ++this.id; this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params, sessionId })); return new Promise((res, rej) => this.wait.set(id, { res, rej })); }
  static async connect(port) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      try { const j = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/version`)).json(); const ws = new WebSocket(j.webSocketDebuggerUrl, { perMessageDeflate: false, maxPayload: 1 << 30 }); await new Promise((r, x) => { ws.once('open', r); ws.once('error', x); }); return new Cdp(ws); }
      catch { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); }
    }
    throw new Error('no DevTools endpoint');
  }
}
async function profilerFor(port) {
  const cdp = await Cdp.connect(port);
  const workers = new Map();       // sessionId -> { title, url }
  cdp.handlers.push(m => {
    if (m.method === 'Target.attachedToTarget') {
      const t = m.params.targetInfo;
      if (t.type === 'worker') workers.set(m.params.sessionId, { title: t.title, url: t.url });
      cdp.send('Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger', {}, m.params.sessionId).catch(() => {});
    }
  });
  const { targetInfos } = await cdp.send('Target.getTargets');
  const page = targetInfos.find(t => t.type === 'page' && t.url.includes('/test/play.html'));
  const { sessionId } = await cdp.send('Target.attachToTarget', { targetId: page.targetId, flatten: true });
  await cdp.send('Target.setAutoAttach', { autoAttach: true, waitForDebuggerOnStart: false, flatten: true }, sessionId);
  workers.set(sessionId, { title: 'page', url: page.url });     // the page's main thread: the renderer's encoder
  return {
    async start() {
      for (const s of workers.keys()) {
        await cdp.send('Profiler.enable', {}, s); await cdp.send('Profiler.setSamplingInterval', { interval: o.interval }, s);
        await cdp.send('Profiler.start', {}, s);
      }
      return workers.size;
    },
    async stop() {
      const res = [];
      for (const [s, w] of workers) { try { const { profile } = await cdp.send('Profiler.stop', {}, s); res.push({ ...w, profile }); } catch { /* gone */ } }
      cdp.ws.close();
      return res;
    },
  };
}
// Samples whose leaf is one of these are a blocked or idle thread, not work: V8's sampler keeps sampling a thread
// parked in Atomics.wait (the pool's idle loop in onmessage, futex waits, the guest lock's ticket wait, the
// host's sleep/RPC wait), so they are counted apart.
const WAITS = new Set(['(idle)', '(program)', '(garbage collector)', '(root)', 'onmessage', '__wasilibc_futex_wait',
  'gil_acquire', 'q', 'poll_oneoff', 'wait32', 'tramp_main', 'input_main']);
function analyse(prof, interval) {
  const nodes = new Map(prof.nodes.map(n => [n.id, n])), parent = new Map();
  for (const n of prof.nodes) for (const c of n.children ?? []) parent.set(c, n.id);
  const name = n => (n.callFrame.functionName || '(anonymous)').replace(/^\$/, '');
  const self = new Map(), incl = new Map(), waits = new Map();
  let work = 0, total = 0, lifted = 0;
  const dts = prof.timeDeltas ?? [];
  for (let i = 0; i < prof.samples.length; i++) {
    const n = nodes.get(prof.samples[i]); total++;
    const nm = name(n);
    if (WAITS.has(nm)) { waits.set(nm, (waits.get(nm) ?? 0) + 1); continue; }
    work++; if (nm.startsWith('sub_')) lifted++;
    self.set(nm, (self.get(nm) ?? 0) + 1);
    const seen = new Set();
    for (let id = n.id; id !== undefined; id = parent.get(id)) { const k = name(nodes.get(id)); if (!seen.has(k)) { seen.add(k); incl.set(k, (incl.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); } }
  }
  const span = (prof.endTime - prof.startTime) / 1e3;
  const top = (m, k) => [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, k).map(([f, c]) => ({ f, n: c, share: c / Math.max(1, work) }));
  return { samples: total, busy: work, lifted, waits: Object.fromEntries(waits), spanMs: span,
    avgIntervalUs: dts.length ? dts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / dts.length : interval, self: top(self, 80), incl: top(incl, 80) };
}

// ---- Chrome trace of every process (Tracing domain on the browser target) ----
async function tracerFor(port) {
  const cdp = await Cdp.connect(port);
  const events = [];
  let done; const complete = new Promise(r => { done = r; });
  cdp.handlers.push(m => { if (m.method === 'Tracing.dataCollected') for (const e of m.params.value) events.push(e); else if (m.method === 'Tracing.tracingComplete') done(); });
  return {
    start: () => cdp.send('Tracing.start', { transferMode: 'ReportEvents', traceConfig: { recordMode: 'recordContinuously',
      includedCategories: o.traceCats.split(','), enableSampling: false } }),
    async stop() { await cdp.send('Tracing.end'); await complete; cdp.ws.close(); return events; },
  };
}
// self time per thread and event name: complete (X) and begin/end (B/E) slices nested by a stack per thread
function traceSummary(events, frames) {
  const tname = new Map(), pname = new Map(), per = new Map();
  for (const e of events) {
    if (e.ph !== 'M') continue;
    if (e.name === 'thread_name') tname.set(`${e.pid}:${e.tid}`, e.args.name);
    if (e.name === 'process_name') pname.set(e.pid, e.args.name);
  }
  const byThread = new Map();
  for (const e of events) if (e.ph === 'X' || e.ph === 'B' || e.ph === 'E') {
    const k = `${e.pid}:${e.tid}`; if (!byThread.has(k)) byThread.set(k, []); byThread.get(k).push(e);
  }
  let t0 = Infinity, t1 = -Infinity;
  for (const [k, evs] of byThread) {
    evs.sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts || (a.ph === 'E' ? -1 : 0) - (b.ph === 'E' ? -1 : 0) || (b.dur ?? 0) - (a.dur ?? 0));
    const self = new Map(), stack = [];
    // a slice ends at ts + dur (X) or at its E; an X slice is closed when a later event starts after its end
    const close = (until) => { while (stack.length && stack[stack.length - 1].end !== undefined && stack[stack.length - 1].end <= until) {
      const s = stack.pop(); self.set(s.name, (self.get(s.name) ?? 0) + (s.end - s.start) - s.kids); if (stack.length) stack[stack.length - 1].kids += s.end - s.start; } };
    for (const e of evs) {
      t0 = Math.min(t0, e.ts); t1 = Math.max(t1, e.ts + (e.dur ?? 0));
      close(e.ts);
      if (e.ph === 'X') stack.push({ name: e.name, start: e.ts, end: e.ts + (e.dur ?? 0), kids: 0 });
      else if (e.ph === 'B') stack.push({ name: e.name, start: e.ts, end: undefined, kids: 0 });
      else { for (let i = stack.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (stack[i].end === undefined) { stack[i].end = e.ts; break; } close(e.ts); }
    }
    close(Infinity);
    const tot = [...self.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    per.set(k, { name: `${pname.get(+k.split(':')[0]) ?? '?'}/${tname.get(k) ?? k}`, tot, self });
  }
  const span = (t1 - t0) / 1e3, out = [`trace: ${events.length} events over ${(span / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, ${frames} frames`];
  for (const t of [...per.values()].sort((a, b) => b.tot - a.tot).slice(0, 14)) {
    out.push('', `${t.name}: ${(t.tot / 1e3).toFixed(0)} ms in slices (${(t.tot / 1e3 / (frames || 1)).toFixed(3)} ms/frame)`);
    for (const [n, us] of [...t.self].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 16)) out.push(`  ${(us / 1e3 / (frames || 1)).toFixed(3).padStart(8)} ms/frame  ${(100 * us / t.tot).toFixed(1).padStart(5)} %  ${n}`);
  }
  return out.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// ---- per-thread CPU time of this run's Chrome processes ----
// macOS: web/tools/threadcpu.c (built on first use; Mach thread info and counters).  Windows:
// web/tools/threadcpu-win.ps1, one PowerShell server for the whole bench (thread times, cycle counts,
// Chrome's thread names; no instruction counts).  Elsewhere the CPU columns stay empty and the guest
// busy times still count.
const MAC = process.platform === 'darwin', WIN = process.platform === 'win32';
const TMP = MAC ? '/private/tmp/nsfu2-web-perf' : path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'nsfu2-web-perf');
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
const TCPU = path.join(TMP, 'threadcpu/threadcpu');
if (MAC && !fs.existsSync(TCPU)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(TCPU), { recursive: true }); execFileSync('clang', ['-O2', '-o', TCPU, path.join(ROOT, 'web/tools/threadcpu.c')]); }
let winCpu = null;
function winSnap(dir) {
  if (!winCpu) {
    // a copy on the local disk: PowerShell refuses unsigned scripts from a network path (\\wsl.localhost)
    const ps1 = path.join(TMP, 'threadcpu-win.ps1');
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'web/tools/threadcpu-win.ps1'), ps1);
    const proc = spawn('pwsh', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-File', ps1], { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'inherit'] });
    winCpu = { proc, waiters: [], lines: [], rest: '' };
    proc.stdout.setEncoding('utf8');
    proc.stdout.on('data', d => {
      const parts = (winCpu.rest + d).split('\n'); winCpu.rest = parts.pop();
      for (const l of parts.map(s => s.trim())) {
        if (!l.startsWith('END ')) { if (l) winCpu.lines.push(l); continue; }
        const lines = winCpu.lines; winCpu.lines = [];
        winCpu.waiters.shift()?.({ lines, t: +l.slice(4) });
      }
    });
    proc.on('error', e => { console.error(`threadcpu-win: ${e}`); for (const w of winCpu.waiters.splice(0)) w(null); });
    proc.unref(); proc.stdout.unref?.();
  }
  return new Promise(res => { winCpu.waiters.push(res); winCpu.proc.stdin.write(`snap ${dir}\n`); });
}
/** every thread of the run's Chrome processes: { m: Map, t: epoch ms of the snapshot }, or null */
async function threadCpu(dir) {
  if (WIN) {
    const s = await winSnap(dir);
    if (!s || !s.lines.length) return null;
    const m = new Map();
    for (const l of s.lines) {
      const [pid, id, ns, name, type, cns] = l.split(' ');
      // the cycle count is exact; the thread times only advance on clock ticks
      m.set(`${pid}:${id}`, { pid: +pid, type, name, ns: +cns || +ns, pi: NaN, pc: NaN, pn: NaN, ei: NaN, ec: NaN, en: NaN });
    }
    return { m, t: s.t };
  }
  if (!MAC) return null;
  const m = threadCpuMac(dir);
  return m ? { m, t: Date.now() } : null;
}
function threadCpuMac(dir) {
  const ps = execFileSync('ps', ['-axo', 'pid=,ppid=,command='], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 }).split('\n')
    .map(l => /^\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(.*)$/.exec(l)).filter(Boolean).map(m => ({ pid: +m[1], ppid: +m[2], cmd: m[3] }));
  const br = ps.find(p => p.cmd.includes(`--user-data-dir=${dir}`) && !p.cmd.includes('--type='));
  if (!br) return null;
  const pids = ps.filter(p => p.ppid === br.pid && /--type=(renderer|gpu-process)/.test(p.cmd)).map(p => ({ pid: p.pid, type: /--type=([\w-]+)/.exec(p.cmd)[1] }));
  const out = execFileSync(TCPU, pids.map(p => String(p.pid)), { encoding: 'utf8' });
  const m = new Map();
  for (const l of out.trim().split('\n')) {
    const [pid, id, ns, name, pi, pc, pn, ei, ec, en] = l.split(' ');
    m.set(`${pid}:${id}`, { pid: +pid, type: pids.find(p => p.pid === +pid)?.type, name, ns: +ns, pi: +pi, pc: +pc, pn: +pn, ei: +ei, ec: +ec, en: +en });
  }
  return m;
}
function cpuDelta(a, b, frames, wallMs) {
  const th = [];
  for (const [k, v] of b) {
    const z = a.get(k) ?? { ns: 0, pi: 0, pc: 0, pn: 0, ei: 0, ec: 0, en: 0 }, ns = v.ns - z.ns;
    if (ns > 0) th.push({ ...v, ms: ns / 1e6, dpi: v.pi - z.pi, dpc: v.pc - z.pc, dpn: v.pn - z.pn, dei: v.ei - z.ei, dec: v.ec - z.ec, den: v.en - z.en });
  }
  th.sort((x, y) => y.ms - x.ms);
  const sum = f => th.filter(f).reduce((s, t) => s + t.ms, 0);
  const main = th.find(t => t.type === 'renderer' && /Worker/i.test(t.name) && !/ThreadPool/.test(t.name)) ?? th[0];
  const per = x => frames ? x / frames : NaN;
  return { frames, wallMs, mainMs: main?.ms, mainName: main?.name, mainPerFrame: frames ? main.ms / frames : NaN, mainUtil: main ? main.ms / wallMs : NaN,
    // instructions retired per frame (P + E cores; less load-dependent than time, not independent of it), P-core cycles per frame,
    // the share of the thread's CPU time spent on E cores, and the P-core clock (cycles / P time)
    minsPerFrame: main ? per(main.dpi + main.dei) / 1e6 : NaN, mcycPPerFrame: main ? per(main.dpc) / 1e6 : NaN,
    eShare: main && main.dpn + main.den ? main.den / (main.dpn + main.den) : NaN, pGHz: main && main.dpn ? main.dpc / main.dpn : NaN,
    ipcP: main && main.dpc ? main.dpi / main.dpc : NaN,
    rendererMs: sum(t => t.type === 'renderer'), poolMs: sum(t => t.type === 'renderer' && /ThreadPool/.test(t.name)),
    pageMs: sum(t => t.name === 'CrRendererMain'), gpuProcMs: sum(t => t.type === 'gpu-process'),
    top: th.slice(0, 12).map(t => `${t.type}/${t.name} ${t.ms.toFixed(0)}`) };
}

// ---- one run ----
async function runOnce(fps, label, timed, wasm = variants[0].url) {
  const url = urlFor(fps, wasm);
  const port = 9500 + (process.pid % 400);
  const args = ['--enable-unsafe-webgpu', ...(o.jsFlags ? [`--js-flags=${o.jsFlags}`] : []), ...o.chromeArgs,
    ...((o.cpuprofile || o.trace) && timed ? [`--remote-debugging-port=${port}`] : [])];
  // always a persistent context with a known directory: it finds this run's Chrome processes for the
  // per-thread CPU times (a fresh, deleted directory unless --profile keeps one)
  const dir = o.profile || fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(TMP, 'chprof-'));
  const ctx = await chromium.launchPersistentContext(dir, { ...pickBrowser(), headless: !o.headed, args, viewport: null });
  const page = ctx.pages()[0] ?? await ctx.newPage();
  if (o.throttle > 1) await (await ctx.newCDPSession(page)).send('Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate', { rate: o.throttle });
  const browser = { close: async () => { await ctx.close(); if (!o.profile) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } };
  const lines = [], loads = [];
  let cpu0 = null, cpu1 = null, f0 = 0, f1 = 0, tw0 = 0, tw1 = 0, cpuE = null, twE = 0, mark0 = null, mark1 = null, mt0 = 0, mt1 = 0;
  const up0 = uptime(), t0 = Date.now();
  const lt = setInterval(() => loads.push(load1()), 5000); loads.push(load1());
  let prof = null, profStarted = null, profStop = null, traceDone = null, traceF0 = 0, traceF1 = 0;
  let raceAt = 0;
  const onLine = async t => {
    // the CPU window: cpu_begin .. cpu_end when the script has them (a fixed stretch of race time)
    // (snapshots are asynchronous on Windows: each keeps the time it was taken)
    if (timed && t.includes(' LOG cpu_begin')) { const s = await threadCpu(dir); if (s) { mark0 = s.m; mt0 = s.t; } }
    if (timed && t.includes(' LOG cpu_end') && mark0 && !mark1) { const s = await threadCpu(dir); if (s) { mark1 = s.m; mt1 = s.t; } }
    if (timed && t.includes(' LOG race_loaded')) {
      const f = +(/ f=(\d+) /.exec(t)?.[1] ?? 0);
      if (o.cpuFrom) { const s = await threadCpu(dir); if (s) { cpuE = s.m; twE = s.t; } }      // the early window: race_loaded .. +cpuFrom
      setTimeout(async () => { const s = await threadCpu(dir); if (s) { cpu0 = s.m; tw0 = s.t; f0 = o.cpuFrom ? 0 : f; } }, o.cpuFrom * 1000);
    }
    if (timed && t.includes(' LOG drive_end') && cpu0 && !cpu1) { const f = o.cpuFrom ? 0 : +(/ f=(\d+) /.exec(t)?.[1] ?? 0), s = await threadCpu(dir); if (s) { cpu1 = s.m; tw1 = s.t; f1 = f; } }
    if (o.trace && timed && t.includes(' LOG race_loaded')) setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const tr = await tracerFor(port); await tr.start(); traceF0 = Date.now(); lines.push(`[bench] trace started`);
        traceDone = new Promise(r => setTimeout(async () => { traceF1 = Date.now(); r(await tr.stop()); }, o.trace * 1000));
      } catch (e) { lines.push(`[bench] trace failed: ${e}`); }
    }, o.profFrom * 1000);
    if (!o.cpuprofile || !timed) return;
    if (t.includes(' LOG race_loaded')) {
      raceAt = Date.now();
      setTimeout(async () => { try { prof = await profilerFor(port); const n = await prof.start(); profStarted = Date.now(); lines.push(`[bench] profiler started on ${n} workers`); } catch (e) { lines.push(`[bench] profiler failed: ${e}`); } }, o.profFrom * 1000);
    }
    if (t.includes(' LOG drive_end') && prof && !profStop) profStop = prof.stop();
  };
  page.on('console', m => { const t = m.text(); lines.push(t); onLine(t); });
  page.on('pageerror', e => lines.push(`PAGEERROR ${e}`));
  page.on('crash', () => lines.push('CRASH (renderer process)'));
  await page.goto(url);
  let timedOut = false;
  try { await page.waitForFunction(() => document.title === 'DONE', null, { timeout: o.timeout * 1000, polling: 1000 }); }
  catch { timedOut = true; lines.push('[bench] TIMEOUT'); }
  const profiles = profStop ? await profStop : [];
  const traceEvents = traceDone ? await traceDone : null;
  clearInterval(lt); loads.push(load1());
  const wall = (Date.now() - t0) / 1000, up1 = uptime();
  await browser.close();
  const log = lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  if (!timed) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}.log`), log); return null; }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}.log`), log);
  const r = parse(log);
  // frames in the CPU window: the autotest frame numbers, or (--cpu-from) the racing frames presented between the
  // two snapshots (gcpu.c's epoch-ms Present times; the snapshots take a few ms, which bounds the error)
  if (cpu0 && cpu1 && o.cpuFrom) { const t00 = +(/\[gcpuf0\] ([\d.]+)/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN); f1 = r.frameT.filter(x => t00 + x >= tw0 && t00 + x < tw1).length; }
  if (mark0 && mark1) {
    const t00 = +(/\[gcpuf0\] ([\d.]+)/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN);
    r.cpu = cpuDelta(mark0, mark1, r.frameT.filter(x => t00 + x >= mt0 && t00 + x < mt1).length, mt1 - mt0); r.cpu.window = 'cpu_begin..cpu_end';
  } else if (cpu0 && cpu1) r.cpu = cpuDelta(cpu0, cpu1, f1 - f0, tw1 - tw0);
  if (cpuE && cpu0) { const t00 = +(/\[gcpuf0\] ([\d.]+)/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN);
    r.cpuEarly = cpuDelta(cpuE, cpu0, r.frameT.filter(x => t00 + x >= twE && t00 + x < tw0).length, tw0 - twE); }
  const ld = loads.filter(x => !Number.isNaN(x));
  Object.assign(r, { label, fps, wall, timedOut, load: { min: Math.min(...ld), mean: ld.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / ld.length, max: Math.max(...ld) }, uptimeBefore: up0, uptimeAfter: up1 });
  if (profiles.length) {
    const an = profiles.map(p => ({ title: p.title, ...analyse(p.profile, o.interval) })).sort((a, b) => b.lifted - a.lifted);
    r.profile = { from: o.profFrom, workers: an.map(a => ({ title: a.title, busy: a.busy, samples: a.samples, spanMs: a.spanMs })), main: an[0] };
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}.cpuprofile`), JSON.stringify(profiles.find(p => p.title === an[0].title).profile));
    const pg = profiles.find(p => p.title === 'page');
    if (pg) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}-page.cpuprofile`), JSON.stringify(pg.profile));
    const txt = [`main guest worker ${an[0].title}: ${an[0].busy} working of ${an[0].samples} samples over ${(an[0].spanMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s (interval ${an[0].avgIntervalUs.toFixed(0)} us); waiting: ${JSON.stringify(an[0].waits)}`,
      '', 'self:', ...an[0].self.map(x => `  ${(100 * x.share).toFixed(2).padStart(6)} %  ${x.f}`),
      '', 'inclusive:', ...an[0].incl.map(x => `  ${(100 * x.share).toFixed(2).padStart(6)} %  ${x.f}`),
      '', 'other workers:', ...an.slice(1).filter(a => a.busy).map(a => `  ${a.title}: ${a.busy} busy samples; top self ${a.self.slice(0, 5).map(x => `${x.f} ${(100 * x.share).toFixed(1)}%`).join(', ')}`)];
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}-prof.txt`), txt.join('\n') + '\n');
  }
  if (traceEvents) {
    const t00 = +(/\[gcpuf0\] ([\d.]+)/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN), fr = r.frameT.filter(x => t00 + x >= traceF0 && t00 + x < traceF1).length;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}.trace.json`), JSON.stringify({ traceEvents }));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}-trace.txt`), traceSummary(traceEvents, fr));
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${label}.json`), JSON.stringify(r, null, 1));
  return r;
}

function parse(log) {
  const r = { exit: null, race: null, early: null, warm: null, hfr: null, late: null, renderer: null, gpuFinal: null };
  const ex = /^EXIT (-?\d+)$/m.exec(log); if (ex) r.exit = +ex[1];
  const busy = [], t = [];
  for (const m of log.matchAll(/\[gcpuf\] (\S+)/g)) for (const e of m[1].split(';')) { const [b, tt] = e.split('@'); busy.push(+b / 1000); t.push(+tt); }
  r.race = dist(busy); Object.defineProperty(r, 'frameT', { value: t, enumerable: false });
  const EARLY = 15000;
  r.early = dist(busy.filter((_, i) => t[i] < EARLY)); r.warm = dist(busy.filter((_, i) => t[i] >= EARLY));
  const h = /\[hfr\] race wall=([\d.]+)s fps=([\d.]+) slots\/f=([\d.]+) miss=(\d+).* work=([\d.]+)ms\/f sleep=([\d.]+)ms\/f/.exec(log);
  if (h) r.hfr = { wall: +h[1], fps: +h[2], slotsPerFrame: +h[3], missed: +h[4], workMs: +h[5], sleepMs: +h[6] };
  const rate = /content rate (\d+)/.exec(log); const hz = rate ? +rate[1] : 0;
  if (hz > 0 && t.length) {    // present intervals in the warm drive (after the intro NIS and the first 15 s)
    const per = 1000 / hz; let n = 0, late = 0, lost = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < t.length; i++) if (t[i - 1] >= EARLY) { const d = t[i] - t[i - 1]; n++; if (d > 1.5 * per) { late++; lost += Math.round(d / per) - 1; } }
    r.late = { intervals: n, late, lostSlots: lost, periodMs: per };
  }
  const b = /\[bench\] renderer (\{.*\})/.exec(log); if (b) r.renderer = JSON.parse(b[1]);
  const g = /\[gpu\] final: (\{.*\})/.exec(log); if (g) { const s = JSON.parse(g[1]); r.gpuFinal = { encodeMsAvg: s.encodeMsAvg, gpuMsAvg: s.gpuMsAvg, errors: s.errors, frames: s.frames }; }
  r.compileMs = +(/compiled in (\d+) ms/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN);
  r.raceLoadedMs = +(/w=([\d.]+)ms LOG race_loaded/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN);
  r.loadMs = +(/\[bench\] race load (\d+) ms/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? NaN);
  return r;
}

// The browser the web tools and tests drive: Google Chrome when it is installed (Playwright's channel 'chrome', as
// they always did), else Playwright's own Chromium (npx playwright install chromium; a headless run takes its
// headless shell).  NFSU2_BROWSER=chrome or chromium forces either.  The first pick says on stderr which one it took.
//   chromium.launch({ ...pickBrowser(), headless: true, args })
//   chromium.launchPersistentContext(dir, { ...pickBrowser(), headless: true, args })
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

/** Google Chrome's executable where Playwright's channel 'chrome' looks for it (playwright-core's registry), or null */
export function chromeExe() {
  const at = { linux: '/opt/google/chrome/chrome', darwin: '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome',
    win32: '\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe' }[process.platform];
  if (!at) return null;
  const e = process.env;
  const prefixes = process.platform !== 'win32' ? [''] : [e.LOCALAPPDATA, e.PROGRAMFILES, e['PROGRAMFILES(X86)'],
    e.HOMEDRIVE && `${e.HOMEDRIVE}\\Program Files`, e.HOMEDRIVE && `${e.HOMEDRIVE}\\Program Files (x86)`].filter(Boolean);
  for (const p of prefixes) {
    const exe = path.join(p, at);
    try { fs.accessSync(exe); return exe; } catch { /* not there */ }
  }
  return null;
}

let picked = null;
/** the launch option that picks the browser: { channel: 'chrome' } for Google Chrome, {} for Playwright's Chromium;
 *  the same for every launch of the process */
export function pickBrowser() {
  if (!picked) {
    const force = (process.env.NFSU2_BROWSER || '').toLowerCase();
    if (force && force !== 'chrome' && force !== 'chromium') throw new Error(`NFSU2_BROWSER=${force}: chrome or chromium`);
    const exe = force === 'chromium' ? null : chromeExe();
    picked = force === 'chrome' || exe ? { channel: 'chrome' } : {};
    console.error(picked.channel ? `browser: Google Chrome (${exe || 'not found where Playwright looks'}${force ? ', NFSU2_BROWSER=chrome' : ''})`
      : `browser: Playwright's Chromium (${force ? 'NFSU2_BROWSER=chromium' : 'no Google Chrome installed'})`);
  }
  return { ...picked };
}

// Checks that the TypeScript mirrors of the shared-memory layouts carry the
// same numbers as their C headers: every name defined on both sides must
// have the same value, and every C name must exist in TypeScript.
//   node web/tools/check-proto.mjs        (exit 1 on a mismatch)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');

// C: #define NAME <number> and enum members (explicit or implicit values)
function cNames(file, prefixes) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), 'utf8').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '');
  const out = new Map();
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/^#define\s+([A-Z_0-9]+)\s+(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)u?\b/gm)) out.set(m[1], Number(m[2]));
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/enum\s*\{([^}]*)\}/g)) {
    let next = 0;
    for (const item of m[1].split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)) {
      const [name, val] = item.split('=').map(s => s.trim());
      const v = val === undefined ? next : Number(val.replace(/u$/, ''));
      out.set(name, v); next = v + 1;
    }
  }
  return new Map([...out].filter(([k]) => prefixes.some(p => k.startsWith(p))));
}
// TS: export const NAME = <number>[, NAME = <number>]...
function tsNames(file) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), 'utf8').replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '');
  const out = new Map();
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/export const ([^;]+);/g))
    for (const d of m[1].split(',')) { const r = /^\s*([A-Z_0-9]+)\s*=\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*$/.exec(d); if (r) out.set(r[1], Number(r[2])); }
  return out;
}
const pairs = [
  ['runtime/web/audio_proto.h', 'web/src/audio/proto.ts', ['AR_', 'AUDIO_']],
  ['runtime/web/input_proto.h', 'web/src/input/proto.ts', ['IM_', 'IEV_', 'IKF_', 'INAME_', 'IREASON_', 'ISYN_', 'INPUT_']],
  ['runtime/kbd.h', 'web/src/input/proto.ts', ['KSYN_']],
  ['runtime/gamepad.h', 'web/src/input/proto.ts', ['PAD_', 'PADF_']],
  ['runtime/web/host_abi.h', 'web/src/host/abi.ts', []],
];
let bad = 0, checked = 0;
for (const [c, t, pre] of pairs) {
  if (!pre.length) continue;
  const cn = cNames(c, pre), tn = tsNames(t);
  for (const [k, v] of cn) {
    if (k === 'PAD_NBUTTONS' || k === 'PAD_NAXES') continue;
    checked++;
    if (!tn.has(k)) { console.log(`MISSING in ${t}: ${k} = ${v} (${c})`); bad++; }
    else if (tn.get(k) !== v) { console.log(`MISMATCH ${k}: ${c} ${v}, ${t} ${tn.get(k)}`); bad++; }
  }
}
console.log(bad ? `check-proto: ${bad} problem(s) in ${checked} names` : `check-proto: OK, ${checked} names agree`);
process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);

// The child processes of a test tool (its own server, roam-crowd, a Chrome it started itself) go when the tool ends,
// however it ends: at the end, on an error, on Ctrl-C.  A server left running holds its ports, and the next run's own
// server then fails with "server exited".
//   const c = own(spawn(...));   ...   await stop(c);
const live = new Set();

/** c goes with this process */
export function own(c) {
  live.add(c);
  c.once('exit', () => live.delete(c));
  return c;
}

/** whether c has ended: its 'exit' came already, and is not sent again (waiting for it would wait for ever) */
export const ended = c => c.exitCode !== null || c.signalCode !== null;

/** stop c and wait until it has gone (SIGKILL after 10 s); at once when it ended already */
export async function stop(c, signal = 'SIGTERM') {
  if (!c || ended(c)) return;
  const gone = new Promise(r => c.once('exit', r));
  c.kill(signal);
  const t = setTimeout(() => { if (!ended(c)) c.kill('SIGKILL'); }, 10_000);
  await gone;
  clearTimeout(t);
}

const killAll = () => { for (const c of live) { try { c.kill('SIGTERM'); } catch {} } };
process.on('exit', killAll);
for (const [sig, n] of [['SIGINT', 2], ['SIGTERM', 15], ['SIGHUP', 1]]) process.on(sig, () => { killAll(); process.exit(128 + n); });

async function startServer(args) {
  const state = path.join(OUT, `state-${args.includes('--behind-proxy') ? 'proxy' : 'tls'}`);
  const c = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--state', state, '--access-log', ...args], SERVER || undefined),
    { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: SERVER ? { ...process.env, NFSU2_REPO: path.dirname(SERVER) } : process.env });
  const log = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(OUT, `server-${args.includes('--behind-proxy') ? 'proxy' : 'tls'}.log`));
  c.stdout.pipe(log); c.stderr.pipe(log);
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start')), 60000);
    c.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    c.on('exit', code => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error(`server exited (${code}): ${out}`)); });
  });
  return { stop: () => new Promise(r => { c.once('exit', r); c.kill('SIGTERM'); }) };
}

// the shipped stack, but Caddy serves the test certificate on 127.0.0.1:<port> only, without its http -> https

async function startDocker() {

      	default_bind 127.0.0.1
      	https_port ${P1}
      	auto_https disable_redirects

      	tls /certs/${path.basename(certs.cert)} /certs/${path.basename(certs.key)}
      	reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:${P2}
      	header -Server
      }
`);
  const env = { ...process.env, NFSU2_HOST: 'nfsu2.test', NFSU2_DATA: DATA, NFSU2_MODULE: MODULE, NFSU2_IMAGE: IMAGE, NFSU2_HTTP_PORT: String(P2) };

  compose('up', '-d', '--wait', '--wait-timeout', '120');

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'server-docker.log'), compose('logs', '--no-color', 'server', 'caddy'));

    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, `${mode}-failure.png`) }).catch(() => {});

// The test tools load the test pages (/test/) and the repo's test scripts
// (/tests/), which the server serves only when started with --dev:
//   out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-server --data "<game folder>" --http-port <http> --dev [--artifacts <dir>]
// requireDev(base) stops a tool early, with that hint, when the server at base
// answers without them.  (A server it cannot reach, or one behind a
// certificate node does not trust, is left to the browser to report.)
export async function requireDev(base) {
  let r;
  try { r = await fetch(new URL('/test/hostcheck.html', base), { method: 'HEAD' }); } catch { return; }
  if (r.status === 404) {
    console.error(`${base} does not serve the test pages: start the server with --dev ` +
      '(out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-server --data "<game folder>" --http-port <http> --dev)');
    process.exit(2);
  }
}

/** The module the server at base sends, in one line for a run's output (a
 *  result counts only for the module that made it): its revision and lift
 *  options (/game.json, web/build.sh's nfsu2.json) and its hash, which the
 *  server adds for /game.wasm?v=.  null when there is no json to read. */
export async function moduleLine(base) {
  let j;
  try { j = await (await fetch(new URL('/game.json', base))).json(); } catch { return null; }
  if (!j || typeof j !== 'object') return null;
  return `module: rev ${j.rev ?? '?'}, lift ${j.lift || '-'}, hash ${j.module ?? '?'}`;
}

// Drives a page with trusted input (Playwright keyboard, mouse, a fake
// gamepad) while it runs, synchronised on its console output, and waits for
// document.title === 'DONE' like run-page.mjs.
//
//   node web/tools/drive.mjs <url> <timeout-ms> <steps.json> [--profile DIR] [--headed]
//        [--done "<js expression>"] [--shots DIR] [--size WxH|window] [--cdp http://localhost:9341]
//
// --done: the run is over when this is true in the page (default document.title
// === 'DONE'); the app's start page: "window.__nfsu2?.phase === 'exited'".
//
// steps.json: an array of steps, run in order:
//   {"wait": "regex", "timeout": ms}          until a console line matches
//   {"press": "Enter", "until": "regex", "every": ms, "timeout": ms}
//                                             press (repeatedly with until)
//   {"down": "KeyW"} / {"up": "KeyW"}         keyboard.down / up (KeyboardEvent.code names)
//   {"sleep": ms}
//   {"mouse": [x, y]} / {"click": [x, y]} / {"wheel": dy}   page coordinates
//   {"pad": {"buttons": {"0": 1, "7": 0.8}, "axes": [lx, ly, rx, ry], "id": "..."}}
//                                             the fake standard gamepad's state
//                                             (buttons not named keep their value)
//   {"padtap": 0, "until": "regex", "every": ms, "timeout": ms}  press and release button i
//   {"padinit": {"id": "...", "mapping": "", "axes": [...], "buttons": n}}
//                                             the fake pad from the start: its Gamepad.id (default Xbox),
//                                             mapping (default "standard"; "" a wheel's), axes at rest and
//                                             number of buttons (a wheel: "pad" steps then give all its axes)
//   {"eval": "js expression"}                 page.evaluate, the result is logged
//   {"waitfor": "js expression", "timeout": ms}   until it is true in the page
//   {"clicksel": "#play"}                      a trusted click on that element
//   {"screenshot": "name.png"}                 the page as the person sees it, into --shots
//   {"activate": true}                         bring the Chrome of --os-pid to the front (macOS)
//   {"oskey": "Escape", "hold": ms}            a real macOS key event (CGEventPost: through the browser's
//                                             own key handling, unlike Playwright's), sent only while the
//                                             frontmost app is the process --os-pid (the Chrome under test,
//                                             never another one); needs the Accessibility permission

import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { pickBrowser } from './browser.mjs';
import fs from 'node:fs';

const [url, tmo, stepsFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
const timeout = +(tmo || 60000), headed = process.argv.includes('--headed');
const opt = (n) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(n); return i > 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : null; };

  : await (await chromium.launch({ ...pickBrowser(), headless: !headed, args })).newContext({ viewport, bypassCSP: true });   // string waitForFunction needs eval; the server's CSP forbids it

    mapping: spec.mapping, timestamp: 0, axes: spec.axes.slice(), vibrationActuator: null,
    buttons: Array.from({ length: spec.buttons }, () => ({ pressed: false, touched: false, value: 0 })) };

  window.__setPad = (s) => {
    if (s.id) pad.id = s.id;
    for (const [i, v] of Object.entries(s.buttons ?? {})) pad.buttons[+i] = { pressed: v > 0.5, touched: v > 0, value: v };

  const t = m.text(); console.log(t); lines.push(t);
  waiters = waiters.filter(w => { if (w.re.test(t)) { w.res(t); return false; } return true; });

  const w = { re, res }; waiters.push(w);
  setTimeout(() => { waiters = waiters.filter(x => x !== w); rej(new Error(`no line /${re.source}/ within ${ms} ms`)); }, ms);
});

// with eval inside the page, which the player's page forbids (CSP script-src without
// 'unsafe-eval', web/server-rs/crates/headers); a function goes over DevTools instead
const predicate = expr => new Function(`return (${expr});`);
const seen = (re, from) => lines.slice(from).some(l => re.test(l));

  for (const s of steps) {

      if (s.log) console.log(`[drive] ${s.log}`);
      if (s.wait) { await waitLine(new RegExp(s.wait), s.timeout ?? timeout); console.log(`[drive] seen /${s.wait}/`); }
      if (s.sleep) await sleep(s.sleep);
      if (s.down) await page.keyboard.down(s.down);
      if (s.up) await page.keyboard.up(s.up);
      if (s.mouse) await page.mouse.move(s.mouse[0], s.mouse[1]);
      if (s.click) await page.mouse.click(s.click[0], s.click[1]);
      if (s.wheel) await page.mouse.wheel(0, s.wheel);
      if (s.pad) await page.evaluate(st => window.__setPad(st), s.pad);
      if (s.eval) console.log(`[drive] eval ${s.eval} -> ${JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(s.eval))}`);
      if (s.waitfor) { await page.waitForFunction(predicate(s.waitfor), null, { timeout: s.timeout ?? timeout, polling: 100 }); console.log(`[drive] true: ${s.waitfor}`); }
      if (s.clicksel) { await page.click(s.clicksel); console.log(`[drive] clicked ${s.clicksel}`); }
      if (s.activate) {
        if (!osPid) throw new Error('activate needs --os-pid');
        const { execFileSync } = await import('node:child_process');
        execFileSync('osascript', ['-l', 'JavaScript', '-e', `ObjC.import('AppKit'); $.NSRunningApplication.runningApplicationWithProcessIdentifier(${+osPid}).activateWithOptions($.NSApplicationActivateAllWindows)`]);
        await sleep(500);
      }
      if (s.oskey) {
        const { execFileSync } = await import('node:child_process');
        const front = /pid = (\d+)/.exec(execFileSync('sh', ['-c', 'lsappinfo info -only pid "$(lsappinfo front)"'], { encoding: 'utf8' }))?.[1];
        if (!osPid || front !== String(osPid)) throw new Error(`not sending a real key: the frontmost process is ${front}, not the Chrome under test (--os-pid ${osPid})`);
        const code = { Escape: 53, Enter: 36, Space: 49 }[s.oskey];
        execFileSync('osascript', ['-l', 'JavaScript', '-e', `ObjC.import('ApplicationServices');
          $.CGEventPost($.kCGHIDEventTap, $.CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(null, ${code}, true)); delay(${(s.hold ?? 80) / 1000});
          $.CGEventPost($.kCGHIDEventTap, $.CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(null, ${code}, false));`]);
        console.log(`[drive] real key ${s.oskey} held ${s.hold ?? 80} ms`);
      }
      if (s.screenshot) { fs.mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true }); await page.screenshot({ path: `${shots}/${s.screenshot}` }); console.log(`[drive] screenshot ${shots}/${s.screenshot}`); }
      if (s.press || s.padtap !== undefined) {
        const re = s.until ? new RegExp(s.until) : null, t0 = Date.now(), from = lines.length;
        for (let n = 0; ; n++) {
          if (s.press) await page.keyboard.press(s.press, { delay: 50 });
          else { await page.evaluate(i => window.__setPad({ buttons: { [i]: 1 } }), s.padtap); await sleep(80);
                 await page.evaluate(i => window.__setPad({ buttons: { [i]: 0 } }), s.padtap); }
          if (!re) break;
          const end = Date.now() + (s.every ?? 1500);
          while (Date.now() < end && !seen(re, from)) await sleep(50);
          if (seen(re, from)) { console.log(`[drive] ${s.press ?? 'pad ' + s.padtap} x${n + 1} until /${s.until}/: seen`); break; }
          if (Date.now() - t0 > (s.timeout ?? 30000)) throw new Error(`/${s.until}/ not seen pressing ${s.press ?? s.padtap}`);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { console.log(`[drive] FAILED at ${JSON.stringify(s)}: ${e.message}`); failed = true; break; }
  }
  console.log(`[drive] steps ${failed ? 'FAILED' : 'done'}`);
})();
const ok = await done;
if (!ok) console.log('TIMEOUT');
// steps after the end (a last screenshot or eval) still run, briefly
else await Promise.race([stepsDone, sleep(15000)]);
await ctx.close();
process.exit(ok && !failed ? 0 : 1);

#!/bin/bash
# The lifts made on this machine, kept by what they were made from, so that the same lift is made once:
# ~/.cache/nsfu2-web/gen/<key>/{all,server}, key = a hash of tools/genstamp.sh's source lines (override list, hook
# list, lifter).  Only web/gen.sh's default lift (no WEB_LIFT, JTSWITCH, LREGS, FTOL2INL or INLINE_LIST set) is
# kept; the newest 12 stay.  The kept lifts are never written to again: build against them through links.
#
#   web/tools/gencache.sh link          gen/all and gen/server are links (a worktree's): point them at the kept lift
#                                       for this checkout's sources, if there is one and they show another
#                                       (web/build.sh runs this first)
#   web/tools/gencache.sh get <exe>     gen/all and gen/server are folders: copy the kept lift for this checkout
#                                       into them, exit 1 when there is none (web/gen.sh runs this first)
#   web/tools/gencache.sh put <exe>     keep gen/all and gen/server (web/gen.sh runs this when it has finished)
#   web/tools/gencache.sh add <dir>     keep <dir>/all and <dir>/server, a finished default lift made elsewhere
#   web/tools/gencache.sh key|dir       this checkout's key, the kept lifts' folder
set -e -o pipefail
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"; cd "$ROOT"
CACHE="$HOME/.cache/nsfu2-web/gen"
DEFAULT_LIFT="FLAGABI X87OPT JTSWITCH LREGS FTOL2INL INLINE_LIST"
WANT="$(tools/genstamp.sh sources)"
KEY="$(printf '%s\n' "$WANT" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16)"
sha(){ shasum -a 256 < "$1" | cut -c1-16; }
# <dir>/all and <dir>/server: a finished lift of these sources (any options), both from one run
current(){ [ -f "$1/all/fntab.c" ] && [ -f "$1/server/fntab.c" ] &&
           [ "$(grep -E '^(overrides|hooks|lifter) ' "$1/all/stamp.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$WANT" ] &&
           cmp -s "$1/all/stamp.txt" "$1/server/stamp.txt"; }
# ... and web/gen.sh's default one
fits(){ current "$1" && [ "$(cat "$1/all/web-lift.txt" 2>/dev/null)" = "$DEFAULT_LIFT" ]; }
kept(){ [ -f "$CACHE/$KEY/done" ] && fits "$CACHE/$KEY"; }
keep(){   # $1: folder with all/ and server/ (a finished default lift of any sources), $2: the exe's hash (or empty)
  local lines k t
  lines="$(grep -E '^(overrides|hooks|lifter) ' "$1/all/stamp.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | grep -c .)" = 3 ] && [ -f "$1/all/fntab.c" ] && [ -f "$1/server/fntab.c" ] &&
    [ "$(cat "$1/all/web-lift.txt" 2>/dev/null)" = "$DEFAULT_LIFT" ] && cmp -s "$1/all/stamp.txt" "$1/server/stamp.txt" ||
    { echo "gencache: $1 is not a finished default lift: not kept"; return 0; }
  k="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16)"
  [ ! -f "$CACHE/$k/done" ] || return 0
  mkdir -p "$CACHE"; t="$(mktemp -d "$CACHE/.new-XXXXXX")"
  cp -R "$1/all" "$t/all"; cp -R "$1/server" "$t/server"
  [ -z "$2" ] || echo "$2" > "$t/exe.sha"
  touch "$t/done"
  if [ -e "$CACHE/$k" ]; then rm -rf "$t"; else mv "$t" "$CACHE/$k"; echo "gencache: kept as $CACHE/$k"; fi
  ls -1dt "$CACHE"/*/ | tail -n +13 | while read -r d; do rm -rf "$d"; done
  find "$CACHE" -maxdepth 1 -name '.new-*' -mmin +120 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
}
case "${1:-}" in
  key) echo "$KEY" ;;
  dir) echo "$CACHE" ;;
  link)
    for d in gen/all gen/server; do [ -L "$d" ] || [ ! -e "$d" ] || exit 0; done   # a folder: the checkout's own lift
    current gen && exit 0
    kept || exit 0
    mkdir -p gen
    ln -sfn "$CACHE/$KEY/all" gen/all; ln -sfn "$CACHE/$KEY/server" gen/server
    touch "$CACHE/$KEY"
    echo "gen/all, gen/server -> $CACHE/$KEY (a lift of these sources made before)" ;;
  get)
    EXE="${2:?usage: gencache.sh get <exe>}"
    kept || exit 1
    [ ! -f "$CACHE/$KEY/exe.sha" ] || [ "$(cat "$CACHE/$KEY/exe.sha")" = "$(sha "$EXE")" ] || exit 1
    mkdir -p gen
    for d in all server; do rm -rf "gen/$d"; cp -R "$CACHE/$KEY/$d" "gen/$d"; done
    touch "$CACHE/$KEY"
    echo "gen/all, gen/server: copied from $CACHE/$KEY (a lift of these sources made before)" ;;
  put) keep gen "$(sha "${2:?usage: gencache.sh put <exe>}")" ;;
  add) keep "${2:?usage: gencache.sh add <dir>}" "" ;;
  *) sed -n '2,15p' "$0"; exit 2 ;;
esac

// The start page's English texts, as the page looks them up in a language's file (web/src/app/i18n.ts):
//   node web/tools/i18n-keys.mjs              every text, with where it is and its plural's one form (JSON)
//   node web/tools/i18n-keys.mjs <language>   the texts web/src/app/lang/<language>.json does not have yet
// From the sources: the first argument of t(), T(), N() and tvars() and the last two of tn() when they are string
// literals, and the markup index.html marks (data-i18n: its text, data-i18n-html: its text with <0>…</0> for the
// elements in it, data-i18n-attr: the attributes named).  web/test/i18n.test.mjs checks every language's file with it.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const WEB = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

/** a JS string literal at s[i] (a quote): [its value, the index after it] */
function literal(s, i) {
  const q = s[i];
  let out = '', j = i + 1;
  for (; j < s.length && s[j] !== q; j++) {
    if (s[j] !== '\\') { out += s[j]; continue; }
    const c = s[++j];
    out += c === 'n' ? '\n' : c === 't' ? '\t' : c === 'u' ? String.fromCharCode(parseInt(s.slice(j + 1, (j += 4) + 1), 16)) : c;
  }
  return [out, j + 1];
}
const space = (s, i) => { while (/\s/.test(s[i])) i++; return i; };

/** the texts of one TypeScript source: [{ key, one?, plural }]; bad: calls whose text is not a plain literal */
export function sourceKeys(src) {
  const out = [], bad = [];
  const re = /\b(t|T|N|tvars|tn)\(/g;
  for (let m; (m = re.exec(src));) {
    if (/[\w.$]/.test(src[m.index - 1] ?? '')) continue;          // x.t(, myT(
    let i = space(src, m.index + m[0].length);
    if (m[1] === 'tn') {
      // past the count, to the first comma at its own depth
      let depth = 0;
      for (; i < src.length; i++) {
        const c = src[i];
        if (c === '\'' || c === '"' || c === '`') { i = literal(src, i)[1] - 1; continue; }
        if ('([{'.includes(c)) depth++;
        else if (')]}'.includes(c)) depth--;
        else if (c === ',' && depth === 0) break;
      }
      i = space(src, i + 1);
      if (src[i] !== '\'' && src[i] !== '"') { bad.push(src.slice(m.index, m.index + 60)); continue; }
      const [one, j] = literal(src, i);
      i = space(src, j);
      if (src[i] !== ',') { bad.push(src.slice(m.index, m.index + 60)); continue; }
      i = space(src, i + 1);
      if (src[i] !== '\'' && src[i] !== '"') { bad.push(src.slice(m.index, m.index + 60)); continue; }
      out.push({ key: literal(src, i)[0], one, plural: true });
      continue;
    }
    // t(x), T(x) and tvars(x) of a text made elsewhere (in N()) are fine; N() of anything but a literal is not
    if (src[i] !== '\'' && src[i] !== '"') { if (m[1] === 'N') bad.push(src.slice(m.index, m.index + 60)); continue; }
    out.push({ key: literal(src, i)[0], plural: false });
  }
  return { keys: out, bad };
}

const VOID = new Set(['area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'source', 'track', 'wbr']);
const decode = s => s.replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|[a-z]+);/gi, (m, e) => e[0] === '#' ? String.fromCodePoint(e[1] === 'x' || e[1] === 'X' ? parseInt(e.slice(2), 16) : +e.slice(1))
  : ({ amp: '&', lt: '<', gt: '>', quot: '"', apos: '\'', nbsp: ' ' })[e.toLowerCase()] ?? m);
const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
const norm = s => s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

/** index.html as a tree: { tag, attrs, kids } and text strings */
function parseHtml(html) {
  const root = { tag: '#root', attrs: {}, kids: [] }, stack = [root];
  const re = /<!--[\s\S]*?-->|<!doctype[^>]*>|<\/([a-z0-9-]+)\s*>|<([a-z0-9-]+)((?:\s+[^\s=>/]+(?:\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+))?)*)\s*\/?>|([^<]+)/gi;
  for (let m; (m = re.exec(html));) {
    const top = stack[stack.length - 1];
    if (m[4] !== undefined) { top.kids.push(decode(m[4])); continue; }
    if (m[1]) { const t = m[1].toLowerCase(); while (stack.length > 1 && stack.pop().tag !== t); continue; }
    if (!m[2]) continue;
    const attrs = {};
    for (const a of m[3].matchAll(/([^\s=>/]+)(?:\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+))?/g)) attrs[a[1].toLowerCase()] = a[2] === undefined ? '' : decode(a[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, ''));
    const el = { tag: m[2].toLowerCase(), attrs, kids: [] };
    top.kids.push(el);
    if (!VOID.has(el.tag) && el.tag !== 'script' && el.tag !== 'style') stack.push(el);
    else if (el.tag === 'script' || el.tag === 'style') { const end = html.indexOf(`</${el.tag}`, re.lastIndex); re.lastIndex = end < 0 ? html.length : end; }
  }
  return root;
}
const textOf = n => typeof n === 'string' ? n : n.kids.map(textOf).join('');
/** i18n.ts htmlKey: the text, each element <k>…</k> in the order they open */
function htmlKey(el) {
  let k = 0;
  const walk = n => n.kids.map(c => typeof c === 'string' ? esc(c) : (i => `<${i}>${walk(c)}</${i}>`)(k++)).join('');
  return norm(walk(el));
}

/** the texts index.html marks: [{ key, where }] */
export function htmlKeys(html) {
  const out = [];
  const visit = n => {
    if (typeof n === 'string') return;
    const where = `index.html ${n.tag}${n.attrs.id ? '#' + n.attrs.id : ''}`;
    if ('data-i18n' in n.attrs) out.push({ key: norm(textOf(n)), where });
    if ('data-i18n-html' in n.attrs) out.push({ key: htmlKey(n), where, html: true });
    if ('data-i18n-attr' in n.attrs) for (const a of n.attrs['data-i18n-attr'].split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) out.push({ key: n.attrs[a] ?? '', where: `${where} [${a}]` });
    n.kids.forEach(visit);
  };
  visit(parseHtml(html));
  return out;
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the catalog --

function sources(dir) {
  return fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(e => {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    // the test pages are not the player's; i18n.ts itself only defines the functions
    return e.isDirectory() ? (e.name === 'test' ? [] : sources(p)) : e.name.endsWith('.ts') && e.name !== 'i18n.ts' ? [p] : [];
  });
}

/** every text: Map key -> { where: string[], plural, one?, html? }; bad: calls the extraction cannot read */
export function catalog() {
  const all = new Map(), bad = [];
  const add = (k, where, extra = {}) => {
    if (!k) return;
    const e = all.get(k) ?? { where: [], plural: false };
    if (!e.where.includes(where)) e.where.push(where);
    Object.assign(e, extra.plural ? { plural: true, one: extra.one } : {}, extra.html ? { html: true } : {});
    all.set(k, e);
  };
  for (const f of sources(path.join(WEB, 'src'))) {
    const rel = path.relative(path.join(WEB, 'src'), f).split(path.sep).join('/');
    const r = sourceKeys(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
    for (const k of r.keys) add(k.key, rel, k);
    bad.push(...r.bad.map(b => `${rel}: ${b}`));
  }
  for (const k of htmlKeys(fs.readFileSync(path.join(WEB, 'index.html'), 'utf8'))) add(k.key, k.where, k);
  return { keys: all, bad };
}

/** the {name}s of a text */
export const holes = s => new Set([...s.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)].map(m => m[1]));
/** the <k> tags of a text, in order, opening and closing */
export const tags = s => [...s.matchAll(/<(\/?)(\d+)>/g)].map(m => m[0]);

/** CLDR's plural forms (Intl.PluralRules) of each language the files are for */
const LOCALE = { french: 'fr', german: 'de', italian: 'it', spanish: 'es', dutch: 'nl', swedish: 'sv', danish: 'da', korean: 'ko',
  chinese: 'zh-Hant', japanese: 'ja', russian: 'ru', thai: 'th', portuguese: 'pt-BR', polish: 'pl', turkish: 'tr', hungarian: 'hu',
  ukrainian: 'uk', czech: 'cs', slovak: 'sk', greek: 'el' };
export const LANGUAGE_FILES = Object.keys(LOCALE);
export const langFile = l => path.join(WEB, 'src/app/lang', `${l}.json`);

/** src/boot.ts's texts in each language's file: { language: { key: text } }.  boot.js shows them before the page's
 *  script (and its language files) have arrived, so build.mjs puts them into it. */
export function bootTexts() {
  const keys = sourceKeys(fs.readFileSync(path.join(WEB, 'src/boot.ts'), 'utf8')).keys.map(k => k.key);
  return Object.fromEntries(LANGUAGE_FILES.map(l => {
    const have = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(langFile(l), 'utf8'));
    return [l, Object.fromEntries(keys.filter(k => typeof have[k] === 'string').map(k => [k, have[k]]))];
  }));
}

/** What is wrong with a language's file against the texts in use: [] when nothing. */
export function check(lang, keys = catalog().keys) {
  const out = [];
  let have;
  try { have = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(langFile(lang), 'utf8')); } catch (e) { return [`${lang}.json: ${e.message}`]; }
  const forms = new Intl.PluralRules(LOCALE[lang]).resolvedOptions().pluralCategories;
  const sameTags = (en, x) => JSON.stringify(tags(en).sort()) === JSON.stringify(tags(x).sort());
  /** x's {name}s are the English's, and it keeps all of them but {n}, which one form may say in words; {pos} (an
   *  English ordinal, "3rd") comes with {n}, its number, which a language says its own way in place of it */
  const holesOk = (en, x, mayDropN) => {
    const a = holes(en), b = holes(x);
    if (a.has('pos')) a.add('n');
    return [...b].every(h => a.has(h)) && [...a].every(h => b.has(h) || (h === 'n' && (mayDropN || a.has('pos'))) || (h === 'pos' && b.has('n')));
  };
  for (const [k, e] of keys) {
    if (!(k in have)) { out.push(`missing: ${JSON.stringify(k)}`); continue; }
    const v = have[k];
    const en = e.plural ? [e.one, k].join(' ') : k;
    const texts = typeof v === 'string' ? [[v, false]] : v && typeof v === 'object' && e.plural ? Object.entries(v).map(([f, x]) => [x, f !== 'other', f]) : null;
    if (!texts) { out.push(`not a text${e.plural ? ' or plural forms' : ''}: ${JSON.stringify(k)}`); continue; }
    if (typeof v === 'object') {
      for (const f of Object.keys(v)) if (!forms.includes(f)) out.push(`plural form "${f}" is not ${lang}'s (${forms.join(', ')}): ${JSON.stringify(k)}`);
      if (!('other' in v)) out.push(`plural forms without "other": ${JSON.stringify(k)}`);
    }
    for (const [x, single] of texts) {
      if (typeof x !== 'string' || !x.trim()) { out.push(`empty: ${JSON.stringify(k)}`); continue; }
      if (!holesOk(e.plural ? en : k, x, e.plural && single)) out.push(`{names} differ: ${JSON.stringify(k)} -> ${JSON.stringify(x)}`);
      if (!sameTags(k, x)) out.push(`<n> tags differ: ${JSON.stringify(k)} -> ${JSON.stringify(x)}`);
    }
  }
  for (const k of Object.keys(have)) if (!keys.has(k)) out.push(`not in use: ${JSON.stringify(k)}`);
  return out;
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const { keys, bad } = catalog();
  for (const b of bad) console.error(`not a literal: ${b}`);
  const [a, b] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (a === '--check') {
    let n = 0;
    for (const l of b ? [b] : LANGUAGE_FILES) { const p = check(l, keys); n += p.length; console.log(`${l}: ${p.length ? p.length + ' problems' : 'ok'}`); for (const x of p) console.log(`  ${x}`); }
    process.exit(n ? 1 : 0);
  }
  const have = a ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(langFile(a), 'utf8')); } catch { return {}; } })() : {};
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, e] of keys) if (!(k in have)) out[k] = e;
  console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 1));
}

    s.presses = before.length;
    s.afterPress = before.length ? s.end - before[before.length - 1] : null;
  }

const first = firstLine ? { ms: firstLine.ms, f: +/f=(\d+)/.exec(firstLine.t)[1] } : null;

  screens, presses: presses.length, sequence: tops.map(t => t.name),

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${o.name}.json`), JSON.stringify(res, null, 1));
console.log(`${o.name}: page ${o.page}, intro ${res.intro}, reg ${o.reg}, drive ${o.drive}${o.drive !== 'none' ? ` every ${o.every} ms` : ''}, exit ${exit}${ok ? '' : ' (TIMEOUT)'}`);
for (const s of screens)

    (s.presses ? `  presses ${s.presses}, ended ${s.afterPress} ms after the last` : ''));

for (const k of res.skips) console.log(`  ${k}`);
console.log(`  log: ${path.relative(ROOT, path.join(OUT, `${o.name}.log`))}`);
process.exitCode = ok && exit === 0 ? 0 : 1;

#!/bin/bash
# The x86 ISA semantics suite (tools/isatest.py) on WebAssembly: the lifter's
# output for the hand-coded test instructions, compiled exactly like the game's
# lifted shards (web/build.sh flags, identity guest mapping, guest span below
# 0x28000000) and run in V8 under node:wasi.  This is the first correctness
# gate of the wasm codegen; the Mac runs the same tests as out/isatest.
#
#   web/tools/isatest.sh            regenerate gen/isatest.c, build, run
#   OPT=-O2 web/tools/isatest.sh    another optimisation level (default -O3)
#   WEB_LIFT=opt web/tools/isatest.sh   with web/gen.sh's lift options (X87OPT, FLAGABI, JTSWITCH, LREGS)
#
# Output: out/web/isa/isatest.wasm and the test report; exit 0 = all passed.

# FLAGABI's liveness with the test snippet declared flag-returning: the test
# reads its flags after its ret, which a FLAGABI lift otherwise leaves dead)

  echo '{"live_in": {}, "flags_out": ["0x401000"], "indirect_rd": []}' > "$OUT/flagabi_isa.json"
  export X87OPT=1 FLAGABI="$OUT/flagabi_isa.json" JTSWITCH="${JTSWITCH:-1}" LREGS="${LREGS:-1}"
fi
"$PY" tools/isatest.py
# Same target, features and defines as web/build.sh (keep in step with it).
OPT="${OPT:--O3}"
TARGET="--target=wasm32-wasip1-threads -pthread"
FEAT="-msimd128 -mbulk-memory -mnontrapping-fptoint -mtail-call -mexception-handling -mllvm -wasm-enable-sjlj -mllvm -wasm-use-legacy-eh=false"

// What fails a game's run in the test runners (run-suite.mjs, input-suite.mjs, roam-pair.mjs): the lines the runtime
// and the page print when something went wrong.  Each runner adds its own checks (the exit code, its marker, results).
//   logWhy(log)                        -> [] or ['fault', 'wait-timeout', ...]
//   logWhy(log, { allow: ['freeze'] }) -> the same without those (a scenario that expects them)
// The log's lines as the runners keep them; a thread tag ([3] or [3!]) in front of a line is fine.

/** [why, the line that says it] */
export const LOG_RULES = [
  ['fault', /FAULT IN GUEST|GUEST MEMORY FAULT|HOST SEGV/],
  ['timeout', /TIME LIMIT REACHED/],
  ['trap', /^\[trap\]/m],
  ['unresolved-icall', /UNRESOLVED INDIRECT/],
  ['expect-failed', /^\[expect\] FAIL/m],
  ['wasm-trap', /^TRAP in thread/m],
  ['page-error', /^PAGEERROR|^WORKERERROR|^CRASH/m],
  ['unimplemented-import', /unimplemented import/],
  ['stack-overflow', /RangeError|Maximum call stack/],
  ['net-blocked', /^\[(net|roam)\] BLOCKED/m],
  // a script's wait that ran out (waitfng, waitmem, waitexpr, tapuntil ...): runtime/autotest.c goes on with the next
  // line, so a marker the script logs after it still comes although the step it waited for never did
  ['wait-timeout', /^\[autotest\] f=\d+ .*\bTIMEOUT\b/m],
  // a script line the runtime could not read (it leaves it out), or no script at all
  ['script-error', /^\[autotest\] (script line \d+:|cannot open input script)/m],
  // the stall watchdog (runtime/watchdog.c): no frame for 15 s (20 s while loading), also when the game went on later
  ['freeze', /^\[watchdog\] no Present for/m],
];

/** the log without the thread tags the test pages put in front of the game's lines */
export const untagged = log => log.replace(/^\[\d+!?\] /gm, '');

/** why the log fails the run ([] when it does not) */
export function logWhy(log, { allow = [] } = {}) {
  const l = untagged(log);
  return LOG_RULES.filter(([why, re]) => !allow.includes(why) && re.test(l)).map(([why]) => why);
}

/** the lines that made logWhy fail the run (to print beside its verdict) */
export function whyLines(log, { allow = [], max = 3 } = {}) {
  const res = LOG_RULES.filter(([why]) => !allow.includes(why)).map(([, re]) => new RegExp(re.source));
  return untagged(log).split('\n').filter(l => res.some(re => re.test(l))).slice(0, max);
}

//
//   node web/tools/lan-pair.mjs --out <dir> [--mode circuit|sprint|drag] [--races N] [--players 2..6]

//        [--env K=V ...] [--host-env K=V ...] [--join-env K=V ...] [--headed] [--bounce <s>]
//        [--host-arg X ...] [--join-arg X ...]   more tools/gen_lan_race.py options, e.g. --join-arg --confirm-join
//        [--joinN-arg X ...]   the same for instance N alone (2..6), e.g. its own --after lines

//                    switch's --lan-impair, vlanhub.py's impairments on LAN play's frames; hold: a link held for
//                    holdms, then everything at once, as a player's WebSocket after a lost TCP segment; legs:
//                    leg=MS,leg.N=MS,legjitter=MS,stall=PCT,stall.N=PCT,stallms=MS, each player's own way to the

//        [--page play [--size 960x540] [--play-only N]]   the renderer's test page instead of the null

//                    only instance N renders (two renderers at once overloaded a busy machine: §4.4 of the report)

// The generated scripts are answered by this tool (Playwright's request
// interception in start()) at a path of the page's own origin: the server's
// Content-Security-Policy (connect-src 'self') refuses a data: URL, and the
// server only serves the repository's own tests/.
const scriptPath = i => `/tests/lan-pair/${stamp}-i${i + 1}.txt`;
function url(i) {
  const env = { ...COMMON };
  for (const kv of opts(i === 0 ? 'host-env' : 'join-env')) env[kv.slice(0, kv.indexOf('='))] = kv.slice(kv.indexOf('=') + 1);
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ wasm: '/game.wasm', pages: '16384', arg: '/data/SPEED2.EXE',
    reg: '/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt', save: `lan-${stamp}-i${i + 1}`, net: NAMES[i],
    script: scriptPath(i) });
  if (PAGE === 'app') {
    // the player's page: no wasm/pages/arg/net (the app's own), the switch name from roam_name, free roam off
    const a = new URLSearchParams({ reg: q.get('reg'), save: q.get('save'), script: q.get('script') });
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({ ...env, NFSU2_ROAM: '0', NFSU2_ROAM_NAME: NAMES[i] })) if (k !== 'NFSU2_SAVEDIR') a.append('env', `${k}=${v}`);
    return `${BASE}/?${a}&fresh`;
  }
  const page = PAGE === 'play' && (!PLAY_ONLY || PLAY_ONLY === i + 1) ? 'play' : 'hostcheck';
  if (page === 'play'){ q.set('w', String(SIZE[0])); q.set('h', String(SIZE[1])); q.set('artifacts', `/artifacts/i${i + 1}-`); q.set('dumpscale', '1'); }
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(env)) q.append('env', `${k}=${v}`);
  return `${BASE}/test/${page}.html?${q}&fresh`;
}

// our own server (stopped by its child handle only)
let server = null, serverDied = null;
const serverLog = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(OUT, 'server.log'));
async function startServer() {
  const c = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA,
    '--http-port', String(HTTP_PORT), '--dev', '--artifacts', OUT, ...(opt('impair', '') ? ['--lan-impair', opt('impair', '')] : [])]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  own(c);
  c.stdout.pipe(serverLog, { end: false }); c.stderr.pipe(serverLog, { end: false });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start')), 20000);
    c.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('this Mac') || out.includes('this host')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    c.on('exit', code => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error(`server exited (${code})`)); });
  });
  serverLog.write(`--- server pid ${c.pid} up at ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);
  c.on('exit', (code, sig) => { if (server === c) serverDied = `server-died(${code ?? sig})`; });
  return c;
}
async function stopServer() {
  if (!server) return;
  const c = server; server = null;
  await stop(c);
  serverLog.write(`--- server stopped at ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);
}

async function start(i) {
  const dir = path.join(OUT, `i${i + 1}`); fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const ctx = await browser.newContext();
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await page.route(`**${scriptPath(i)}`, r => r.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', body: scripts[i] }));
  if (WASM_OF.has(i + 1)) await page.route('**/game.wasm', r => r.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/wasm', path: WASM_OF.get(i + 1) }));
  const plog = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(dir, 'page.log'));
  const lines = [], clk = [];
  const r = { dropAt: null, dropped: 0 };
  let exit = null;
  const w = (s) => plog.write(`${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(3)} ${s}\n`);
  page.on('console', m => {
    const t = m.text(); w(t);
    // the instance's trace clock as it read it, and when the line came by this tool's monotonic clock (clock.csv):
    // the least difference lines the instances' car traces up (tools/race_acc.py; their wall clocks can differ)
    const ck = /\[ctclock\] (\d+\.\d+)/.exec(t);
    if (ck) clk.push(`${performance.now().toFixed(3)},${ck[1]}`);
    const g = /^\[\d+!?\] ([^]*)$/.exec(t);
    if (g) lines.push(g[1]); else { const e = /^EXIT (-?\d+)$/.exec(t); if (e) exit = +e[1]; lines.push(t); }
    if (DROP && DROP[0] === i + 1 && !r.dropAt && /network race begins/.test(t)) {
      r.dropAt = setTimeout(() => { r.dropped = (Date.now() - t0) / 1000; console.log(`lan-pair: ${NAMES[i]} closes its page at ${r.dropped.toFixed(1)} s (--drop)`);
        void ctx.close().catch(() => {}); }, DROP[1] * 1000);
    }
    if (PAGE === 'app') { const x = /guest exited with code (-?\d+)|\[app\] the game exited with code (-?\d+)/.exec(t); if (x) exit = +(x[1] ?? x[2]); }
  });
  page.on('pageerror', e => { w('PAGEERROR ' + e); lines.push(`PAGEERROR ${e}`); });
  page.on('crash', () => lines.push('CRASH (renderer process)'));
  const u = url(i);
  w(`URL ${u}`);
  await page.goto(u);
  if (PAGE === 'app') {
    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__nfsu2?.phase === 'ready', null, { timeout: 120000 });
    await page.click('#play');
    w('[lan-pair] clicked Play');
  }
  const timer = setInterval(async () => {
    try { const s = await page.evaluate(() => { const n = globalThis.nfsu2Net; return n ? { ...n.stats(), peers: n.peers } : null; }); if (s) w(`NETSTAT ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); } catch {}
  }, 10000);
  Object.assign(r, { i, name: NAMES[i], dir, page, ctx, plog, lines, clk, timer, exitCode: () => exit, done: null });
  r.done = page.waitForFunction(() => document.title === 'DONE' || window.__nfsu2?.phase === 'exited', null, { timeout: TMO, polling: 1000 })
    .then(() => 'done', () => 'timeout');
  inst.push(r);
  console.log(`lan-pair: ${r.name} started at ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`);
  return r;
}

    summary.result[x.name] = { dropped: `closed its page at ${x.dropped.toFixed(1)} s`, why };
    summary.why.push(...why);
    continue;

  if (x.exitCode() !== 0) why.push(`${n}:exit=${x.exitCode()}`);
  if (!log.includes('quit at guest frame')) why.push(`${n}:no-quit`);
  if (!log.includes('screen UI_PostRaceResults.fng')) why.push(`${n}:no-results`);
  if (has(/FAULT IN GUEST|GUEST MEMORY FAULT|HOST SEGV/)) why.push(`${n}:fault`);
  if (log.includes('TIME LIMIT REACHED')) why.push(`${n}:timeout`);
  if (has(/^\[trap\]/m) || has(/^TRAP in thread/m)) why.push(`${n}:trap`);
  if (log.includes('UNRESOLVED INDIRECT')) why.push(`${n}:unresolved-icall`);
  if (has(/^\[net\] BLOCKED/m)) why.push(`${n}:net-blocked`);
  if (has(/^PAGEERROR|^CRASH/m)) why.push(`${n}:page-error`);
  if (RACES > 1 && !has(new RegExp(`LOG results_r${RACES}$`, 'm'))) why.push(`${n}:no-results-r${RACES}`);
  const L = log.split('\n'), grab = (re) => L.filter(l => re.test(l));

    exit: x.exitCode(), quit: grab(/quit at guest frame/).pop() ?? null,
    net: grab(/^\[net\] (virtual LAN|mode vlan|WSAStartup)/).slice(0, 6),
    lanstats: grab(/^\[net\] virtual LAN (stats|at exit)/).slice(-2),

    lobby: grab(/^\[guest\] .*(auth|Server ready|login)/).slice(0, 8),
    page: grab(/^NET \{/).pop() ?? null,
    why,
  };

/** a flag's pixels in runs (see the top) */
function runs(px) {
  const n = px.length / 3, o = [], same = (i, j) => px[3 * i] === px[3 * j] && px[3 * i + 1] === px[3 * j + 1] && px[3 * i + 2] === px[3 * j + 2];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < n) {
    let r = 1;
    while (i + r < n && r < 129 && same(i, i + r)) r++;
    if (r >= 2) { o.push(126 + r, px[3 * i], px[3 * i + 1], px[3 * i + 2]); i += r; continue; }
    let l = 1;
    while (i + l < n && l < 128 && !(i + l + 1 < n && same(i + l, i + l + 1))) l++;
    o.push(l - 1);
    for (let k = 0; k < l; k++) o.push(px[3 * (i + k)], px[3 * (i + k) + 1], px[3 * (i + k) + 2]);
    i += l;
  }
  return Uint8Array.from(o);
}

  buf.set(f.data, at); at += f.data.length;
});
