// The recorded horns (runtime/horn.c's kinds with a clip): cut from their recordings, as web/src/static/horns.dat,
// which the game embeds (horn.c) and the start page fetches for Settings' Listen button (horn-preview.ts).
//   node web/tools/mkhorns.mjs <folder> [out]
// <folder> holds the recordings as <YouTube id>.<any extension ffmpeg reads>, e.g. from
//   yt-dlp -x --audio-format wav -o '%(id)s.%(ext)s' -- <id> ...
// Needs ffmpeg.  Each clip: cut, one channel at RATE, the silence before and after it trimmed, a fade in (and out,
// but for a looping clip), its peak at -1 dBFS (horn.c's level per kind sets how loud it sounds).  soft: its spikes
// rounded off (c tanh(x / c), c that much of its peak), so it sounds as loud as the others with no higher peaks.  A looping clip
// (loop: seconds after its start) ends at the loop's end, which is cross-faded with what comes before the loop's
// start, so the jump back is seamless.
//
// horns.dat, little-endian: "HRN1", u16 count, u16 rate; count entries of { char name[16] (NUL-padded), u32 offset,
// u32 samples, u32 loop start, u32 loop end (0, 0: none) } (offsets and points in samples, from the data's start);
// then the data, int16.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const RATE = 32000;
/** the clips, by the name horn.c's kinds give; from/to: seconds in the recording */
const CLIPS = [
  { name: 'dixie', src: '-wllulJyJa8', from: 1.0, to: 4.2 },   // "Goofy ahh car honk sound effect": a Dixie horn
  { name: 'oldcar', src: 'wrmQ2KHHQPc', from: 0.3, to: 2.0 },  // "Old Car Horn - Sound Effect(HD)"
  { name: 'broken', src: 'RtQN0sRRbvM', from: 0.5, to: 1.7 },  // "1990 Manual Toyota Corolla Broken Horn Honks": its first, from the honk
  { name: 'thecar', src: 'ds3r2nT7YeU', from: 1.8, to: 4.6 },  // "The car (1977) horn SFX": a short and a long honk
  { name: 'thecar_long', src: 'ds3r2nT7YeU', from: 13.5, to: 16.6, loop: [0.5, 2.5], soft: 0.45 },   // the same, its held blast
];
const XFADE_S = 0.15, FADE_IN_S = 0.005, FADE_OUT_S = 0.03, GATE_DB = -40, PEAK_DB = -1;

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const [dir, out = path.join(REPO, 'web/src/static/horns.dat')] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!dir) { console.error('usage: node web/tools/mkhorns.mjs <folder of recordings> [out]'); process.exit(2); }

function clip(c) {
  const file = fs.readdirSync(dir).find(f => path.parse(f).name === c.src);
  if (!file) throw new Error(`${c.name}: no ${c.src}.* in ${dir}`);
  const raw = execFileSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-ss', String(c.from), '-to', String(c.to), '-i', path.join(dir, file),
    '-ac', '1', '-ar', String(RATE), '-f', 'f32le', '-'], { maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });
  let x = new Float32Array(raw.buffer.slice(raw.byteOffset, raw.byteOffset + raw.length));
  let peak = x.reduce((m, v) => Math.max(m, Math.abs(v)), 0);
  const gate = peak * 10 ** (GATE_DB / 20);
  let a = x.findIndex(v => Math.abs(v) > gate), b = x.length;
  if (!c.loop) while (b > a && Math.abs(x[b - 1]) <= gate) b--;
  a = Math.max(0, a - Math.round(0.002 * RATE));
  x = x.slice(a, b);
  let l0 = 0, l1 = 0;
  if (c.loop) {
    [l0, l1] = c.loop.map(s => Math.round(s * RATE));
    const n = Math.round(XFADE_S * RATE);
    if (l0 < n || l1 > x.length || l1 - l0 < 2 * n) throw new Error(`${c.name}: the loop does not fit`);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {   // equal power: the end turns into what led to the start
      const w = (i + 0.5) / n;
      x[l1 - n + i] = x[l1 - n + i] * Math.cos(w * Math.PI / 2) + x[l0 - n + i] * Math.sin(w * Math.PI / 2);
    }
    x = x.slice(0, l1);
  }
  if (c.soft) for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] = c.soft * peak * Math.tanh(x[i] / (c.soft * peak));
  const fi = Math.round(FADE_IN_S * RATE), fo = c.loop ? 0 : Math.round(FADE_OUT_S * RATE);
  for (let i = 0; i < fi; i++) x[i] *= i / fi;
  for (let i = 0; i < fo; i++) x[x.length - 1 - i] *= i / fo;
  peak = x.reduce((m, v) => Math.max(m, Math.abs(v)), 0);
  const g = 10 ** (PEAK_DB / 20) / peak;
  const pcm = Int16Array.from(x, v => Math.max(-32768, Math.min(32767, Math.round(v * g * 32767))));
  console.log(`${c.name.padEnd(12)} ${(pcm.length / RATE).toFixed(2)} s${c.loop ? `, loop ${(l0 / RATE).toFixed(2)}-${(l1 / RATE).toFixed(2)} s` : ''}`);
  return { name: c.name, pcm, l0, l1 };
}

const clips = CLIPS.map(clip), HEAD = 8 + 32 * clips.length;
const total = clips.reduce((n, c) => n + c.pcm.length, 0), buf = Buffer.alloc(HEAD + 2 * total);
buf.write('HRN1', 0, 'latin1'); buf.writeUInt16LE(clips.length, 4); buf.writeUInt16LE(RATE, 6);
let off = 0;
clips.forEach((c, i) => {
  const e = 8 + 32 * i;
  buf.write(c.name, e, 16, 'latin1');
  buf.writeUInt32LE(off, e + 16); buf.writeUInt32LE(c.pcm.length, e + 20); buf.writeUInt32LE(c.l0, e + 24); buf.writeUInt32LE(c.l1, e + 28);
  Buffer.from(c.pcm.buffer, c.pcm.byteOffset, c.pcm.byteLength).copy(buf, HEAD + 2 * off);
  off += c.pcm.length;
});
fs.writeFileSync(out, buf);
console.log(`${out}: ${clips.length} clips, ${(total / RATE).toFixed(1)} s, ${buf.length} bytes`);

// a message: [0..3] kind, [4..7] code (0 = success), [8..11] u32 big-endian length (these 12 bytes included), then
// KEY=VALUE fields, NUL-terminated; a value with a byte below 0x20, DEL or = " : % ^ has them as %xx, and is in
// double quotes when it has a space (as SPEED2.EXE writes one)
const HDR = 12, SPECIAL = new Set([0x3d, 0x22, 0x3a, 0x25, 0x5e, 0x7f]), HEX = '0123456789abcdef';
function encodeValue(v) {
  const b = Buffer.from(String(v), 'latin1');
  let s = '';
  for (const c of b) s += c < 0x20 || SPECIAL.has(c) ? '%' + HEX[c >> 4] + HEX[c & 15] : String.fromCharCode(c);
  return b.includes(0x20) ? `"${s}"` : s;
}
const tag4 = t => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); if (t) Buffer.from(String(t), 'latin1').copy(b, 0, 0, 4); return b; };
const tagText = b => [...b].filter(c => c).map(c => c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f ? String.fromCharCode(c) : '\\x' + HEX[c >> 4] + HEX[c & 15]).join('');
/** one message: kind, code, fields ([[k, v]] or {k: v}) */
function encodeFrame(kind, code, fields = []) {
  const list = Array.isArray(fields) ? fields : Object.entries(fields);
  const body = Buffer.from(list.filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${encodeValue(v)}\n`).join('') + '\0', 'latin1');
  const f = Buffer.alloc(HDR + body.length);
  tag4(kind).copy(f, 0); tag4(code).copy(f, 4); f.writeUInt32BE(f.length, 8); body.copy(f, HDR);
  return f;
}
/** the messages of a byte stream: push() returns those complete so far as { kind, code, body } */
class FrameReader {
  constructor(max) { this.max = max; this.buf = Buffer.alloc(0); this.error = null; }
  push(chunk) {
    if (this.error) return [];
    this.buf = this.buf.length ? Buffer.concat([this.buf, chunk]) : Buffer.from(chunk);
    const out = [];
    while (this.buf.length >= HDR) {
      const n = this.buf.readUInt32BE(8);
      if (n < HDR || n > this.max) { this.error = `a message of ${n} bytes (at most ${this.max})`; this.buf = Buffer.alloc(0); break; }
      if (this.buf.length < n) break;
      out.push({ kind: tagText(this.buf.subarray(0, 4)), code: tagText(this.buf.subarray(4, 8)), body: this.buf.subarray(HDR, n) });
      this.buf = this.buf.subarray(n);
    }
    return out;
  }
}
/** a body's fields as a Map, keys upper-cased (the first of a repeated key wins, as the game's own search finds it) */
function fieldMap(body) {
  const m = new Map();
  let end = body.indexOf(0); if (end < 0) end = body.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < end;) {
    while (i < end && body[i] <= 0x20) i++;
    if (i >= end) break;
    let k = i;
    while (k < end && body[k] > 0x20 && body[k] !== 0x3d) k++;
    const key = body.toString('latin1', i, k).toUpperCase();
    if (k >= end || body[k] !== 0x3d) { i = k; continue; }
    let q = k + 1, raw;
    if (body[q] === 0x22) { const a = q + 1; q = a; while (q < end && body[q] !== 0x22) q++; raw = body.toString('latin1', a, q); i = q + 1; }
    else { const a = q; while (q < end && body[q] > 0x20) q++; raw = body.toString('latin1', a, q); i = q; }
    if (!m.has(key)) m.set(key, raw.replace(/%([0-9a-fA-F]{2})/g, (_, h) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16))));
  }
  return m;
}
/** one switch frame of a LAN kind: [0] kind, [4..7] source, [8..11] destination, [12..15] ports, then the LAN header
 * (op, ttl, 2 reserved, the connection id, little-endian) and the data */
function lanFrame(kind, src, dst, sport, dport, op, cid, data = null) {
  const n = data ? data.length : 0;
  const f = Buffer.alloc(16 + 8 + n);
  f[0] = kind; f.writeUInt32BE(src >>> 0, 4); f.writeUInt32BE(dst >>> 0, 8);
  f.writeUInt16BE(sport, 12); f.writeUInt16BE(dport, 14);
  f[16] = op; f[17] = 64; f.writeUInt32LE(cid >>> 0, 20);
  if (n) data.copy(f, 24);
  return f;
}

// a race report the server takes: version 3, n players, circuit, index order = places, plausible times
function report(n) {
  const b = Buffer.alloc(8 + 55 * n);
  b[0] = 3; b[1] = n; b[2] = 0; b[3] = 0; b.writeUInt16BE(4014, 4); b[7] = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const o = 8 + 55 * i; b[o] = i; b[o + 1] = i + 1; b[o + 2] = 1; b[o + 3] = 21; b.writeFloatBE(20 + i, o + 8); }
  return b.toString('base64');
}

// games in groups of four, round after round until the time is up
async function group(g) {
  while (Date.now() < end - 8000) {
    const [h, ...js] = g, name = `L${h.i}.${Date.now() % 100000}`;
    try {
      h.lobby.send('gcre', [['NAME', name], ['MAXSIZE', 4], ['MINSIZE', 2], ['CUSTFLAGS', 1], ['SYSFLAGS', 0], ['PARAMS', 'TRACK=4014\nDIR=0\nLAPS=2']]);
      await h.lobby.wait(x => x.kind === 'gcre');
      for (const j of js) { j.lobby.send('gjoi', [['NAME', name]]); await j.lobby.wait(x => x.kind === 'gjoi'); j.lobby.send('gset', [['NAME', name], ['USERFLAGS', 134217728]]); }
      h.lobby.send('gsta', [['NAME', name]]);
      const ses = await h.lobby.wait(x => x.kind === '+ses');
      stats.races++;
      await sleep(2000);
      for (const b of g) {                                // the race report, from a new lobby session as the game does
        b.lobby.close();
        const c = await b.login(b.name);
        c.send('rank', [['AUTH', ses.f.get('AUTH')], ['RESU', report(g.length)], ...g.map((x, k) => [`NAME${k}`, x.name])]);
        await c.wait(x => x.kind === 'rank'); stats.reports++;
        c.send('move', [['NAME', ROOMS[b.i % ROOMS.length]]]);
        c.on = b.lobby.on;
      }
    } catch (e) { await sleep(1000); }
  }
}
const groups = [];

const racing = Promise.all(groups.map(group));

// the abusive clients
async function abusers() {

  server: { before, afterLogins: peak, after },

/**
 * The generated flow (the game's screens):
 * main menu -> Online -> the Online Main Menu, logged in under the instance's
 * name (NFSU2_ROAM_NAME, runtime/online.c).  With --ea-login: main menu ->
 * Online -> EA Login: Use Existing EA Account -> account name and password

 * the room -> a chat line -> Ready.  Then as lan-pair: the game's AI drives
 * (drag: the synthetic pad) to the results screen.
 */
function onlineScript(role, name, inst) {
  const host = role === 'host', L = [], w = l => L.push(l);
  const raceMs = { circuit: 150000, sprint: 90000, drag: 40000 }[MODE] ?? 150000;
  w(`# Online race, ${role} side (${name}), generated by web/tools/online-pair.mjs --mode ${MODE}`);
  w('0     tapuntil RETURN MC_Background.fng 120 4000');
  w('+200  tap RETURN');
  w('+0    waitfng GarageMain.fng 3000');
  w('+300  tap RIGHT');                      // Quick Race -> Split Screen
  w('+60   tap RIGHT');                      // -> Online
  w('+120  tap RETURN');
  if (!EA_LOGIN) w('+0    waitfng UI_OLMAIN.fng 1800');
  else eaLogin(w);
  w('+300  log online-main');
  w('+0    dump online_main');
  w('+0    tap RIGHT');                      // News -> Lobby
  w('+60   tap RETURN');
  w('+0    waitfng PC_OL_Lobby.fng 900');
  w('+600  log lobby');
  for (let race = 1; race <= RACES; race++) if (!raceFlow(w, host, race, raceMs, inst)) return L.join('\n') + '\n';
  if (host) {
    // the results in the game's own screens: Personal Stats, then the overall Circuit board
    w('+0    log rankings');
    w('+0    tap ESCAPE');                   // the lobby's Back: the Online Main Menu (Lobby selected)
    w('+0    waitfng UI_OLMAIN.fng 900');
    w('+300  tap RIGHT');
    w('+40   tap RIGHT');
    w('+60   tap RETURN');
    w('+0    waitfng UI_OLRankings.fng 900');
    w('+300  tap RETURN');                   // Personal Stats
    w('+600  dump personal_stats');
    w('+0    tap ESCAPE');
    w('+300  tap RIGHT');                    // Overall Rankings
    w('+60   tap RETURN');
    w('+900  dump overall');
    w('+0    tap RIGHT');
    w('+300  dump overall_2');
  }
  w('+60   quit');
  return L.join('\n') + '\n';
}

  // game takes a pick from the page, or the page's own keys

  if (QUIT_MID[0] === inst) {
    // this player's process ends in the middle of the race (sockets closed, nothing more sent)
    w(`+${QUIT_MID[1]}ms dump quit_mid`);
    w('+0    log quit-mid-race');
    w('+0    quit');
    return false;
  }
  for (let t = 0; t < raceMs; t += 20000) w(`+${Math.min(20000, raceMs - t)}ms dump race_${Math.min(raceMs, t + 20000) / 1000}${x}`);
  // the results: a ranked race shows the tournament results screen instead
  w(`+0    waitfng ${RANKED ? 'UI_PostRace_TournResults.fng' : 'UI_PostRaceResults.fng'} 30000`);
  w(`+0    log results${x}`);
  w('+0    untrace');
  if (SAY && race === 1) { w(`+${1000 * inst}ms log say-results`); say(4, 'say'); w(`+${20000 - 1000 * inst}ms log said`); }

    // 0x58e05d); the screen reported on its own when it opened
    w('+0    waitexpr b:0x0086a6c0 == 1 6000');
    w(`+0    log results-table${x}`);
    w(`+60   dump results_table${x}`);
  }
  w('+300  tap RETURN');                     // Continue (unranked: the game logs in again, reports), the lobby
  w('+0    waitfng PC_OL_Lobby.fng 1800');
  w(`+3000ms dump after_results${x}`);
  return true;
}

    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({ ...env, NFSU2_ROAM: '0' })) if (k !== 'NFSU2_SAVEDIR') a.append('env', `${k}=${v}`);

// our own server (stopped by its child handle only); its log is this run's alone (the judge counts the results in it)
let server = null, serverDied = null;
const serverLog = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(OUT, 'server.log'));
async function startServer() {
  const c = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--http-port', String(HTTP_PORT), '--port', '0',
    '--dev', '--artifacts', OUT, '--online-trace', path.join(OUT, 'trace.txt'), '--state', path.join(OUT, 'state'), ...opts('server-arg')]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  own(c);
  c.stdout.pipe(serverLog, { end: false }); c.stderr.pipe(serverLog, { end: false });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start')), 20000);
    c.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('this Mac') || out.includes('this host')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    c.on('exit', code => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error(`server exited (${code})`)); });
  });
  c.on('exit', (code, sig) => { if (server === c) serverDied = `server-died(${code ?? sig})`; });
  return c;
}
async function stopServer() {
  if (!server) return;
  const c = server; server = null;
  await stop(c);
}

/** random bytes, or (packs) bytes of 2 bits each that compress to about a quarter */
function make(rel, size, packs = false) {
  const p = path.join(DATA, rel);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
  // AES-128-CTR over zeros, keyed by a counter: random-looking, the same every run
  const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(seed++)).digest().subarray(0, 16);
  const buf = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-128-ctr', key, Buffer.alloc(16)).update(Buffer.alloc(size));
  if (packs) for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) buf[i] = (buf[i] & 3) * 0x41;
  fs.writeFileSync(p, buf);
  files.set(rel, crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex'));
}

}

const text = sel => page.locator(sel).textContent();
async function open() {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => ['ready', 'error'].includes(window.__nfsu2?.phase), null, { timeout: 60000 });
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !/Counting/.test(document.querySelector('#cache-info').textContent), null, { timeout: 30000 });
  await page.click('#settings .tab[data-tab="game"]');                // where the game data's buttons are (its end)
}
async function until(f, ms = 60000) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  for (;;) { const s = await status(); if (f(s)) return s; if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) return s; await page.waitForTimeout(50); }
}
/** every file the download fetches (aheadOf), as the cache holds it: all blocks marked and the bytes the server
 *  has; and nothing else, no movie */
async function cacheMatches(ahead = AHEAD) {
  const got = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const m = await (await fetch('/data-manifest')).json();
    const d = await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getDirectoryHandle('cache').catch(() => null);
    const out = {};
    for (const f of m.files.filter(f => !f.d)) {
      const k = `${f.p.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_')}.${f.s}.${f.m}`;
      try {
        const have = new Uint8Array(await (await (await d.getFileHandle(k + '.have')).getFile()).arrayBuffer());
        const data = new Uint8Array(await (await (await d.getFileHandle(k)).getFile()).arrayBuffer()).subarray(0, f.s);
        const hex = [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data))].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
        out[f.p] = { full: have.length === Math.ceil(f.s / (1 << 20)) && have.every(b => b === 1), size: data.length, hex };
      } catch { out[f.p] = null; }
    }
    return out;
  });
  // an empty file needs nothing in the cache (a read of it never asks)
  const bad = ahead.filter(p => got[p] ? !got[p].full || got[p].hex !== files.get(p) : fs.statSync(path.join(DATA, p)).size > 0);
  const extra = Object.keys(got).filter(p => got[p] && !ahead.includes(p));
  return { ok: !bad.length && !extra.length && Object.keys(got).length === files.size, bad, extra };
}

  await page.click('#clear-cache');
  await page.click('#confirm-ok');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => /deleted/.test(document.querySelector('#data-msg').textContent), null, { timeout: 15000 });
}

// Simulated free-roam players for load tests: n players, each the real core (runtime/roam_core.c in hub mode,
// tests/roam_crowd.c, built here for wasm without a C library) on its own WebSocket to a server's switch,
// driving along a track.  Real game pages (web/tools/roam-pair.mjs) can join the same server meanwhile.
//
//   node web/tools/roam-crowd.mjs [--base http://localhost:8655] [--n 62] [--seconds 120] [--room <name>] [--crew <name>]
//        [--track <pose.csv>] [--speed 15] [--spread 20] [--car 350Z] [--cars A,B,..|all] [--parts <list>|@<file>] [--stagger 50] [--states 1]
//        [--out <summary.json>] [--open 15] [--dents 1|2|3] [--dents-ms 1000]
//        [--race 1-3:60:120] [--paused 1-3] [--prefix Bot] [--links 64] [--bundle] [--first 0] [--loop-ms 10] [--hold 50] [--lobbies 7:S2_SPRINT_3,S2_URL_2]
//        [--flags nl,br,gb-eng] [--plates -,FAST123,AB123456] [--meet x,y,z] [--city side[,x,y]] [--seed n]
//
// --bundle the players send and take bundles as the page does (web/src/net/index.ts TxBundle, nfsu2-lan kind 32): what
//          one tick or one received message made them send goes as one message, a snapshot to several friends once
//          with their addresses.  Without it each datagram is a message of its own, as a page of before sends them.
// --loop-ms the core's timers run this often (the game's network thread: runtime/web/roam_web.c, rc_tick every 10 ms),
//          each pass's datagrams one message, a car state still 20 times a second; without it everything runs once a
//          car state (50 ms), so a player's pings, pongs and HELLOs mostly go with its snapshots: fewer messages than
//          a page sends.
// --hold   a player's own datagrams (pings, pongs, HELLOs, the SNAP to the hub) wait for its next car state to a friend,
//          this many ms after its last message at most, as the page holds them (web/src/net/index.ts TX_HOLD_MS)
// --first  the first player's number (from 0), for several of these at once on one server: their names and client
//          addresses stay apart.
// --cars   the players' cars in turn (car type names, CarTypeInfo +0), or all: the game's 31 player cars, PEUGOT to
//          IMPREZAWRX; without it every player drives --car.
// --parts  the players' cars' parts instead of the stock ones, slot:key:owner in hex, comma-separated (or from a file): a
//          record names every part (tests/scripts/roam_crowd_rims.parts: a 350Z with the rim shops' rims).  Several
//          records, one a line in the file (or |-separated): the players take them in turn (roam_crowd_paint.parts).

//          1 once; 2 a new set (a repair and a new crash) every --dents-ms (1000), as a game that sends what it likes
//          may; 3 as 2 with bytes at random (tests/scripts/damage_crowd.txt).

//          say nothing, and the hub gives them 32 (a game before core version 10)
// --crew   every player is in this crew (the Crews setting's one name): the hub links them to the players who share it
//          first, wherever they are, and those see them in the crew's colour.
// --race   players first to last (Bot01 is 1) are in a race from one second to the other after the start: they
//          announce it (RC_ST_EVENT) and send no car meanwhile, as a game in a race does.
// --paused players first to last (1-3) are paused (RC_ST_PAUSED, as a game in its pause menu): "(paused)" by their names.

const PAUSED = (opt('paused', '').match(/^(\d+)-(\d+)$/) ?? []).slice(1).map(Number), PREFIX = opt('prefix', 'Bot');
const FLAGS = opt('flags', '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map(f => f === '-' ? '' : f.toLowerCase());
const PLATES = opt('plates', '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map(p => p === '-' ? '' : p);
if (PLATES.some(p => !/^[A-Z0-9]{0,8}$/.test(p))) throw new Error('--plates: capitals and digits, at most 8 each, or - for none');
const ALL_CARS = ['PEUGOT', 'FOCUS', 'COROLLA', '240SX', 'MIATA', 'CIVIC', 'PEUGOT106', 'CORSA', 'HUMMER', 'NAVIGATOR', 'ESCALADE', 'TIBURON',
  'SENTRA', 'CELICA', 'IS300', 'SUPRA', 'GOLF', 'A3', 'RSX', 'ECLIPSE', 'TT', 'RX8', '350Z', 'G35', '3000GT', 'GTO', 'MUSTANGGT', 'SKYLINE',
  'LANCEREVO8', 'RX7', 'IMPREZAWRX'];
const CARS = opt('cars', '') === 'all' ? ALL_CARS : opt('cars', '') ? opt('cars', '').split(',') : [CAR];
const LOBBIES = (opt('lobbies', '').match(/^(\d+):(.+)$/) ?? []).slice(1);
const MEET = opt('meet', '') ? opt('meet', '').split(',').map(Number) : null, SEED = +opt('seed', String(Date.now() % 1e9 | 0));
const CITY = opt('city', '') ? opt('city', '').split(',').map(Number) : null, MEET_N = +opt('meet-n', 90), FIDGET = argv.includes('--fidget');
const HUB = 0x0A4D00FD, PORT = 47210;

// the core for wasm: no C library (wasip1 for its headers: names.h's <string.h>), bulk memory for the copies
const WASI = fs.readdirSync(path.join(REPO, 'deps')).filter(d => d.startsWith('wasi-sdk-')).map(d => path.join(REPO, 'deps', d)).pop();
const WASM = path.join(REPO, 'out/web/test/roam_crowd.wasm');
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(WASM), { recursive: true });
execFileSync(path.join(WASI, 'bin/clang'), ['--target=wasm32-wasip1', '-O2', '-ffreestanding', '-nostdlib', '-mbulk-memory', '-ffp-contract=off',
  '-Iruntime', '-Wl,--no-entry', '-Wl,--export-dynamic', '-o', WASM, 'tests/roam_crowd.c', 'runtime/roam_core.c'], { cwd: REPO, stdio: 'inherit' });
const mod = await WebAssembly.compile(fs.readFileSync(WASM));

// a room's hash as roam_core.c rc_room_hash makes it of an ASCII name (capitals and spaces do not count; the core also
// folds capitals past A to Z and Unicode's blanks, which a crowd's names here never have)
const roomHash = s => {
  let h = 0x811C9DC5, kept = 0;
  for (let c of Buffer.from(s, 'utf8')) {
    if (c === 32 || (c >= 9 && c <= 13)) continue;
    if (c >= 65 && c <= 90) c += 32;
    h ^= c; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; kept++;
  }
  return !kept ? 0 : h || 1;
};
const bhash = s => { let h = 0xFFFFFFFF; for (const c of Buffer.from(s, 'latin1')) h = (Math.imul(h, 33) + c) >>> 0; return h; };   // the game's bStringHash
const nowUs = () => (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()) * 1000;

// the track: (t s) -> { p, v }
let track;
if (TRACK) {
  const rows = fs.readFileSync(TRACK, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('L,')).map(l => l.split(','));
  const id = rows[0][3], pts = rows.filter(r => r[3] === id).map(r => ({ t: +r[1] / 1e6, p: [+r[4], +r[5], +r[6]] }));
  const t0 = pts[0].t, T = pts[pts.length - 1].t - t0;
  for (const q of pts) q.t -= t0;
  track = (t, i) => {
    const u = ((t + (i / N) * T) % T + T) % T;
    let lo = 0, hi = pts.length - 2;
    while (lo < hi) { const m = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (pts[m].t <= u) lo = m; else hi = m - 1; }
    const k = lo;
    const a = pts[k], b = pts[k + 1], dt = Math.max(1e-3, b.t - a.t), f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - a.t) / dt));
    return { p: a.p.map((x, j) => x + f * (b.p[j] - x)), v: a.p.map((x, j) => (b.p[j] - x) / dt) };
  };
  console.log(`roam-crowd: track ${TRACK}: ${pts.length} points over ${T.toFixed(0)} s`);
} else {
  track = (t, i) => {
    const r = SPREAD + (i % 6) * SPREAD, w = SPEED / r, a = w * t + i;
    return { p: [1695 + r * Math.cos(a), -884 + r * Math.sin(a), 24.1], v: [-r * w * Math.sin(a), r * w * Math.cos(a), 0] };
  };
}

if (MEET) {
  // mulberry32: the meet's random numbers, from --seed
  let a = SEED >>> 0;
  const unit = () => { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
  const range = (lo, hi) => lo + (hi - lo) * unit(), TAU = 2 * Math.PI, [cx, cy, cz] = MEET;
  const spot = () => { const r = Math.sqrt(range(64, 3600)), w = unit() * TAU; return [cx + r * Math.cos(w), cy + r * Math.sin(w)]; };
  const line = t => {
    const w = unit() * TAU, d = [Math.cos(w), Math.sin(w)], n = [-d[1], d[0]], b = range(-200, 200);
    return { leg: { a: [cx + n[0] * b - d[0] * 600, cy + n[1] * b - d[1] * 600], b: [cx + n[0] * b + d[0] * 600, cy + n[1] * b + d[1] * 600], t0: t, s: range(15, 35), park: false } };
  };
  const bots = [];
  const start = () => unit() < 0.55 ? { p: spot(), h: unit() * TAU, until: range(10, 360), fid: FIDGET ? range(0, 50) : Infinity } : line(-range(0, 40));
  let parked = 0;
  track = (t, i) => {
    const b = bots[i] ??= start();
    // a standing one's donut, move or stop (--fidget)
    if (b.until !== undefined && b.fx) {
      const f = b.fx, dt = Math.min(0.5, t - f.t); f.t = t;
      if (t >= f.end) { b.fx = null; if (f.stop) b.status = 2; b.fid = t - 25 * Math.log(1 - unit()); return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [0, 0, 0], h: b.h, status: b.status }; }
      if (f.stop) return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [0, 0, 0], h: b.h, status: b.status };
      b.h += f.w * dt; const v = [Math.cos(b.h) * f.sp, Math.sin(b.h) * f.sp];
      b.p = [b.p[0] + v[0] * dt, b.p[1] + v[1] * dt];
      return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [v[0], v[1], 0], h: b.h };
    }
    if (b.until !== undefined && t >= (b.fid ?? Infinity) && t < b.until) {
      const u = unit();
      if (u < 0.45) { const sp = range(6, 12); b.fx = { t, end: t + range(3, 8), sp, w: sp / range(4, 8) * (unit() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) }; }
      else if (u < 0.75) b.fx = { t, end: t + range(2, 6), sp: range(4, 8), w: range(-0.4, 0.4) };
      else { b.fx = { t, end: t + range(10, 60), stop: true }; b.status = unit() < 0.5 ? 4 : 5; }
      return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [0, 0, 0], h: b.h, status: b.status };
    }
    if (b.loop) {
      const { rr, a0, t0, w, end } = b.loop, a = a0 + w * (t - t0), sp = w * rr;
      if (t < end) { const v = [-Math.sin(a) * sp, Math.cos(a) * sp]; b.p = [cx + rr * Math.cos(a), cy + rr * Math.sin(a)]; b.h = Math.atan2(v[1], v[0]); return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [v[0], v[1], 0], h: b.h }; }
      b.loop = null; b.leg = line(t).leg;
    }
    if (b.until !== undefined && t >= b.until) {
      const d = [Math.cos(b.h), Math.sin(b.h)];
      Object.assign(b, { until: undefined, leg: { a: b.p, b: [b.p[0] + d[0] * 600, b.p[1] + d[1] * 600], t0: t, s: range(15, 25), park: false } });
    }
    if (b.leg) {
      const { a: p0, b: p1, t0, s } = b.leg, dx = p1[0] - p0[0], dy = p1[1] - p0[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dy), u = Math.min(len, (t - t0) * s);
      const d = [dx / len, dy / len];
      b.p = [p0[0] + d[0] * u, p0[1] + d[1] * u]; b.h = Math.atan2(d[1], d[0]);
      if (u < len) return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [d[0] * s, d[1] * s, 0], h: b.h };
      if (b.leg.park) { b.leg = null; b.until = t + range(90, 360); b.fid = FIDGET ? t + range(0, 50) : Infinity; parked++; }
      else if (FIDGET && unit() < 0.35) {
        const rr = range(40, 150), w = range(10, 25) / rr * (unit() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
        b.leg = null; b.loop = { rr, a0: Math.atan2(b.p[1] - cy, b.p[0] - cx), t0: t, w, end: t + range(20, 90) };
        return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [0, 0, 0], h: b.h };
      }
      else if (unit() < 0.4) { const sp = spot(), w = unit() * TAU; b.leg = { a: [sp[0] - Math.cos(w) * 500, sp[1] - Math.sin(w) * 500], b: sp, t0: t, s: range(12, 20), park: true }; }
      else b.leg = line(t).leg;
    }
    return { p: [b.p[0], b.p[1], cz], v: [0, 0, 0], h: b.h };
  };
  track.standing = () => bots.filter(b => b && !b.leg && !b.loop).length;
  console.log(`roam-crowd: a car meet at ${cx} ${cy} ${cz}, seed ${SEED}`);
}

if (CITY) {
  const [side, cx = 1695, cy = -884] = CITY, half = side / 2, meet = MEET ? track : null;
  const cars = new Map();
  const city = (t, i) => {
    let c = cars.get(i);
    if (!c) {
      // mulberry32 of the seed and the player's number: the same city from every process
      let a = (SEED ^ Math.imul(i + 1, 0x9E3779B1)) >>> 0;
      const unit = () => { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const h = unit() * 2 * Math.PI, sp = unit() < 0.55 ? 15 + 35 * unit() : 0;
      c = { unit, p: [cx - half + side * unit(), cy - half + side * unit()], v: [Math.cos(h) * sp, Math.sin(h) * sp], h, turn: 0, t };
      cars.set(i, c);
    }
    const dt = Math.min(0.5, Math.max(0, t - c.t)); c.t = t;
    if (c.v[0] || c.v[1]) {
      if (!c.turn && c.unit() < dt / 6) c.turn = (c.unit() - 0.5) * Math.PI;
      if (c.turn) {
        const w = Math.max(-1.047 * dt, Math.min(1.047 * dt, c.turn)); c.turn = Math.abs(c.turn - w) < 1e-9 ? 0 : c.turn - w;
        const [sn, co] = [Math.sin(w), Math.cos(w)]; c.v = [c.v[0] * co - c.v[1] * sn, c.v[0] * sn + c.v[1] * co];
      }
      for (const k of [0, 1]) {
        c.p[k] += c.v[k] * dt;
        const lo = (k ? cy : cx) - half, hi = (k ? cy : cx) + half;
        if (c.p[k] < lo || c.p[k] > hi) { c.p[k] = Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, c.p[k])); c.v[k] = -c.v[k]; }
      }
      c.h = Math.atan2(c.v[1], c.v[0]);
    }
    return { p: [c.p[0], c.p[1], 24.1], v: [c.v[0], c.v[1], 0], h: c.h };
  };
  track = meet ? (t, i) => (i < MEET_N ? meet(t, i) : city(t, i)) : city;
  if (meet) track.standing = meet.standing;
  console.log(`roam-crowd: a city of ${side} m round ${cx} ${cy}${meet ? `, a meet's ${MEET_N} in it` : ''}, seed ${SEED}`);
}

const st = { inDg: 0, outDg: 0, inB: 0, outB: 0, inMsg: 0, outMsg: 0, joins: 0, outOfRange: 0, otherLeaves: 0, notes: 0 }, why = {};
const tally = t => { const k = t.replace(/^Bot\d+/, '<bot>').replace(/\d+(\.\d+)*(:\d+)?/g, '#'); why[k] = (why[k] ?? 0) + 1; };
/** the frames of one tick (or one received message) as bundles, as the page's TxBundle makes them: a snapshot of
 *  the same bytes to another friend in the entry before it, unless something for that friend came between; bundles
 *  of NET_BUNDLE_MAX bytes at most, as the page's (the switch closes a connection whose message is over 64 KB: 1009) */
const NET_BUNDLE_MAX = 32 << 10;
function bundled(q) {
  const out = [];
  let part = [], bytes = 4;
  for (const f of q) {
    const n = 4 + 4 * 64 + f.length;
    if (part.length && bytes + n > NET_BUNDLE_MAX) { out.push(...bundle1(part)); part = []; bytes = 4; }
    part.push(f); bytes += n;
  }
  if (part.length) out.push(...bundle1(part));
  return out;
}
function bundle1(q) {
  const e = [], last = new Map();
  for (const f of q) {
    const dst = f.readUInt32BE(8);
    let i = (last.get(dst) ?? -1) + 1;
    for (; i < e.length; i++) {
      const g = e[i].f;
      if (e[i].dst.length < 64 && g.length === f.length && !f.compare(g, 0, 8, 0, 8) && !f.compare(g, 12, g.length, 12, f.length)) break;
    }
    if (i < e.length) e[i].dst.push(dst); else e.push({ f, dst: [dst] });
    last.set(dst, i);
  }
  if (e.length === 1 && e[0].dst.length === 1) return [e[0].f];
  const n = 4 + e.reduce((a, x) => a + 4 + (x.dst.length > 1 ? 4 * x.dst.length : 0) + x.f.length, 0), b = Buffer.alloc(n);
  b[0] = 32;
  let at = 4;
  for (const { f, dst } of e) {
    const k = dst.length > 1 ? dst.length : 0;
    b[at] = k; b.writeUInt16BE(f.length, at + 2);
    for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) b.writeUInt32BE(dst[j], at + 4 + 4 * j);
    f.copy(b, at + 4 + 4 * k); at += 4 + 4 * k + f.length;
  }
  return [b];
}
class Bot {
  constructor(i) {
    this.i = i; this.name = `${PREFIX}${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`; this.vip = 0; this.ready = false; this.car = CARS[i % CARS.length];
    this.id = (Math.random() * 0xfffffffe + 1) >>> 0;
    this.bundles = false; this.q = [];                     // the switch takes bundles; what waits to go as one
  }
  async start() {
    this.inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, { crowd: {
      send: (ip, port, ptr, n) => this.out(ip, port, ptr, n),
      event: (ev, ptr, n) => {
        const t = Buffer.from(this.mem().subarray(ptr, ptr + n)).toString('latin1');
        if (ev === 1) st.joins++;
        else if (ev === 2) { if (t.includes('out of range')) st.outOfRange++; else { st.otherLeaves++; tally(t); } }
        else if (ev !== 4) { st.notes++; tally(t); }
      },
    } });
    this.x = this.inst.exports;
    const ws = this.ws = new WebSocket(BASE.replace(/^http/, 'ws') + '/lan', { headers: { 'X-Forwarded-For': `10.200.${this.i >> 8}.${this.i & 255}` } });
    ws.binaryType = 'nodebuffer';
    ws.on('error', e => console.log(`${this.name}: ${e.message}`));
    ws.on('close', (c, r) => { if (this.ready) console.log(`${this.name}: closed ${c} ${r}`); this.ready = false; });
    ws.on('message', (d, bin) => {
      if (!bin) {
        const m = JSON.parse(String(d));
        if (m.t === 'welcome' && !this.vip) {
          this.vip = m.vip >>> 0; this.bundles = BUNDLE;
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'hello', name: this.name, ...(BUNDLE ? { bundle: 1 } : {}) }));
          const io = this.x.crowd_io(), m8 = this.mem();
          const flag = FLAGS.length ? FLAGS[(this.i ?? 0) % FLAGS.length] : '';
          const parts = PARTS[(this.i ?? 0) % PARTS.length];
          const plate = PLATES.length ? PLATES[(this.i ?? 0) % PLATES.length] : '';
          const b = Buffer.from(`${this.name}\0${this.car}\0${parts}\0${flag}\0${plate}\0`, 'latin1'); m8.set(b, io);
          if (LINKS) this.x.crowd_links(LINKS);
          if (OPEN) this.x.crowd_open(OPEN);
          if (DENTS) this.x.crowd_dents(DENTS, DENTS_MS, (this.id * 2654435761) >>> 0);
          this.x.crowd_init(this.id, roomHash(ROOM), roomHash(CREW), HUB, PORT, bhash(this.car), STATES, nowUs());
          this.ready = true;
        }
        return;
      }
      st.inMsg++;
      if (d[0] === 32) {
        for (let at = 4; at + 4 <= d.length;) {
          const f = at + 4 + 4 * d[at], end = f + d.readUInt16BE(at + 2);
          if (end > d.length) break;
          this.take(d.subarray(f, end)); at = end;
        }
      } else this.take(d);
      this.flush();
    });
  }
  /** a datagram from the switch into the core */
  take(d) {
    if (d.length < 16 || d[0] !== 1 || d.readUInt16BE(14) !== PORT || d.length - 16 > 1200) return;
    st.inDg++; st.inB += d.length;
    this.mem().set(d.subarray(16), this.x.crowd_io());
    this.x.crowd_recv(d.readUInt32BE(4), d.readUInt16BE(12), d.length - 16, nowUs());
  }
  mem() { return new Uint8Array(this.x.memory.buffer); }
  out(ip, port, ptr, n) {
    if (!this.ready || this.ws.readyState !== 1) return;
    const f = Buffer.alloc(16 + n);
    f[0] = 1; f.writeUInt32BE(this.vip, 4); f.writeUInt32BE(ip >>> 0, 8); f.writeUInt16BE(PORT, 12); f.writeUInt16BE(port, 14);
    f.set(this.mem().subarray(ptr, ptr + n), 16);
    st.outDg++; st.outB += f.length;
    if (this.bundles) this.q.push(f); else { this.ws.send(f); st.outMsg++; }
  }
  /** what waits, as bundles */
  flush(now = false) {
    if (!this.q.length) return;
    if (HOLD && !now && performance.now() - (this.sent ?? 0) < HOLD && !this.q.some(f => f[21] === 3 && f.readUInt32BE(8) !== HUB)) return;
    if (this.ws.readyState === 1) for (const m of bundled(this.q)) { this.ws.send(m); st.outMsg++; }
    this.q = []; this.sent = performance.now();
  }
  tick(t, snap = true) {
    if (!this.ready) return;
    const racing = RACE.length === 4 && this.i + 1 >= RACE[0] && this.i + 1 <= RACE[1] && t >= RACE[2] && t < RACE[3];
    const paused = PAUSED.length === 2 && this.i + 1 >= PAUSED[0] && this.i + 1 <= PAUSED[1];
    if (racing !== !!this.racing) {
      this.racing = racing; this.x.crowd_status(racing ? 3 : paused ? 5 : 2);
      console.log(`roam-crowd: t=${t.toFixed(0)}s ${this.name} ${racing ? 'in a race' : 'back in free roam'}`);
    }
    if (paused && !this.paused) { this.paused = true; this.x.crowd_status(5); }
    if (racing || !snap) { this.x.crowd_wait(nowUs()); this.flush(); return; }
    const { p, v, h, status } = track(t, this.i);
    // (a meet's --fidget: a shop or the pause menu a while; in a shop the game sends no car)
    const want = status ?? 2;
    if (want !== (this.tstatus ?? 2)) { this.tstatus = want; this.x.crowd_status(want); }
    if (want === 4) { this.x.crowd_wait(nowUs()); this.flush(); return; }
    this.x.crowd_tick(nowUs(), p[0], p[1], p[2], v[0], v[1], v[2], h ?? Math.atan2(v[1], v[0]));
    if (LOBBIES.length && this.i % +LOBBIES[0] === 0 && t - (this.advT ?? -9) >= 1) {
      const races = LOBBIES[1].split(',');
      this.advT = t;
      this.lob ??= { id: (this.id ^ 0x5a5a) >>> 0, race: bhash(races[(this.i / +LOBBIES[0] | 0) % races.length]), x: Math.round(p[0]), y: Math.round(p[1]), n: 1 + this.i % 5 };
      this.x.crowd_lobby(this.lob.id, this.lob.race, this.lob.x, this.lob.y, this.lob.n, 6);
    }
    this.flush();
  }
  stop() { if (this.ready) { this.x.crowd_stop(); this.flush(true); } setTimeout(() => this.ws.close(), 200); }
}

const bots = [];
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const b = new Bot(FIRST + i); bots.push(b); await b.start(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, STAGGER)); }
const t0 = performance.now();
let passes = 0;
const timer = setInterval(() => {
  const t = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000, snap = !LOOP_MS || passes++ % Math.round(50 / LOOP_MS) === 0;
  for (const b of bots) b.tick(t, snap);
}, LOOP_MS || 50);
let last = { ...st }, lastT = performance.now();
const samples = [];
const report = setInterval(() => {
  const dt = (performance.now() - lastT) / 1000, on = bots.filter(b => b.ready), peers = on.map(b => b.x.crowd_peers());
  const s = { t: Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 1000), players: on.length, peersMin: Math.min(...peers), peersMean: +(peers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / Math.max(1, peers.length)).toFixed(2),
    peersMax: Math.max(...peers), inPerS: Math.round((st.inDg - last.inDg) / dt), outPerS: Math.round((st.outDg - last.outDg) / dt),
    inKBs: +((st.inB - last.inB) / dt / 1024).toFixed(1), outKBs: +((st.outB - last.outB) / dt / 1024).toFixed(1),
    inMsgPerS: Math.round((st.inMsg - last.inMsg) / dt), outMsgPerS: Math.round((st.outMsg - last.outMsg) / dt),
    joins: st.joins - last.joins, outOfRange: st.outOfRange - last.outOfRange, otherLeaves: st.otherLeaves - last.otherLeaves };
  samples.push(s);
  if (track.standing) s.standing = track.standing();
  console.log(`roam-crowd: t=${s.t}s players ${s.players}${track.standing ? ` (${s.standing} standing)` : ''}, peers ${s.peersMin}/${s.peersMean}/${s.peersMax}, datagrams ${s.inPerS}/s in ${s.outPerS}/s out ` +
    `(${s.inKBs} / ${s.outKBs} KB/s with the switch's 16-byte header) in ${s.inMsgPerS} / ${s.outMsgPerS} messages a second, ` +
    `joins ${s.joins}, out of range ${s.outOfRange}, other leaves ${s.otherLeaves}`);
  last = { ...st }; lastT = performance.now();
}, 10_000);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, SECONDS * 1000));
clearInterval(timer); clearInterval(report);
for (const b of bots) b.stop();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
if (OUTF) fs.writeFileSync(OUTF, JSON.stringify({ n: N, seconds: SECONDS, track: TRACK || 'circles', totals: st, why, samples }, null, 1));
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(why).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8)) console.log(`roam-crowd:   ${v} x ${k}`);
console.log(`roam-crowd: done, ${st.joins} joins, ${st.outOfRange} out of range, ${st.otherLeaves} other leaves, ${st.notes} notes`);
process.exit(0);

//        (an instance's own settings after its script: --a Alice:roam_mp_ram_a.txt:NFSU2_ROAM_COLLIDE=0,K=V; a comma

    : new URLSearchParams({ wasm: '/game.wasm', pages: '16384', arg: '/data/SPEED2.EXE',
      reg: '/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt', script: `/tests/scripts/${script}`, save: `roam-${name}`, net: name });

  for (const kv of opts('page-arg')) q.append(kv.slice(0, kv.indexOf('=')), kv.slice(kv.indexOf('=') + 1));

let serverDied = null;                        // our server ended by itself: why
async function startServer() {
  const certs = HTTPS ? makeTestCerts(path.join(OUT, 'certs')) : null;
  const c = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA,
    ...(certs ? ['--port', String(HTTPS_PORT), '--tls-cert', certs.cert, '--tls-key', certs.key] : []),
    '--http-port', String(HTTP_PORT), '--dev', ...(PLAY ? ['--artifacts', OUT] : [])]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  own(c);
  c.stdout.pipe(serverLog, { end: false }); c.stderr.pipe(serverLog, { end: false });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start')), 20000);
    c.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    c.on('exit', code => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error(`server exited (${code})`)); });
  });
  serverLog.write(`--- server pid ${c.pid} up at ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);
  c.on('exit', (code, sig) => {
    if (server !== c) return;                 // stopServer's
    serverDied = `server-died(${code ?? sig})`;
    serverLog.write(`--- server ended by itself (${code ?? sig}) at ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);
  });
  return c;
}
async function stopServer() {
  if (!server) return;
  const c = server; server = null;
  await stop(c);
  serverLog.write(`--- server stopped at ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);
}

// Open a page in Playwright-driven Chrome, stream its console, wait for document.title === 'DONE'.
//   node web/tools/run-page.mjs <url> [timeout-ms] [--headed] [--profile <dir>]
// --profile keeps a Chrome user-data directory between runs (localStorage,
// OPFS and Chrome's shader cache persist, as in a real browser).

import { pickBrowser } from './browser.mjs';

  page = ctx.pages()[0] ?? await ctx.newPage();

// scenarios (input scripts), environment and pass criteria, run through the
// browser host's test page (hostcheck.html) with no renderer, audio or input
// layer attached: draws are dropped (no frame dumps), the mixer runs on the

// (runtime/web/input_web.c).
//
//   node web/tools/run-suite.mjs [options] [scenario ...]
//     --base URL        the local server, started with --dev (default http://localhost:8611)
//     --run NAME        output directory out/web/runs/NAME (default suite-<date>-<time>)
//     --jobs N          scenarios at once, each in its own browser context (default: a third of the cores, 1 to 4;
//                       the longest first, by the last run's times)
//     --env K=V         extra environment for every scenario (repeatable)
//     --timeout-scale X multiply every scenario's time limit (default 1)
//     --script FILE     an ad-hoc scenario: tests/scripts/FILE (with --marker, --name, --net NAME;
//                       NFSU2_SAVE_SEED seeds its save directory)
//     --save-out DIR    each scenario's save directory afterwards, as DIR/<scenario>/ (a seed for the next run)

//                       except while it reads a file, so a scenario takes less time; scenarios with --net / a net
//                       column, and free roam (NFSU2_ROAM), run as usual

function urlFor(s) {
  const env = { ...SUITE_ENV, ...Object.fromEntries(s.extra.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(e => e.split('='))), ...extraEnv,
    ...(opt.fast && !s.net ? { NFSU2_FAST: '1' } : {}) };
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  q.set('wasm', '/game.wasm'); q.set('pages', '16384'); q.append('arg', '/data/SPEED2.EXE');
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(env)) q.append('env', `${k}=${v}`);
  q.set('save', saveName(s)); if (!s.seed) q.set('fresh', '');     // a seeded save dir is prepared by seedSave
  q.set('reg', opt.reg);
  q.set('script', s.script.startsWith('/') ? s.script : `/tests/scripts/${s.script}`);
  if (s.net) q.set('net', s.net);
  return `${opt.base}/test/hostcheck.html?${q}`;
}

function judge(s, log, exit) {
  const why = [];
  if (exit === null) why.push('no-exit'); else if (exit !== 0) why.push(`exit=${exit}`);
  if (!log.includes('quit at guest frame')) why.push('no-quit');
  if (s.marker && !log.includes(s.marker)) why.push(`missing:'${s.marker}'`);
  why.push(...logWhy(log, { allow: s.allow }));
  why.noted = logWhy(log).filter(w => s.allow?.includes(w));
  const chk = path.join(ROOT, 'tests/checks', `${s.name}.sh`);
  if (fs.existsSync(chk)) {
    let out = '', ok = true;
    try { out = execFileSync(chk, [path.join(OUT, `${s.name}.log`)], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); }
    catch (e) { ok = false; out = String(e.stdout ?? '') + String(e.stderr ?? ''); }
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${s.name}.check.txt`), out);
    if (!ok) why.push(`check-failed(${out.trim().split('\n').pop()})`);
  }
  return why;
}

// the page's OPFS save directory dir into the folder out (files, as the page has them)
async function saveOut(page, dir, out) {
  try {
    const files = await page.evaluate(async dir => {
      const got = [];
      async function walk(d, rel) {
        for await (const [name, h] of d.entries()) {
          const r = rel ? `${rel}/${name}` : name;
          if (h.kind === 'directory') await walk(h, r);
          else {
            const b = new Uint8Array(await (await h.getFile()).arrayBuffer());
            let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
            got.push([r, btoa(s)]);
          }
        }
      }
      await walk(await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getDirectoryHandle(dir), '');
      return got;
    }, dir);
    fs.rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
    for (const [rel, b64] of files) {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(out, rel)), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, rel), Buffer.from(b64, 'base64'));
    }
    return `${files.length} files to ${out}`;
  } catch (e) { return `failed: ${e}`; }
}

async function runOne(browser, s) {
  const logPath = path.join(OUT, `${s.name}.log`);
  const lines = [];
  const ctx = await browser.newContext();
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  let exit = null;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  page.on('console', m => {
    const t = m.text();
    // the test page prefixes game output with [tid] or [tid!] (stderr)
    const g = /^\[\d+!?\] ([^]*)$/.exec(t);
    if (g) lines.push(g[1]);
    else {
      const e = /^EXIT (-?\d+)$/.exec(t);
      if (e) exit = +e[1];
      lines.push(t);
    }
  });
  page.on('pageerror', e => lines.push(`PAGEERROR ${e}`));
  page.on('crash', () => lines.push('CRASH (renderer process)'));
  const limit = s.alarm * opt.scale * 1000;
  if (s.seed) lines.push(`[suite] save seed: ${await seedSave(page, opt.base, saveName(s), SEED)} files from ${SEED}`);
  await page.goto(urlFor(s));
  let timedOut = false;
  try { await page.waitForFunction(() => document.title === 'DONE', null, { timeout: limit, polling: 1000 }); }
  catch { timedOut = true; lines.push(`TIME LIMIT REACHED: the web suite runner stopped the run after ${(limit / 1000).toFixed(0)} s`); }
  if (opt.saveOut) lines.push(`[suite] save out: ${await saveOut(page, saveName(s), path.join(opt.saveOut, s.name))}`);
  const wall = (Date.now() - t0) / 1000;
  await ctx.close().catch(() => {});
  const log = lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  fs.writeFileSync(logPath, log);
  const why = judge(s, log, timedOut ? null : exit);
  const st = (log.match(/^\[status\] .*$/gm) ?? []).pop()?.replace(/^\[status\] /, '') ?? '';
  const frame = /quit at guest frame (\d+)/.exec(log)?.[1] ?? '-';
  return { name: s.name, pass: why.length === 0, why, noted: why.noted, wall, frame, status: st, log: path.relative(ROOT, logPath) };
}

const results = [], skipped = [];
const queue = scen.filter(s => { if (s.blocked) { skipped.push(s); return false; } return true; });
// the longest first, so that the jobs end together instead of a long one starting last: each scenario's wall time in
// the latest run that had it (out/web/runs/*/summary.json), else its time limit
const lastWall = {};
const runsDir = path.join(ROOT, 'out/web/runs');
for (const d of (fs.existsSync(runsDir) ? fs.readdirSync(runsDir) : []).map(d => path.join(runsDir, d, 'summary.json'))
  .filter(f => fs.existsSync(f)).sort((a, b) => fs.statSync(a).mtimeMs - fs.statSync(b).mtimeMs)) {
  try { for (const r of JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d, 'utf8')).results ?? []) if (r.wall) lastWall[r.name] = r.wall; } catch {}
}
queue.sort((a, b) => (lastWall[b.name] ?? b.alarm) - (lastWall[a.name] ?? a.alarm));
// (nothing to run, every scenario named not runnable yet: no browser, only the summaries)
const browser = queue.length ? await chromium.launch({ ...pickBrowser(), headless: true,
  args: ['--enable-unsafe-webgpu', ...(process.env.CHROME_ARGS ? process.env.CHROME_ARGS.split(' ') : [])] }) : null;
console.log(`web suite ${run}: ${queue.length} scenario(s), ${opt.jobs} at a time${opt.fast ? ', fast-forward' : ''}, logs in ${path.relative(ROOT, OUT)}/`);
async function worker() {
  for (let s; (s = queue.shift());) {
    const r = await runOne(browser, s);
    results.push(r);
    console.log(`${r.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${r.name.padEnd(11)} ${r.wall.toFixed(0).padStart(4)} s  frame ${r.frame}${r.pass ? '' : '  ' + r.why.join(' ')}` +
      (r.noted.length ? `  (known: ${r.noted.join(' ')})` : ''));
  }
}
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, opt.jobs) }, worker));
await browser?.close();

const order = scen.map(s => s.name);
results.sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a.name) - order.indexOf(b.name));
const rows = [
  '| scenario | result | wall | quit frame | reason / last [status] |', '|---|---|---|---|---|',
  ...results.map(r => `| ${r.name} | ${r.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | ${r.wall.toFixed(0)} s | ${r.frame} | ${r.pass ? r.status.replace(/\|/g, '/') : r.why.join(' ')} |`),
  ...skipped.map(s => `| ${s.name} | not runnable yet | - | - | ${s.blocked} |`),
];
const pass = results.filter(r => r.pass).length;
const sum = `web suite ${run}: ${pass} passed, ${results.length - pass} failed, ${skipped.length} not runnable yet\n` +
  `${MODULE ? MODULE + '\n' : ''}\n${rows.join('\n')}\n`;
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'summary.txt'), sum);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'summary.json'), JSON.stringify({ run, module: MODULE, env: { ...SUITE_ENV, ...extraEnv }, fast: opt.fast, results, skipped: skipped.map(s => ({ name: s.name, why: s.blocked })) }, null, 1));
console.log('\n' + sum);
process.exitCode = results.length === pass ? 0 : 1;

// A save tree (NFSU2_SAVE_SEED, a player's "Download a backup" unzipped, the
// Mac port's work/seed/...) written into a page's OPFS save directory, from a
// page of the server's origin; the test page then runs without &fresh.
// Used by run-suite.mjs and roam-pair.mjs (--seed).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export async function seedSave(page, base, dir, tree) {
  const files = [];
  (function walk(d, rel) {
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const r = rel ? `${rel}/${e.name}` : e.name;
      if (e.isDirectory()) walk(path.join(d, e.name), r);
      else if (e.isFile()) files.push([r, fs.readFileSync(path.join(d, e.name)).toString('base64')]);
    }
  })(tree, '');
  await page.goto(`${base}/players`);
  return page.evaluate(async ([dir, files]) => {
    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
    try { await root.removeEntry(dir, { recursive: true }); } catch { /* none yet */ }
    const top = await root.getDirectoryHandle(dir, { create: true });
    for (const [rel, b64] of files) {
      const parts = rel.split('/'); let d = top;
      for (const p of parts.slice(0, -1)) d = await d.getDirectoryHandle(p, { create: true });
      const w = await (await d.getFileHandle(parts.at(-1), { create: true })).createWritable();
      await w.write(Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), c => c.charCodeAt(0))); await w.close();
    }
    return files.length;
  }, [dir, files]);
}

// The server the tests and tools start: the Rust binary out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-server, built by
// web/server-rs/build.sh, or $NFSU2_SERVER_BIN (another build of it: another worktree's, an older one as a negative
// control):
//   spawn(...serverCommand(args), opts)
// Its defaults (the page, the module, the state folder) are this checkout's: NFSU2_REPO, set here for the children
// unless it is set already (the binary's own default is the checkout it was built in).
// On Windows the binary is Linux's, so it runs in WSL: wsl.exe -e (the default distribution, or $NFSU2_WSL_DISTRO),
// with the binary and every argument that is a Windows path as WSL sees them, and NFSU2_REPO and the NFSU2_<OPTION>
// variables passed through WSLENV.  Killing wsl.exe stops the server in WSL too.
// The checkout's own binary older than its sources (web/server-rs's src folders, the Cargo files) would test the
// server of before: the tests (node --test) refuse it, the tools say so.  $NFSU2_SERVER_BIN is taken as it is.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const WIN = process.platform === 'win32';
export const SERVER_BIN = process.env.NFSU2_SERVER_BIN || path.join(REPO, 'out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-server');
process.env.NFSU2_REPO ||= REPO;

if (WIN) {
  // NFSU2_<OPTION> of the options with a value (/p: a path, translated), and the server's knobs
  const paths = ['REPO', 'DATA', 'DIST', 'WASM', 'STATE', 'TLS_CERT', 'TLS_KEY', 'ARTIFACTS', 'ONLINE_TRACE'];
  const plain = ['PORT', 'HTTP_PORT', 'BIND', 'TRUSTED_PROXIES', 'REAL_IP_HEADER', 'MAX_PEERS', 'LAN_IMPAIR', 'HOST',
    'ONLINE', 'ROAM_HUB', 'THREADS', 'BUNDLE_MS', 'BUNDLE_MAX_MS', 'BUNDLE_BUDGET', 'LAN_SNDBUF', 'SESSIONS',
    'COMPRESS_THREADS'];
  const have = (process.env.WSLENV || '').split(':').filter(Boolean);
  process.env.WSLENV = [...new Set([...have, ...paths.map(n => `NFSU2_${n}/p`), ...plain.map(n => `NFSU2_${n}`)])].join(':');
}

/** a Windows path as WSL sees it (C:\x -> /mnt/c/x, \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\x -> /x); anything else as it is */
export function wslPath(p) {
  const s = String(p);
  const drive = /^([A-Za-z]):[\\/](.*)$/.exec(s);
  if (drive) return `/mnt/${drive[1].toLowerCase()}/${drive[2].replace(/\\/g, '/')}`;
  const share = /^[\\/]{2}(?:wsl\.localhost|wsl\$)[\\/][^\\/]+[\\/]?(.*)$/i.exec(s);
  return share ? '/' + share[1].replace(/\\/g, '/') : s;
}

/** a source of the server newer than bin, or '' (the checkout's own binary only) */
let staleChecked = null;
export function newerServerSource(bin = SERVER_BIN) {
  if (staleChecked !== null) return staleChecked;
  staleChecked = '';
  const built = !process.env.NFSU2_SERVER_BIN && !WIN && fs.statSync(bin, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.mtimeMs;
  if (!built) return staleChecked;
  const rs = path.join(REPO, 'web/server-rs');
  const dirs = [path.join(rs, 'src'), ...fs.readdirSync(path.join(rs, 'crates')).map(c => path.join(rs, 'crates', c, 'src'))];
  const files = [path.join(rs, 'Cargo.toml'), path.join(rs, 'Cargo.lock'), ...fs.readdirSync(path.join(rs, 'crates')).map(c => path.join(rs, 'crates', c, 'Cargo.toml'))];
  for (const d of dirs) if (fs.existsSync(d)) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d, { recursive: true })) files.push(path.join(d, String(f)));
  let at = built;
  for (const f of files) {
    const st = fs.statSync(f, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
    if (st?.isFile() && st.mtimeMs > at) { at = st.mtimeMs; staleChecked = path.relative(REPO, f); }
  }
  return staleChecked;
}

/** [command, argv] that starts the server with args */
export function serverCommand(args, bin = SERVER_BIN) {
  const distro = process.env.NFSU2_WSL_DISTRO;
  // where this machine sees the binary (on Windows a WSL path is looked for through its share, if the distribution
  // is named)
  const seen = !WIN || !bin.startsWith('/') ? bin : distro ? `\\\\wsl.localhost\\${distro}${bin.replace(/\//g, '\\')}` : '';
  if (seen && !fs.existsSync(seen)) {
    throw new Error(`no server at ${bin}: build it with web/server-rs/build.sh${WIN ? ' (in WSL)' : ''}, or set NFSU2_SERVER_BIN`);
  }
  const newer = bin === SERVER_BIN ? newerServerSource(bin) : '';
  if (newer) {
    const msg = `${path.relative(REPO, bin)} is older than ${newer}: build it again with web/server-rs/build.sh (or set NFSU2_SERVER_BIN)`;
    if (process.env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) throw new Error(msg);
    console.error(`server-cmd: warning: ${msg}`);
  }
  if (!WIN) return [bin, args];
  // WSLENV hands WSL every name it lists, an unset one as empty: drop those, then the server takes the shell's place
  const unsetEmpty = `for v in $(env | grep -o '^NFSU2_[A-Z_]*=$' | tr -d =); do unset "$v"; done; exec "$@"`;
  return ['wsl.exe', [...(distro ? ['-d', distro] : []), '-e', 'sh', '-c', unsetEmpty, 'sh', wslPath(bin), ...args.map(wslPath)]];
}

// Side by side: the same load against builds of the server (web/server-rs, built with web/server-rs/build.sh), one
// after the other, on this machine: a change against main's, say.
//
//   node web/tools/server-compare.mjs [--load roam,online,http] [--n 120] [--seconds 60] [--servers a=<bin>,b=<bin>]
//        [--port 8691] [--data <game folder>] [--out <dir>] [--spread 3000] [--rate 20] [--gen-threads 8]
//        [--server-cpus 0-11] [--gen-cpus 12-23] [--server-env NFSU2_THREADS=8,NFSU2_BUNDLE_MS=8]
//   --server-cpus, --gen-cpus  the CPUs (taskset) the server and the load generators may use: apart, so that on
//                              one machine they do not take each other's cores, as on two machines
//   --server-env               environment for the server (its knobs: NFSU2_THREADS, NFSU2_BUNDLE_MS)
//   --servers                  name=binary for each (default rust=out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-server; a name alone is
//                              that binary too)
//
// Each server starts fresh for each load (its own state folder, --max-peers its most: 4000 for Rust,
// 2000 for the others; --dev), and while the load runs
// its process is sampled every second (CPU time and resident memory, from /proc), and a probe measures the
// switch's answer to a ping ({"t":"ping"}, a page's own measure of the switch) every 100 ms.  The loads:
//   roam    web/tools/roam-crowd.mjs --bundle: n players in free roam, in one spot (each with up to 32 friends)
//   crowd   out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-roamload (web/server-rs/build.sh): n simulated players in free roam, as many as a
//           full server holds (4000, 2000 for Node), spread over --spread metres (3000), each sending --rate snapshots a second
//           (20) to every friend the hub gives it; light enough to leave the cores to the server.  It reports the
//           friends each player has, the snapshots lost on the way, a snapshot's delay from player to player, the
//           players' own pings, and the messages each way; --gen-threads (8): its threads
//   mix     crowd and online at once, as nfsu2.xyz has them (2026-10-21: 850-1075 players, ~80 % in free roam, ~10 %
//           in Online mode): n - m players in free roam and m (--mix-online, n / 10) Online clients
//   online  web/tools/online-load.mjs: n clients in the Online lobby (logins, chat, games, races, abuse)
//   http    n clients fetching the game data's runs (/data-blocks/, compressed) as the page's workers do, each
//           its own client address (X-Forwarded-For) with 4 requests in flight on keep-alive connections
// The probe, and the HTTP clients (in 4 processes), run apart from this script, so that none of them waits behind
// another.  Besides the process's CPU, its threads' (busiestThread: the share of one core its busiest thread used,
// the ceiling of a server that runs everything on one; busyThreads: how many used a tenth of one or more), and the
// load generator's own CPU (a generator at its limit measures itself, not the server).  Prints one table and writes
// <out>/compare.json.  Linux (the /proc sampling).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import http from 'node:http';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { serverCommand, SERVER_BIN } from './server-cmd.mjs';

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 && i + 1 < argv.length ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const LOADS = opt('load', 'roam,online,http').split(',');
const BINS = Object.fromEntries(opt('servers', 'rust').split(',').map(s => s.split('=')).map(([n, b]) => [n, b ? path.resolve(b) : SERVER_BIN]));
const SERVERS = Object.keys(BINS);
const N = +opt('n', 120), SECONDS = +opt('seconds', 60), PORT = +opt('port', 8691);
const DATA = opt('data', process.env.NFSU2_DATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'projects/nsfu2/Need for Speed - Underground 2'));
const OUT = path.resolve(opt('out', path.join(REPO, 'out/web/server-compare')));
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const pct = (a, p) => { if (!a.length) return null; const s = [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y); return +s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.floor(p / 100 * s.length))].toFixed(2); };
const TICK = 100;   // /proc's clock ticks a second (USER_HZ)
const SERVER_CPUS = opt('server-cpus', ''), GEN_CPUS = opt('gen-cpus', '');
const SERVER_ENV = Object.fromEntries(opt('server-env', '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map(kv => kv.split('=')));
/** [cmd, args] under taskset when cpus are given */
const pinned = (cpus, cmd, args) => (cpus ? ['taskset', ['-c', cpus, cmd, ...args]] : [cmd, args]);

async function startServer(impl, port, tag) {
  const state = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `nfsu2-compare-${impl}-`));
  const [cmd, args] = serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--http-port', String(port), '--max-peers', '4000', '--dev', '--state', state],
    BINS[impl]);
  const c = spawn(...pinned(SERVER_CPUS, cmd, args), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: { ...process.env, ...SERVER_ENV } });
  const log = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(OUT, `server-${impl}-${tag}.log`));
  c.stdout.pipe(log); c.stderr.pipe(log);
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let o = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`${impl}: no start-up line`)), 30_000);
    c.stdout.on('data', d => { o += d; if (o.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    c.on('exit', code => rej(new Error(`${impl} exited ${code}`)));
  });
  // the module's compression at the start is not the load's
  await sleep(4000);
  return { c, state, stop: async () => { const gone = new Promise(r => c.once('exit', r)); c.kill('SIGTERM'); await Promise.race([gone, sleep(5000)]); c.kill('SIGKILL'); fs.rmSync(state, { recursive: true, force: true }); } };
}

/** CPU seconds (user + system) and resident MB of a process */
function usage(pid) {
  try {
    const st = fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/stat`, 'utf8').split(') ')[1].split(' ');
    const rss = +/VmRSS:\s+(\d+)/.exec(fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/status`, 'utf8'))[1] / 1024;
    return { cpu: (+st[11] + +st[12]) / TICK, rss };
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** CPU seconds of each thread of a process: tid -> seconds */
function threadCpu(pid) {
  const m = new Map();
  try {
    for (const t of fs.readdirSync(`/proc/${pid}/task`)) {
      try { const st = fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/task/${t}/stat`, 'utf8').split(') ')[1].split(' '); m.set(t, (+st[11] + +st[12]) / TICK); } catch { /* gone */ }
    }
  } catch { /* gone */ }
  return m;
}
function threadShares(a, b, wall) {
  const shares = [...b].map(([t, c]) => (c - (a.get(t) ?? 0)) / wall);
  return { busiestThread: shares.length ? +Math.max(...shares).toFixed(2) : null, busyThreads: shares.filter(x => x >= 0.1).length };
}

/** the switch's answer to a page's ping, every 100 ms */
function pingProbe(port) {
  const rtt = []; let lost = 0, id = 0;
  const sent = new Map();
  const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${port}/lan`, { headers: { 'x-forwarded-for': '198.18.255.254' } });
  let timer = null;
  ws.on('message', (d, bin) => {
    if (bin) return;
    const m = JSON.parse(String(d));
    if (m.t === 'welcome') { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'hello', name: 'probe' })); timer = setInterval(() => { sent.set(++id, performance.now()); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'ping', id })); }, 100); }
    if (m.t === 'pong' && sent.has(m.id)) { rtt.push(performance.now() - sent.get(m.id)); sent.delete(m.id); }
  });
  ws.on('error', () => {});
  return { stop: () => { clearInterval(timer); lost = sent.size; ws.terminate(); return { p50: pct(rtt, 50), p90: pct(rtt, 90), p99: pct(rtt, 99), max: pct(rtt, 100), n: rtt.length, lost }; } };
}

function run(cmd, args, file) {
  return new Promise(res => {
    const c = spawn(...pinned(GEN_CPUS, cmd, args), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], cwd: REPO });
    const log = fs.createWriteStream(file);
    c.stdout.pipe(log); c.stderr.pipe(log);
    c.on('exit', code => res(code));
  });
}

// ---- the loads ----
async function roamLoad(port, tag) {
  const outf = path.join(OUT, `roam-${tag}.json`);
  await run(process.execPath, [path.join(REPO, 'web/tools/roam-crowd.mjs'), '--base', `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, '--n', String(N),
    '--seconds', String(SECONDS), '--bundle', '--stagger', '20', '--out', outf], path.join(OUT, `roam-${tag}.log`));
  const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outf, 'utf8'));
  const late = j.samples.slice(1);   // the first ten seconds are the players joining
  const mean = k => late.length ? Math.round(late.reduce((a, s) => a + s[k], 0) / late.length) : null;
  return { peersMean: late.length ? +(late.reduce((a, s) => a + s.peersMean, 0) / late.length).toFixed(1) : null,
    datagramsInPerS: mean('inPerS'), datagramsOutPerS: mean('outPerS'), messagesInPerS: mean('inMsgPerS'), messagesOutPerS: mean('outMsgPerS'),
    otherLeaves: j.totals.otherLeaves };
}

const SPREAD = +opt('spread', 3000), RATE = +opt('rate', 20), GEN_THREADS = +opt('gen-threads', 8);
async function crowdLoad(port, tag, n = N, first = 0) {
  const outf = path.join(OUT, `crowd-${tag}.json`);
  const bin = process.env.NFSU2_ROAMLOAD || path.join(REPO, 'out/web/server-rs/nfsu2-roamload');
  if (!fs.existsSync(bin)) throw new Error(`no ${bin} (web/server-rs/build.sh)`);
  const c = spawn(...pinned(GEN_CPUS, bin, ['--base', `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, '--n', String(n), '--first', String(first), '--seconds', String(SECONDS),
    '--spread', String(SPREAD), '--rate', String(RATE), '--threads', String(GEN_THREADS), '--stagger-ms', String(Math.max(1, Math.round(10_000 / n))), '--out', outf]),
    { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const log = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(OUT, `crowd-${tag}.log`));
  c.stdout.pipe(log); c.stderr.pipe(log);
  const u0 = usage(c.pid), t0 = performance.now();
  let u1 = u0;
  const sampler = setInterval(() => { u1 = usage(c.pid) ?? u1; }, 1000);
  await new Promise(res => c.on('exit', res));
  clearInterval(sampler);
  const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outf, 'utf8'));
  // the samples after the players joined and the hub linked them (10 s)
  const ramp = 10 + 10, late = j.samples.filter(s => s.t > ramp);
  const mean = k => late.length ? Math.round(late.reduce((a, s) => a + s[k], 0) / late.length) : null;
  const st = j.summary.steady;
  return { players: late.length ? Math.min(...late.map(s => s.players)) : null,
    peersMean: late.length ? +(late.reduce((a, s) => a + s.peersMean, 0) / late.length).toFixed(1) : null,
    deliveriesPerS: mean('deliveriesPerS'), datagramsInPerS: mean('dgramsInPerS'), msgsToPlayersPerS: mean('msgsInPerS'), msgsFromPlayersPerS: mean('msgsOutPerS'),
    snapLossPct: st.snapLossPct, snapDelayMs: st.latencyMs, playersPingMs: st.pingMs, refused: j.summary.refused, closed: j.summary.closed,
    generatorCores: u0 && u1 ? +((u1.cpu - u0.cpu) / ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000)).toFixed(2) : null };
}

/** free roam and Online mode at once: the crowd's players from bot 4096 on (198.18.16.0 and up), so that no client
 *  address is both an Online client's (online-load.mjs: 198.18.0.x) and a player's */
async function mixLoad(port, tag) {
  const m = +opt('mix-online', Math.round(N / 10));
  const [crowd, online] = await Promise.all([crowdLoad(port, tag, N - m, 4096), onlineLoad(port, tag, m)]);
  return { ...crowd, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(online).map(([k, v]) => ['online.' + k, v])) };
}

async function onlineLoad(port, tag, clients = N) {
  const out = path.join(OUT, `online-${tag}`);
  await run(process.execPath, [path.join(REPO, 'web/tools/online-load.mjs'), '--base', `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, '--clients', String(clients),
    '--seconds', String(SECONDS), '--out', out], path.join(OUT, `online-${tag}.log`));
  const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, 'load.json'), 'utf8'));
  return { loginsOk: j.loginsOk, loginsFailed: j.loginsFailed, loginP50: j.loginMs.p50, loginP95: j.loginMs.p95, chatP50: j.chatMs.p50, chatP95: j.chatMs.p95,
    races: j.races, reports: j.reports };
}

/** the HTTP clients in WORKERS processes, their results together */
const WORKERS = 4;
async function httpLoads() {
  const per = Math.ceil(N / WORKERS);
  const rs = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: WORKERS }, (_, w) => child(['--http-worker', '--port', String(PORT), '--n', String(per),
    '--first', String(w * per), '--seconds', String(SECONDS), '--data', DATA]).result));
  const sum = k => rs.reduce((a, r) => a + r[k], 0);
  return { requestsPerS: sum('requestsPerS'), MBPerS: +sum('MBPerS').toFixed(1), latencyP50: Math.max(...rs.map(r => r.latencyP50)),
    latencyP99: Math.max(...rs.map(r => r.latencyP99)), errors: sum('errors') };
}

async function httpLoad(port, first = 0) {
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
  const manifest = await (await fetch(`${base}/data-manifest`)).json();
  const files = manifest.files.filter(f => !f.d && f.s > 0);
  const runs = [];
  for (const f of files) for (let b = 0; b * (1 << 20) < f.s; b += 4) runs.push(`/data-blocks/v2/${f.p.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}?b=${b}&n=4&m=${f.m}&s=${f.s}`);
  const lat = []; let bytes = 0, requests = 0, errors = 0;
  const end = Date.now() + SECONDS * 1000;
  const client = async (c) => {
    const agent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 4 });
    let i = c * 7919;
    const one = async () => {
      while (Date.now() < end) {
        const p = runs[i++ % runs.length], t0 = performance.now();
        try {
          await new Promise((res, rej) => {
            const q = http.get({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, path: p, agent, headers: { host: `localhost:${port}`, 'accept-encoding': 'zstd, br, gzip', 'x-forwarded-for': `198.18.${c >> 8}.${c & 255}` } }, r => {
              r.on('data', d => { bytes += d.length; }); r.on('end', () => (r.statusCode === 200 ? res() : rej(new Error(String(r.statusCode))))); r.on('error', rej);
            });
            q.on('error', rej);
          });
          lat.push(performance.now() - t0); requests++;
        } catch { errors++; await sleep(50); }
      }
    };
    await Promise.all([one(), one(), one(), one()]);
    agent.destroy();
  };
  const t0 = performance.now();
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: N }, (_, c) => client(first + c)));
  const s = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
  return { requestsPerS: Math.round(requests / s), MBPerS: +(bytes / s / 1048576).toFixed(1), latencyP50: pct(lat, 50), latencyP99: pct(lat, 99), errors };
}

// behind each other (700 MB/s of answers kept this process too busy to answer a ping in time)

  await new Promise(() => {});
}
if (argv.includes('--http-worker')) {
  const first = +opt('first', 0);
  process.send(await httpLoad(PORT, first));
  process.exit(0);
}
function child(args) {
  const c = spawn(...pinned(GEN_CPUS, process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), ...args]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit', 'ipc'] });
  return { c, result: new Promise(res => c.once('message', res)) };
}
const results = {};
for (const load of LOADS) {
  for (const impl of SERVERS) {
    const tag = `${load}-${impl}`;
    console.log(`server-compare: ${load} against ${impl} (${N} clients, ${SECONDS} s)`);
    const s = await startServer(impl, PORT, load);
    const u0 = usage(s.c.pid), t0 = performance.now(), th0 = threadCpu(s.c.pid);
    let rssMax = u0?.rss ?? 0;
    const sampler = setInterval(() => { const u = usage(s.c.pid); if (u) rssMax = Math.max(rssMax, u.rss); }, 1000);
    const probe = child(['--probe', '--port', String(PORT)]);
    let r;
    try { r = load === 'roam' ? await roamLoad(PORT, tag) : load === 'crowd' ? await crowdLoad(PORT, tag) : load === 'mix' ? await mixLoad(PORT, tag) : load === 'online' ? await onlineLoad(PORT, tag) : await httpLoads(); }
    catch (e) { r = { error: String(e?.message ?? e) }; }
    probe.c.send('stop');
    const ping = await probe.result;
    clearInterval(sampler);
    const u1 = usage(s.c.pid), wall = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
    results[tag] = { ...r, cpuCores: u0 && u1 ? +((u1.cpu - u0.cpu) / wall).toFixed(2) : null, ...threadShares(th0, threadCpu(s.c.pid), wall),
      rssStartMB: u0 ? Math.round(u0.rss) : null, rssMaxMB: Math.round(rssMax), pingMs: ping };
    await s.stop();
    console.log(`server-compare: ${tag}: ${JSON.stringify(results[tag])}`);
  }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'compare.json'), JSON.stringify({ n: N, seconds: SECONDS, cpus: os.cpus().length, results }, null, 1));

// the table: one row per measure, one column per server, per load
for (const load of LOADS) {
  const cols = SERVERS.map(impl => results[`${load}-${impl}`] ?? {});
  const keys = [...new Set(cols.flatMap(c => Object.keys(c)))];
  const cell = v => v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : typeof v === 'object' ? `${v.p50}/${v.p90}/${v.p99} (max ${v.max})` : String(v);
  console.log(`\n${load} (${N} clients, ${SECONDS} s)`);
  console.log(['', ...SERVERS].map((h, i) => i ? h.padStart(28) : h.padEnd(20)).join(''));
  for (const k of keys) console.log([k.padEnd(20), ...cols.map(c => cell(c[k]).padStart(28))].join(''));
}
console.log(`\n(pingMs: p50/p90/p99 of the switch's answer to a ping every 100 ms; cpuCores: the server's CPU time over the wall time)`);
process.exit(0);

// REJECTED translations and, for a game dump, the census
function checkDump(dir, census) {
  for (const f of ['index.txt', 'pairs.txt']) {
    const p = path.join(dir, f);
    if (!fs.existsSync(p)) continue;
    const rej = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(l => /REJECTED/.test(l));
    for (const l of rej.slice(0, 5)) problems.push(`${f}: ${l}`);
    if (rej.length > 5) problems.push(`${f}: ${rej.length - 5} more REJECTED lines`);
  }
  if (!census) return null;
  const ix = fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'index.txt')) ? fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'index.txt'), 'utf8') : '';
  if (!ix) problems.push('no index.txt in the dump');
  const distinct = re => new Set(fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(n => re.test(n))
    .map(n => fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, n)).toString('base64'))).size;
  const got = {
    vsObjects: distinct(/^vsobj_\d+\.bin$/), psObjects: distinct(/^psobj_\d+\.bin$/), decls: distinct(/^decl_[0-9a-f]+\.bin$/),
    vsPairs: ix.split('\n').filter(l => /^vs \d+ obj=.* ok$/.test(l)).length,
    psModules: ix.split('\n').filter(l => /^ps \d+ obj=\d+ ok$/.test(l)).length,
  };
  for (const [k, min] of Object.entries(CENSUS)) if (!(got[k] >= min)) problems.push(`census: ${k} ${got[k]} < ${min}`);
  return got;
}

{"id": "AT002026", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/tools/slow-line.mjs", "originalBytes": 4818, "originalSha256": "d0390c1dab09d91da69182ed6e633c824130a8405739370693eb49e3ea56a8c5", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 4818, "utf8TotalBytes": 4818}
