// A slow line in front of a local server, for tests of what a player on a slow connection waits for (the game's
// data blocks, the module, a friend's car with an empty cache): every HTTP answer's bytes through one shared
// bucket of --mbit Mbit/s, each request --rtt ms late (half on the way there, half before its answer starts);
// WebSockets (/lan) through as they are, --ws-rtt ms each way if given.
//
//   node web/tools/slow-line.mjs --to http://127.0.0.1:8611 [--port 8612] [--mbit 20] [--rtt 60] [--ws-rtt 0]
//        [--fast /game.wasm,/game.json]
//   --fast   paths (prefixes) answered at full speed: the module, so that a test waits only for what it measures
// Every 10 s while it carries anything: requests, MB through, the bucket's wait (how far behind the line is).
import http from 'node:http';
import net from 'node:net';

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 && i + 1 < argv.length ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const TO = new URL(opt('to', 'http://127.0.0.1:8611')), PORT = +opt('port', 8612), MBIT = +opt('mbit', 20);
const RTT = +opt('rtt', 60), WS_RTT = +opt('ws-rtt', 0), FAST = opt('fast', '/game.wasm,/game.json').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const rate = MBIT * 1e6 / 8;                        // bytes a second
let free = performance.now();                       // when the line is next free (ms)
const st = { req: 0, bytes: 0, waitMs: 0 };
const byPath = new Map();                           // the bytes through the line by file (data blocks: their file)
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

/** a chunk through the line: it leaves when the line has carried every byte before it */
async function line(n) {
  const now = performance.now();
  free = Math.max(free, now) + n / rate * 1000;
  st.bytes += n;
  const wait = free - now;
  st.waitMs = Math.max(st.waitMs, wait);
  if (wait > 1) await sleep(wait);
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  st.req++;
  const fast = FAST.some(p => req.url.startsWith(p));
  // (the request's body, if any, held while it is on its way)
  req.pause();
  if (!fast && RTT) await sleep(RTT / 2);
  const up = http.request({ host: TO.hostname, port: TO.port, method: req.method, path: req.url, headers: req.headers }, async r => {
    if (!fast && RTT) await sleep(RTT / 2);
    res.writeHead(r.statusCode, r.statusMessage, r.headers);
    if (fast) { r.pipe(res); return; }
    // each chunk after the one before (an answer already in can end before its chunks are through the line)
    let chain = Promise.resolve();
    const key = decodeURIComponent(req.url.replace(/^\/data(-blocks)?\/(v\d+\/)?/, '').replace(/\?.*$/, ''));
    r.on('data', c => {
      byPath.set(key, (byPath.get(key) ?? 0) + c.length);
      r.pause();
      chain = chain.then(() => line(c.length)).then(() => { res.write(c); r.resume(); });
    });
    r.on('end', () => { chain = chain.then(() => res.end()); });
    r.on('error', () => res.destroy());
  });
  up.on('error', e => { res.writeHead(502); res.end(String(e)); });
  req.pipe(up);
});
// WebSockets: the upgrade request and everything after it, both ways (a delay each way with --ws-rtt)
server.on('upgrade', (req, sock, head) => {
  const up = net.connect(+TO.port, TO.hostname, () => {
    let h = `${req.method} ${req.url} HTTP/1.1\r\n`;
    for (let i = 0; i < req.rawHeaders.length; i += 2) h += `${req.rawHeaders[i]}: ${req.rawHeaders[i + 1]}\r\n`;
    up.write(h + '\r\n'); if (head?.length) up.write(head);
    const pipe = (a, b) => WS_RTT
      ? a.on('data', c => setTimeout(() => b.write(c), WS_RTT / 2))
      : a.pipe(b);
    pipe(up, sock); pipe(sock, up);
  });
  const end = () => { up.destroy(); sock.destroy(); };
  up.on('error', end); sock.on('error', end); up.on('close', end); sock.on('close', end);
});
server.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log(`slow-line: http://127.0.0.1:${PORT} -> ${TO.origin}, ${MBIT} Mbit/s, ${RTT} ms`));
let last = { ...st };
setInterval(() => {
  if (st.req === last.req && st.bytes === last.bytes) return;
  console.log(`slow-line: ${st.req - last.req} requests, ${((st.bytes - last.bytes) / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB in 10 s, the line up to ${(st.waitMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s behind`);
  // (by kind: a car's files as CARS/*/<file>, the rest by their first two path parts; the 10 largest so far)
  const kinds = new Map();
  for (const [k, v] of byPath) {
    const d = /^CARS\/[^/]+\/[^/]+$/i.test(k) ? k.replace(/^CARS\/[^/]+\//i, 'CARS/*/') : k.split('/').slice(0, 2).join('/');
    kinds.set(d, (kinds.get(d) ?? 0) + v);
  }

// Small statistics for the measurement tools (bench.mjs).
// pct: the p-quantile by linear interpolation between the closest ranks
// (numpy's default): the median of an even count is the mean of the two
// middle values, not the upper one (the perf review: with 2 runs the
// "median" was the maximum).
export const pct = (a, p) => {
  if (!a.length) return NaN;
  const s = a.slice().sort((x, y) => x - y), i = Math.min(Math.max(p, 0), 1) * (s.length - 1), lo = Math.floor(i), hi = Math.ceil(i);
  return lo === hi ? s[lo] : s[lo] + (s[hi] - s[lo]) * (i - lo);
};
export const dist = a => a.length ? { n: a.length, mean: a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length, p50: pct(a, 0.5), p95: pct(a, 0.95), p99: pct(a, 0.99), max: Math.max(...a) } : { n: 0 };

# threadcpu-win: per-thread CPU time of a Chrome run's processes (Windows), for web/tools/bench.mjs.
#   pwsh -NoProfile -File web/tools/threadcpu-win.ps1
# A small server on stdin/stdout, so a snapshot costs milliseconds, not a PowerShell start:
#   in:  "snap <text>"   every chrome.exe whose command line contains <text> (the run's --user-data-dir)
#   out: one line per thread, then "END <epoch ms of the snapshot>":
#        pid thread_id cpu_ns name type cycle_ns
#   cpu_ns is kernel + user time (GetThreadTimes: clock-tick accounting, fine over seconds), cycle_ns the
#   thread's cycle count (QueryThreadCycleTime, exact) at the TSC rate measured at start.  type is the
#   process's --type= (renderer, gpu-process, utility, ...) or "browser".  Names are Chrome's own thread
#   descriptions (CrRendererMain, DedicatedWorker thread, CrGpuMain, ...), spaces as underscores.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
public static class ThreadCpu {
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] static extern IntPtr OpenThread(uint access, bool inherit, uint id);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr h);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool GetThreadTimes(IntPtr h, out long c, out long e, out long k, out long u);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool QueryThreadCycleTime(IntPtr h, out ulong cycles);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr GetCurrentThread();
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern int GetThreadDescription(IntPtr h, out IntPtr desc);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr LocalFree(IntPtr p);
  const uint QUERY_LIMITED = 0x0800;
  public static double TscPerNs = 1.0;
  public static void Calibrate() {
    ulong c0, c1; var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
    QueryThreadCycleTime(GetCurrentThread(), out c0);
    while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 200) { }
    QueryThreadCycleTime(GetCurrentThread(), out c1);
    TscPerNs = (c1 - c0) / (sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds * 1e6);
  }
  public static string Snap(int[] pids, string[] types) {
    var sb = new StringBuilder();
    for (int i = 0; i < pids.Length; i++) {
      Process p;
      try { p = Process.GetProcessById(pids[i]); } catch { continue; }
      foreach (ProcessThread t in p.Threads) {
        IntPtr h = OpenThread(QUERY_LIMITED, false, (uint)t.Id);
        if (h == IntPtr.Zero) continue;
        long c, e, k, u; ulong cy = 0; string name = "-";
        if (!GetThreadTimes(h, out c, out e, out k, out u)) { CloseHandle(h); continue; }
        QueryThreadCycleTime(h, out cy);
        IntPtr d;
        if (GetThreadDescription(h, out d) >= 0 && d != IntPtr.Zero) {
          string s = Marshal.PtrToStringUni(d); LocalFree(d);
          if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)) name = s.Replace(' ', '_');
        }
        CloseHandle(h);
        sb.Append(pids[i]).Append(' ').Append(t.Id).Append(' ').Append((k + u) * 100).Append(' ').Append(name)
          .Append(' ').Append(types[i]).Append(' ').Append((long)(cy / TscPerNs)).Append('\n');
      }
    }
    return sb.ToString();
  }
}

[ThreadCpu]::Calibrate()
$cache = @{}
while ($null -ne ($line = [Console]::In.ReadLine())) {
  if (-not $line.StartsWith('snap ')) { continue }

  if (-not $cache.ContainsKey($key)) {

    $types = @($procs | ForEach-Object { if ($_.CommandLine -match '--type=([\w-]+)') { $Matches[1] } else { 'browser' } })
    if ($procs.Count) { $cache[$key] = @{ pids = [int[]]@($procs | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.ProcessId }); types = [string[]]$types } }
  }
  $t = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
  if ($cache.ContainsKey($key)) { [Console]::Out.Write([ThreadCpu]::Snap($cache[$key].pids, $cache[$key].types)) }
  [Console]::Out.WriteLine("END $t")
  [Console]::Out.Flush()
}

{"id": "AT002029", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/tools/threadcpu.c", "originalBytes": 2566, "originalSha256": "c60b74cc26020f27587f8c29984caf1d6a2f92947ccf4defcd2045401c1ef2cf", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 2566, "utf8TotalBytes": 2566}

/* threadcpu: per-thread CPU time and counters of a process (macOS), for web/tools/bench.mjs.
 *   threadcpu <pid>...
 * One line per thread:
 *   pid thread_id cpu_ns name  P_instructions P_cycles P_ns  E_instructions E_cycles E_ns
 * (P = performance cores, E = efficiency cores).  The browser has no thread CPU clock, so the
 * benchmark's busy time per frame is wall time: on a loaded machine it includes preemption and
 * time on the slower E cores.  Instructions retired per frame do not depend on the load, and the
 * per-core-type split shows how much of the game thread ran on E cores.  The counters come from
 * proc_pidinfo(PROC_PIDTHREADCOUNTS), a private flavour of the public call (the one Activity
 * Monitor and the Mac port's thread_selfcounts use), with its XNU layout below.  Build:
 *   clang -O2 -o <dir>/threadcpu web/tools/threadcpu.c */
#include <libproc.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/proc_info.h>

#define PIDLISTTHREADIDS   28
#define PIDTHREADID64INFO  15
#define PIDTHREADCOUNTS    34
struct tcd { uint64_t instructions, cycles, user_mach, system_mach, energy_nj; };
struct tc  { uint16_t len, r0; uint32_t r1; struct tcd c[4]; };

int main(int argc, char **argv){
    mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    for (int a = 1; a < argc; a++){
        int pid = atoi(argv[a]);
        static uint64_t ids[8192];
        int n = proc_pidinfo(pid, PIDLISTTHREADIDS, 0, ids, sizeof ids);
        if (n <= 0) continue;
        n /= (int)sizeof ids[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            struct proc_threadinfo ti;
            if (proc_pidinfo(pid, PIDTHREADID64INFO, ids[i], &ti, sizeof ti) != (int)sizeof ti) continue;
            for (char *p = ti.pth_name; *p; p++) if (*p == ' ') *p = '_';
            struct tc t; memset(&t, 0, sizeof t);
            int r = proc_pidinfo(pid, PIDTHREADCOUNTS, ids[i], &t, sizeof t);
            printf("%d %llu %llu %s", pid, (unsigned long long)ids[i],
                   (unsigned long long)(ti.pth_user_time + ti.pth_system_time), ti.pth_name[0] ? ti.pth_name : "-");
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++){
                const struct tcd *d = r > 8 && k < t.len ? &t.c[k] : NULL;
                unsigned long long ns = d ? (d->user_mach + d->system_mach) * tb.numer / tb.denom : 0;
                printf(" %llu %llu %llu", d ? (unsigned long long)d->instructions : 0ull, d ? (unsigned long long)d->cycles : 0ull, ns);
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

process.exitCode = bad ? 1 : 0;

// Keyphrase saves between two browsers (web/src/app/vault-ui.ts, the server's /vault): two Chrome contexts (each its
// own OPFS and localStorage) on the start page of a running server.
//
//   node web/tools/vault-pair.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:8080 --backup <a "Download a backup" zip> [--state <dir>] [--play] [--headed]
//
// A restores the backup and makes a keyphrase; B (with a screenshot of its own) types it in, in another shape, and
// loads the saves, but A's DVD and magazine covers (a keyphrase keeps none: each 1 MB, the server takes 256 KB) and
// the device's own (B keeps its registry.txt and its resolution scale and frame rate in settings.ini); A's resolution
// scale changed sends nothing; a settings.ini changed in A comes to B, a cover B has of its own and B's scale staying;
// A's LAN server's file (gamefile.bin, 300 KB that do not pack: past the cap on its own) never goes, B keeps its own
// and A's changing sends nothing; a rename in A comes to B at its next page
// load; a send of A's the server kept without A hearing back is no conflict at A's next send (issue 33); both rename
// (a conflict, both sides shown: B keeps its own when asked, A takes it at its next load); A deletes the saves from the server
// and B is told at its next load.  Before that, A as the page before 2026-10-28 linked it (version 3, its hash

// profile's name nor a byte of the profile.  --play (a server with --dev and a module): two more browsers on fresh

async function until(what, f, ms = 20000) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  for (;;) {
    const v = await f().catch(() => null);
    if (v) return v;
    if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) throw new Error(`${what}: not within ${ms / 1000} s`);
    await sleep(200);
  }
}

/** a page's file of the save folder: its SHA-256, or null */
const fileHash = (page, rel, save = 'save') => page.evaluate(async ([rel, save]) => {

/** a page's files of the save folder that `want` takes (by path), with their bytes */
async function filesOf(page, want) {
  const paths = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const out = [];
    async function walk(d, rel) {
      for await (const [n, h] of d.entries()) { const r = rel ? `${rel}/${n}` : n; if (h.kind === 'directory') await walk(h, r); else out.push(r); }
    }
    await walk(await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getDirectoryHandle('save'), '');
    return out;
  });
  const out = [];
  for (const p of paths.filter(want)) out.push({ path: p, data: new Uint8Array(await page.evaluate(async rel => {

  }, p)) });
  return out;
}

    check((await fileHash(c, at('ROTEST'), 'vplay')) === (await fileHash(d, at('ROTEST'), 'vplay2')), 'D has the game\'s save, the same bytes');
    const rev2 = (await link(d, 'vplay2')).rev;
    await rename(d, 'ROTEST', 'AFTER');
    await until('D sent the rename', async () => (await link(d, 'vplay2'))?.rev !== rev2);
    // C, not reloaded: Play takes the rename before the game starts
    await c.click('#play');
    await until('C playing again', async () => (await phase(c)) === 'playing', 60000);
    const took = !!(await fileHash(c, at('AFTER'), 'vplay')) && !(await fileHash(c, at('ROTEST'), 'vplay'));
    if (!took) console.log(`C: "${await status(c)}"\n${(await c.evaluate(() => window.__nfsu2.log.text())).split('\n').filter(l => /keyphrase|\[app\] (the game|autosave|settings)/.test(l)).slice(-12).join('\n')}`);
    // F9, Quit game: the game's own close (or its input script's, which ends with one)
    await sleep(5000);
    await c.keyboard.press('F9');
    await c.click('#menu [data-act="quit"]').catch(() => {});
    await until('C quit', async () => (await phase(c)) === 'exited', 400000);
    check(took, 'C\'s Play took D\'s rename before the game started');
  }
} catch (e) {
  check(false, `stopped: ${e.message}`);
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
console.log(fails.length ? `FAIL (${fails.length})` : 'PASS');
process.exit(fails.length ? 1 : 0);

{"id": "AT002036", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/tools/wgsl-xl.c", "originalBytes": 18404, "originalSha256": "d0eb09f7913db4cf93845ebd939ea18f936dbc926e5c9fdbd1adb906619d2201", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 18404, "utf8TotalBytes": 18404}

/* Offline WGSL translation of D3D9 shader binaries with the game's own
 * translator (runtime/vsemu.c built natively with -DVSEMU_WGSL), for checking
 * the emitter without running the game:
 *
 *   cc -O1 -DVSEMU_WGSL -DNFS_ENHANCED=0 -Iruntime -Iruntime/web \
 *      runtime/vsemu.c web/tools/wgsl-xl.c -lm -o out/wgsl-xl
 *   out/wgsl-xl <outdir> shader.bin...
 *   out/wgsl-xl --pairs <dumpdir> <outdir>
 *   node web/tools/shader-check.mjs --from <outdir>
 *
 * --pairs takes an in-game dump (NFSU2_SHADER_DUMP) and translates every
 * distinct vertex shader object against every distinct vertex declaration the
 * game created that supplies all of the shader's inputs, mapped exactly as
 * com.c draw_up/gpuvs_id do (stream 0, vs_input_reg).  That covers the pairs a
 * single test drive never draws; the modules get ids from 1001 (index.txt
 * says which object and declaration each one is).  It also writes
 * differential test vectors (vs_<id>.vec, see write_vectors) for these
 * modules and for the game's own pairs in the dump, and pixel shader vectors
 * (ps_<id>.pvec, see write_ps_vectors) for every dumped pixel shader.
 *
 * The output uses the in-game dump's file names (vs_<n>.wgsl, ps_<n>.wgsl,
 * ps_<n+256>.wgsl for the cube twin, vs_0/ps_0/ps_256 built-ins,
 * pulltest.wgsl, index.txt).  A vertex shader gets a synthetic declaration
 * (one element per dcl'd input with a typical NFSU2 type), so this checks the
 * shader bodies; the real (shader, declaration) pairs come from the in-game
 * dump (NFSU2_SHADER_DUMP). */
#include "vsemu.h"
#include "wgsl.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <math.h>

static char g_buf[256 * 1024];

static void put(const char *dir, const char *name, const char *text, size_t n){
    char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, name);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f){ perror(path); exit(1); }
    fwrite(text, 1, n, f); fclose(f);
}

static unsigned char *slurp(const char *path, size_t *n){
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long L = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    unsigned char *b = malloc((size_t)L + 4);
    if (b && fread(b, 1, (size_t)L, f) != (size_t)L){ free(b); b = 0; }
    fclose(f); *n = (size_t)L;
    return b;
}


/* ---- differential test vectors: the CPU interpreter is the reference ----
 * vs_<id>.vec (little-endian): u32 magic 'VSV1', nverts, stride, writes_fog,
 * then nverts*stride vertex bytes, 256*4 f32 constants (K.c), and per vertex
 * 29 f32 expected outputs: pos, col0, col1, uv0..uv3 (TEXCOORDINDEX = identity),
 * fog.  The expected values come from vs_run on inputs decoded by a copy of
 * com.c decl_fetch, i.e. the Mac's CPU vertex path.  The shader check runs the
 * WGSL vertex function as a compute shader on the same bytes and compares. */
static uint32_t g_rng;
static uint32_t rnd(void){ g_rng ^= g_rng << 13; g_rng ^= g_rng >> 17; g_rng ^= g_rng << 5; return g_rng; }
static float rndf(float lo, float hi){ return lo + (hi - lo) * (float)(rnd() >> 8) / 16777216.f; }

/* copy of com.c decl_fetch (static there), reading from a byte buffer */
static float rf(const unsigned char *b){ float f; memcpy(&f, b, 4); return f; }
static int16_t rs(const unsigned char *b){ return (int16_t)(b[0] | b[1] << 8); }
static uint16_t ru(const unsigned char *b){ return (uint16_t)(b[0] | b[1] << 8); }
static void decl_fetch(const unsigned char *a, unsigned type, float out[4]){
    out[0]=out[1]=out[2]=0.f; out[3]=1.f;
    switch (type){
    case 0: out[0]=rf(a); break;
    case 1: out[0]=rf(a); out[1]=rf(a+4); break;
    case 2: out[0]=rf(a); out[1]=rf(a+4); out[2]=rf(a+8); break;
    case 3: out[0]=rf(a); out[1]=rf(a+4); out[2]=rf(a+8); out[3]=rf(a+12); break;
    case 4: out[0]=a[2]/255.f; out[1]=a[1]/255.f; out[2]=a[0]/255.f; out[3]=a[3]/255.f; break;
    case 5: out[0]=a[0]; out[1]=a[1]; out[2]=a[2]; out[3]=a[3]; break;
    case 8: out[0]=a[0]/255.f; out[1]=a[1]/255.f; out[2]=a[2]/255.f; out[3]=a[3]/255.f; break;
    case 6: out[0]=rs(a); out[1]=rs(a+2); break;
    case 7: out[0]=rs(a); out[1]=rs(a+2); out[2]=rs(a+4); out[3]=rs(a+6); break;
    case 9: out[0]=rs(a)/32767.f; out[1]=rs(a+2)/32767.f; break;
    case 10:out[0]=rs(a)/32767.f; out[1]=rs(a+2)/32767.f; out[2]=rs(a+4)/32767.f; out[3]=rs(a+6)/32767.f; break;
    case 11:out[0]=ru(a)/65535.f; out[1]=ru(a+2)/65535.f; break;
    case 12:out[0]=ru(a)/65535.f; out[1]=ru(a+2)/65535.f; out[2]=ru(a+4)/65535.f; out[3]=ru(a+6)/65535.f; break;
    default: break;
    }
}
static const int DSIZE[13] = { 4, 8, 12, 16, 4, 4, 4, 8, 4, 4, 8, 4, 8 };

static void write_vectors(const char *dir, int id, const VSProg *p, const int dcl[16][2]){
    enum { NV = 64 };
    int stride = 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        if (dcl[i][0] >= 0 && dcl[i][1] >= 0 && dcl[i][1] < 13 && dcl[i][0] + DSIZE[dcl[i][1]] > stride)
            stride = dcl[i][0] + DSIZE[dcl[i][1]];
    stride = (stride + 3) & ~3;
    g_rng = 0x9E3779B9u ^ (uint32_t)id * 2654435761u;
    unsigned char *vb = calloc(NV, (size_t)stride);
    /* plausible values per element type: floats in [0, 4) keep relative
     * constant indices (a0 = floor(v) * 4 + n in WORLDBONE) inside c0..c255,
     * where the interpreter (out of range -> 0) and the GPU (clamp) agree */
    for (int v = 0; v < NV; v++)
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++){
            if (dcl[i][0] < 0) continue;
            unsigned char *a = vb + (size_t)v * stride + dcl[i][0];
            int t = dcl[i][1];
            if (t <= 3) for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++){ float f = rndf(0.f, 4.f); memcpy(a + 4*c, &f, 4); }
            else for (int c = 0; c < DSIZE[t]; c++) a[c] = (unsigned char)rnd();
        }
    static VSConst k; memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
    for (int r = 0; r < 256; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) k.f[r][c] = rndf(-1.f, 1.f);
    int wf = vs_writes_fog(p);
    char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/vs_%d.vec", dir, id);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f){ perror(path); exit(1); }
    uint32_t hdr[4] = { 0x31565356u, NV, (uint32_t)stride, (uint32_t)wf };
    fwrite(hdr, 4, 4, f);
    fwrite(vb, (size_t)stride, NV, f);
    fwrite(k.f, 16, 256, f);
    for (int v = 0; v < NV; v++){
        float in[16][4];
        for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++){ in[r][0] = in[r][1] = in[r][2] = 0.f; in[r][3] = 1.f; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
            if (dcl[i][0] >= 0) decl_fetch(vb + (size_t)v * stride + dcl[i][0], (unsigned)dcl[i][1], in[i]);
        VSOut o; vs_run(p, &k, (const float (*)[4])in, &o);
        float e[29];
        memcpy(e, o.pos, 16); memcpy(e + 4, o.col[0], 16); memcpy(e + 8, o.col[1], 16);
        memcpy(e + 12, o.tex[0], 64);
        e[28] = wf ? o.fog : 1.f;          /* GPU semantics: unwritten oFog = 1 (no fog) */
        fwrite(e, 4, 29, f);
    }
    fclose(f); free(vb);
}


/* ---- pixel shader vectors: ps_<id>.pvec, oracle = ps_ref_run ----
 * u32 magic 'PSV1', npix, cubemask, 0; the 560-byte PSPar block; per pixel 25
 * f32 inputs (col0, col1, uv0..uv3, fog); per pixel 5 f32 expected outputs
 * (rgba after alpha test and fog, killed 0/1).  Textures are an analytic
 * function of the coordinate (ftex below; the shader check substitutes the
 * same function for textureSample). */
static void ftex(int k, const float *c, int n, float o[4]){
    float x = c[0], y = c[1], f = (float)k;
    if (n == 3){ x = c[0] + c[2] * 0.3f; y = c[1] - c[2] * 0.2f; }
    o[0] = 0.5f + 0.4f * sinf(x * 3.1f + f * 0.37f);
    o[1] = 0.5f + 0.4f * cosf(y * 2.3f + f * 0.5f);
    o[2] = 0.5f + 0.4f * sinf((x + y) * 1.7f + f);
    o[3] = 0.5f + 0.4f * cosf(x * y * 5.3f + 0.2f * f);
}
static int write_ps_vectors(const char *dir, int id, const VSProg *p, unsigned cubemask){
    enum { NP = 256 };
    g_rng = 0x85EBCA6Bu ^ (uint32_t)id * 2246822519u;
    static PSRefPar P; memset(&P, 0, sizeof P);
    P.aref = rndf(0.f, 0.5f);
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) P.proj[k] = (float)(k + 16 * (int)(rnd() % 3u));
    for (int r = 0; r < 32; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) P.c[r][c] = rndf(-1.f, 1.f);
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) P.fog[c] = rndf(0.f, 1.f);
    P.fog[3] = (float)(id & 1);
    char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/ps_%d.pvec", dir, id);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f){ perror(path); exit(1); }
    uint32_t hdr[4] = { 0x31565350u, NP, cubemask, 0 };
    fwrite(hdr, 4, 4, f);
    float blk[140] = { 0 };                    /* PSPar: aref usec pad pad, proj, c[32], fog */
    blk[0] = P.aref; memcpy(blk + 4, P.proj, 16); memcpy(blk + 8, P.c, 512); memcpy(blk + 136, P.fog, 16);
    fwrite(blk, 4, 140, f);
    static PSRefIn in[NP];
    for (int i = 0; i < NP; i++){
        /* colours a little outside [0, 1] (the Mac does not clamp oD0/oD1)
         * so _sat, cmp and cnd see both sides of their thresholds */
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++){ in[i].col[0][c] = rndf(-0.25f, 1.25f); in[i].col[1][c] = rndf(-0.25f, 1.25f); }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++){
            in[i].uv[k][0] = rndf(0.f, 1.f); in[i].uv[k][1] = rndf(0.f, 1.f);
            in[i].uv[k][2] = rndf(0.5f, 2.f); in[i].uv[k][3] = rndf(0.5f, 2.f);
        }
        in[i].fog = rndf(-0.2f, 1.2f);
        float row[25];
        memcpy(row, in[i].col, 32); memcpy(row + 8, in[i].uv, 64); row[24] = in[i].fog;
        fwrite(row, 4, 25, f);
    }
    int ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < NP; i++){
        float o[5]; int killed = 0;
        if (!ps_ref_run(p, &P, &in[i], ftex, cubemask, o, &killed)) ok = 0;
        o[4] = (float)killed;
        fwrite(o, 4, 5, f);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return ok;
}

/* every pixel shader object of the dump, and its stage-0 cube twin */
static int game_ps_vectors(const char *dump, const char *dir){
    int n = 0;
    for (int id = 1; id < 256; id++){
        char bp[1024]; snprintf(bp, sizeof bp, "%s/psobj_%d.bin", dump, id);
        size_t bn; unsigned char *b = slurp(bp, &bn);
        if (!b) continue;
        VSProg *p = vs_compile((const uint32_t *)b, bn / 4);
        if (p){ n += write_ps_vectors(dir, id, p, 0u); n += write_ps_vectors(dir, id + 256, p, 1u); vs_free(p); }
        free(b);
    }
    return n;
}

/* The game's own pairs: index.txt "vs <gid> obj=<n> decl=0x.. in=v0@0:FLOAT3,..." */
static int game_vectors(const char *dump, const char *dir){
    static const char *const TN[] = { "FLOAT1", "FLOAT2", "FLOAT3", "FLOAT4", "D3DCOLOR", "UBYTE4",
        "SHORT2", "SHORT4", "UBYTE4N", "SHORT2N", "SHORT4N", "USHORT2N", "USHORT4N" };
    char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/index.txt", dump);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[2048]; int n = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)){
        int gid, obj; char in[1500];
        if (sscanf(line, "vs %d obj=%d decl=%*s in=%1499s", &gid, &obj, in) != 3) continue;
        int dcl[16][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++){ dcl[i][0] = -1; dcl[i][1] = 0; }
        for (char *t = strtok(in, ","); t; t = strtok(0, ",")){
            int r, off; char ty[32];
            if (sscanf(t, "v%d@%d:%31s", &r, &off, ty) != 3 || r < 0 || r > 15) continue;
            for (int q = 0; q < 13; q++) if (!strcmp(ty, TN[q])){ dcl[r][0] = off; dcl[r][1] = q; }
        }
        char bp[1024]; snprintf(bp, sizeof bp, "%s/vsobj_%d.bin", dump, obj);
        size_t bn; unsigned char *b = slurp(bp, &bn);
        if (!b) continue;
        VSProg *p = vs_compile((const uint32_t *)b, bn / 4);
        if (p){ write_vectors(dir, gid, p, (const int (*)[2])dcl); n++; vs_free(p); }
        free(b);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return n;
}

static int pairs(const char *dump, const char *dir){
    DIR *d = opendir(dump);
    if (!d){ perror(dump); return 1; }
    enum { MAXO = 512 };
    static struct { char name[64]; unsigned char *b; size_t n; } vs[MAXO], dc[MAXO];
    int nvs = 0, ndc = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))){
        int isvs = !strncmp(e->d_name, "vsobj_", 6) && strstr(e->d_name, ".bin");
        int isdc = !strncmp(e->d_name, "decl_", 5) && strstr(e->d_name, ".bin");
        if (!isvs && !isdc) continue;
        char p[1024]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dump, e->d_name);
        size_t n; unsigned char *b = slurp(p, &n);
        if (!b) continue;
        /* distinct contents only */
        int dup = 0, cnt = isvs ? nvs : ndc;
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt && !dup; i++){
            if (isvs ? (vs[i].n == n && !memcmp(vs[i].b, b, n)) : (dc[i].n == n && !memcmp(dc[i].b, b, n))) dup = 1;
        }
        if (dup || cnt >= MAXO){ free(b); continue; }
        if (isvs){ snprintf(vs[nvs].name, 64, "%s", e->d_name); vs[nvs].b = b; vs[nvs].n = n; nvs++; }
        else     { snprintf(dc[ndc].name, 64, "%s", e->d_name); dc[ndc].b = b; dc[ndc].n = n; ndc++; }
    }
    closedir(d);
    FILE *ix; { char p[1024]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/pairs.txt", dir); ix = fopen(p, "w"); }
    if (!ix){ perror("pairs.txt"); return 1; }
    int id = 1000, ok = 0, fail = 0, nopair = 0;
    for (int v = 0; v < nvs; v++){
        VSProg *p = vs_compile((const uint32_t *)vs[v].b, vs[v].n / 4);
        if (!p){ fprintf(ix, "%s: parse failed\n", vs[v].name); fail++; continue; }
        int paired = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < ndc; k++){
            const unsigned char *el = dc[k].b;
            int dcl[16][2], have[14][16];
            memset(have, 0, sizeof have);
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++){ dcl[i][0] = -1; dcl[i][1] = 0; }
            int nel = 0;
            for (size_t q = 0; q + 8 <= dc[k].n; q += 8){
                unsigned st = el[q] | el[q+1] << 8, of = el[q+2] | el[q+3] << 8;
                unsigned ty = el[q+4], us = el[q+6], ui = el[q+7];
                if (st == 0xFFu && ty == 17u) break;
                if (st != 0) continue;
                if (us < 14 && ui < 16) have[us][ui] = 1;
                int rg = vs_input_reg(p, (int)us, (int)ui);
                if (rg >= 0 && nel < 16){ dcl[rg][0] = (int)of; dcl[rg][1] = (int)ty; nel++; }
            }
            int covered = nel > 0;
            for (int us = 0; us < 14 && covered; us++)
                for (int ui = 0; ui < 16; ui++)
                    if (vs_input_reg(p, us, ui) >= 0 && !have[us][ui]){ covered = 0; break; }
            if (!covered) continue;
            paired = 1;
            int n = vs_to_wgsl(p, ++id, (const int (*)[2])dcl, g_buf, sizeof g_buf);
            char name[64]; snprintf(name, sizeof name, "vs_%d.wgsl", id);
            if (n > 0){ put(dir, name, g_buf, (size_t)n); write_vectors(dir, id, p, (const int (*)[2])dcl); ok++; }
            else fail++;
            fprintf(ix, "vs %d = %s x %s %s\n", id, vs[v].name, dc[k].name, n > 0 ? "ok" : "REJECTED");
        }
        if (!paired){ nopair++; fprintf(ix, "%s: no declaration supplies all inputs\n", vs[v].name); }
        vs_free(p);
    }
    fclose(ix);
    int gv = game_vectors(dump, dir), pv = game_ps_vectors(dump, dir);
    printf("%d distinct vertex shaders x %d distinct declarations: %d modules, %d rejected, %d shaders unpaired; "
           "test vectors for %d game pairs and %d pixel shader modules\n", nvs, ndc, ok, fail, nopair, gv, pv);
    return fail ? 1 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv){
    if (argc == 4 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--pairs")) return pairs(argv[2], argv[3]);
    if (argc < 3){ fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <outdir> shader.bin... | --pairs <dumpdir> <outdir>\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
    const char *dir = argv[1];
    FILE *ix; { char p[1024]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/index.txt", dir); ix = fopen(p, "w"); }
    if (!ix){ perror("index.txt"); return 1; }
    int n;
    if ((n = wgsl_tvert_module(g_buf, sizeof g_buf)) > 0) put(dir, "vs_0.wgsl", g_buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_ff_module(0, g_buf, sizeof g_buf, 0)) > 0) put(dir, "ps_0.wgsl", g_buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_ff_module(256, g_buf, sizeof g_buf, 1)) > 0) put(dir, "ps_256.wgsl", g_buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_pull_test_module(g_buf, sizeof g_buf)) > 0) put(dir, "pulltest.wgsl", g_buf, (size_t)n);
    int nvs = 0, nps = 0, fails = 0;
    for (int a = 2; a < argc; a++){
        FILE *f = fopen(argv[a], "rb");
        if (!f){ perror(argv[a]); return 1; }
        static uint32_t tok[16384];
        size_t dw = fread(tok, 4, 16384, f); fclose(f);
        VSProg *p = vs_compile(tok, dw);
        const char *base = strrchr(argv[a], '/'); base = base ? base + 1 : argv[a];
        if (!p){ fprintf(stderr, "%s: parse failed\n", base); fails++; continue; }
        char name[64];
        if ((tok[0] >> 16) == 0xFFFFu){
            int id = ++nps;
            n = ps_to_wgsl(p, id, g_buf, sizeof g_buf);
            if (n > 0){ snprintf(name, sizeof name, "ps_%d.wgsl", id); put(dir, name, g_buf, (size_t)n); }
            else fails++;
            int nc = ps_to_wgsl_ex(p, id + 256, g_buf, sizeof g_buf, 1u);
            if (nc > 0){ snprintf(name, sizeof name, "ps_%d.wgsl", id + 256); put(dir, name, g_buf, (size_t)nc); }
            else fails++;
            fprintf(ix, "ps %d src=%s instr=%u unknown=%u len=%d cube=%d\n", id, base, vs_ninstr(p),
                    vs_unknown(p), n, nc);
        } else {
            /* synthetic declaration: usage -> type, packed in register order */
            static const int ty_of_usage[14] = { 2, 3, 4, 2, 0, 1, 2, 2, 0, 3, 4, 0, 0, 0 };
            int dcl[16][2], off = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++){ dcl[i][0] = -1; dcl[i][1] = 0; }
            for (int us = 0; us < 14; us++)
                for (int ui = 0; ui < 8; ui++){
                    int r = vs_input_reg(p, us, ui);
                    if (r < 0) continue;
                    int t = ty_of_usage[us];
                    static const int sz[13] = { 4, 8, 12, 16, 4, 4, 4, 8, 4, 4, 8, 4, 8 };
                    dcl[r][0] = off; dcl[r][1] = t; off += sz[t];
                }
            int id = ++nvs;
            n = vs_to_wgsl(p, id, (const int (*)[2])dcl, g_buf, sizeof g_buf);
            if (n > 0){ snprintf(name, sizeof name, "vs_%d.wgsl", id); put(dir, name, g_buf, (size_t)n); }
            else fails++;
            fprintf(ix, "vs %d src=%s instr=%u unknown=%u kmax=%d stride=%d len=%d\n", id, base,
                    vs_ninstr(p), vs_unknown(p), vs_kmax(p), off, n);
        }
        vs_free(p);
    }
    fclose(ix);
    printf("%d vertex shaders, %d pixel shaders, %d translation failures\n", nvs, nps, fails);
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NFSU2FreeRoam.asi - free-roam multiplayer for Need for Speed Underground 2 (PC)
==============================================================================

Drive around Bayview together: friends on the same network, each in their
own career free roam, see each other's cars (the right model and every
customization) moving in real time. Works between Windows PCs and Macs
running the native Mac port.

Needs
-----
- Need for Speed Underground 2, PC version 1.2, North America (SPEED2.EXE
  v1.2). Any other exe: the plugin notices and does nothing (see the log).
- Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput8.dll in the game folder). The usual
  WidescreenFix / ExtraOptions / Unlimiter packs already have it.
- Everybody on the same local network (same Wi-Fi or LAN; not a guest
  network that isolates devices).

Install
-------
1. Copy both files from "scripts" into the game's "scripts" folder:
     <game folder>\scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.asi
     <game folder>\scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.ini
2. Optional: open NFSU2FreeRoam.ini and set Name = <your name>.
3. Start the game. The first time, Windows Defender Firewall asks whether
   SPEED2.EXE may communicate on networks: tick "Private networks" and
   allow it. (If the network is set to "Public", Windows blocks friends:
   set it to Private in Settings > Network.)
4. Load your career and drive. When a friend is in free roam too, their car
   appears; NFSU2FreeRoam.log in the scripts folder says "JOIN: <name> joined".

If friends do not appear
------------------------
- Look at scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.log: it says why (wrong exe, port in use,
  a friend with another plugin version or in another Room, ...).
- Some routers and VPNs block the LAN broadcast: put a friend's IP address
  in the .ini (Peers = 192.168.1.20). One address is enough.
- Everybody must use the same Port (default 47210, UDP) and the same Room.
- On the Mac the same settings are roam = on, roam_name, roam_peers,
  roam_port in ~/Library/Application Support/NFSU2/settings.ini.
- Comments in the .ini: a ';' or '#' at the start of a value or after a
  space starts a comment ("Name = Tobi ; me" is Tobi, "Name = Team#1" stays
  Team#1).

What to expect
--------------
- Up to 33 players in a group, the nearest 5 friends' cars shown at once (the
  game's own paint slots; the Mac and browser versions show 32).
- Friends' cars are ghosts (you drive through them, and they through yours).
  Collide = 1 makes them solid: experimental.
- While friends are in your free roam, the "outrun" challengers are off
  (tuners already cruising are parked once they are out of sight, or after
  20 s at most); they come back a minute after the friends have gone. An
  outrun race you are in is never interrupted (friends' cars are hidden
  during it, as in any race).
- A friend in a shop, the garage, a race or the menus disappears and comes
  back when they return to free roam.
- Traffic, races, money and saves are your own; nothing of your career is
  sent. Only your car's position and its look (with its hydraulics and
  nitrous: friends see the car lift and bounce, and the nitrous trails).
- No horn: players in the browser and the Mac port honk with N, but this
  plugin neither sounds one nor plays theirs.  They also hear your nitrous
  and hydraulics from your car; this plugin does not play theirs.

Uninstall: delete the two files.

/* roam_asi.c -- NFSU2FreeRoam.asi: free-roam multiplayer for the original PC
 * game (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 North America), the Windows companion of the Mac
 * port's feature.
 *
 * An Ultimate ASI Loader plugin (scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.asi, settings in
 * scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.ini, log in scripts\NFSU2FreeRoam.log).  The game
 * side is the Mac port's own runtime/roam_game.c and the protocol is the
 * same runtime/roam_core.c, built for 32-bit x86 (roam_host_win.h); the
 * network is roam_win.c (Winsock).
 *
 * What it changes in the game: one 5-byte call at 0x581475 in GameLoop (the
 * second of two empty debug calls between World::DoTimestep and the camera,
 * audio and render; the first, 0x581470, is ExtraOptions' hook) now calls
 * roam_frame_thunk, which runs the frame step and then jumps on to the
 * call's previous target (the game's empty 0x4022C0, or another mod's hook
 * that was there first).  Nothing else is patched; the game's own functions
 * are called from that hook only, on the game's main thread, exactly as the
 * Mac port calls them.
 *
 * Fail closed: the plugin checks the exe in memory first (entry point, the
 * code of every game function it calls, the instructions that use the game
 * globals it reads, the hook site; win/roam_asi/roam_fp.h, generated from
 * SPEED2.EXE by tools/roam_fingerprint.py) and does nothing on any mismatch,
 * with the reason in the log, never a message box.  A fault inside the frame
 * step (in the plugin, or in a game function it called) is caught by a
 * vectored exception handler: the game continues, the plugin switches
 * itself off and says so in the log.
 *
 * No C runtime: KERNEL32 and WS2_32 only (roam_libc.c has the few C
 * functions); built freestanding by tools/build_roam_asi.sh.
 */
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include "roam_core.h"
#include "roam_plat.h"
#include "roam_fp.h"

int  vsnprintf(char *buf, size_t n, const char *fmt, va_list ap);
int  snprintf(char *buf, size_t n, const char *fmt, ...);
typedef struct CPU CPU;                           /* the port's guest CPU: always 0 here */
void roam_game_frame(CPU *c);                     /* runtime/roam_game.c */
void roam_game_report(void);
void roam_win_poll(void);                         /* roam_win.c */
void roam_plat_fault_unlock(void);
int  roam_plat_quiesced(void);

#ifndef ROAM_ASI_VERSION
#define ROAM_ASI_VERSION "1.0"
#endif
void roam_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));

/* test aid (tests/asi_harness.c): NFSU2_ROAM_TEST_FAULT=N makes the first
 * game function called with an object in frame N get a bad one (a fault in
 * the game's code), -N a bad write in the plugin's own code in frame N */
static int     g_test_fault;
static volatile uint32_t g_test_fault_ptr = 0x10u;
/* test aid: NFSU2_ROAM_TEST_FAULT_SEH=N makes the plugin call the game's
 * Car::SetDriverType (0x5EBA30, which puts an SEH frame into FS:[0] first)
 * with a bad object in frame N: a fault inside a game function's SEH frame */
static int     g_test_fault_seh;

/* ---- the log --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static HANDLE           g_log = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_log_mu;
static uint32_t         g_log_bytes;
#define LOG_MAX (8u << 20)
void roam_log(const char *fmt, ...){
    if (g_log == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    char b[1100];
    SYSTEMTIME t; GetLocalTime(&t);
    int k = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%02u:%02u:%02u.%03u ", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, t.wMilliseconds);
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(b + k, sizeof b - (size_t)k - 2, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (n < 0) return;
    n += k; if (n > (int)sizeof b - 3) n = (int)sizeof b - 3;
    /* the core and the game side end their lines with \n: Windows wants \r\n */
    if (n > 0 && b[n - 1] == '\n') n--;
    b[n++] = '\r'; b[n++] = '\n';
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_log_mu);
    DWORD w = 0;
    if (g_log_bytes < LOG_MAX){
        WriteFile(g_log, b, (DWORD)n, &w, 0);
        g_log_bytes += (uint32_t)n;
        if (g_log_bytes >= LOG_MAX){ const char *m = "... log full (8 MB): nothing more is written\r\n"; WriteFile(g_log, m, (DWORD)lstrlenA(m), &w, 0); }
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_log_mu);
}
static void log_open(void){
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_log_mu);
    g_log = CreateFileA(g_logpath, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, 0, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, 0);
}

};
#define NOPT (int)(sizeof OPTS / sizeof OPTS[0])
static char g_optval[NOPT][160];
static int  g_opt_loaded;
static void trim(char *s){
    /* a comment after the value: ';' or '#' at the start or after a blank
     * (as on the Mac: "Team#1" stays a name) */
    for (char *c = s; *c; c++) if ((*c == ';' || *c == '#') && (c == s || c[-1] == ' ' || c[-1] == '\t')){ *c = 0; break; }
    int n = lstrlenA(s);
    while (n && (s[n - 1] == ' ' || s[n - 1] == '\t' || s[n - 1] == '\r' || s[n - 1] == '\n')) s[--n] = 0;
    int i = 0; while (s[i] == ' ' || s[i] == '\t') i++;
    if (i) for (int j = 0; ; j++){ s[j] = s[i + j]; if (!s[j]) break; }
}
static void opts_load(void){
    for (int i = 0; i < NOPT; i++){
        char *v = g_optval[i];
        DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableA(OPTS[i].name, v, sizeof g_optval[i]);
        if (n > 0 && n < sizeof g_optval[i]){ trim(v); continue; }
        GetPrivateProfileStringA("FreeRoam", OPTS[i].key, OPTS[i].def, v, sizeof g_optval[i], g_ini);
        trim(v);
    }
    g_opt_loaded = 1;
}
const char *roam_opt(const char *name){
    if (!g_opt_loaded) opts_load();
    for (int i = 0; i < NOPT; i++) if (!lstrcmpA(OPTS[i].name, name)) return g_optval[i][0] ? g_optval[i] : 0;
    /* other names: test aids from the environment only */
    static char ev[4][160]; static int k;
    char *v = ev[k++ & 3];
    DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, v, 160);
    return n > 0 && n < 160 ? v : 0;
}
static int opt_int(const char *name, int def){
    const char *v = roam_opt(name);
    if (!v) return def;
    int neg = *v == '-', x = 0, nd = 0;
    for (const char *p = v + neg; *p >= '0' && *p <= '9'; p++, nd++) x = x * 10 + (*p - '0');
    if (!nd) return (!lstrcmpiA(v, "on") || !lstrcmpiA(v, "yes") || !lstrcmpiA(v, "true")) ? 1 :
                    (!lstrcmpiA(v, "off") || !lstrcmpiA(v, "no") || !lstrcmpiA(v, "false")) ? 0 : def;
    return neg ? -x : x;
}

/* ---- guest memory: VirtualQuery, cached ------------------------------------------------------- */
static struct { uint32_t lo, hi; } g_vq[32];
static int g_vqn, g_vqnext;
static void vq_flush(void){ g_vqn = 0; g_vqnext = 0; }
int roam_win_committed(uint32_t a){
    if (a >= EXE_BASE && a < EXE_END) return 1;               /* the exe image is always there */
    for (int i = 0; i < g_vqn; i++) if (a >= g_vq[i].lo && a < g_vq[i].hi) return 1;
    if (a < 0x10000u) return 0;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    if (!VirtualQuery((LPCVOID)(uintptr_t)a, &mi, sizeof mi) || mi.State != MEM_COMMIT) return 0;
    DWORD p = mi.Protect;
    if (p & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) return 0;
    if (!(p & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE |
               PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY))) return 0;
    uint32_t lo = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress, hi = lo + (uint32_t)mi.RegionSize;
    if (hi < lo) hi = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    int k = g_vqn < 32 ? g_vqn++ : (g_vqnext++ & 31);
    g_vq[k].lo = lo; g_vq[k].hi = hi;
    return 1;
}

/* ---- calling the game's code ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* roam_call_asm(fn, ecx, edx, n, args): pushes args[n-1] .. args[0], loads
 * ecx and edx, calls fn, and restores esp from ebp afterwards, so that
 * thiscall/stdcall (callee pops) and cdecl (caller pops) both come back
 * balanced; ebx, esi, edi, ebp are saved here as well */
uint32_t roam_call_asm(uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, uint32_t edx, int n, const uint32_t *args);
__asm__(
    ".text\n"
    ".globl _roam_call_asm\n"
    "_roam_call_asm:\n"
    "    pushl %ebp\n"
    "    movl  %esp, %ebp\n"
    "    pushl %ebx\n"
    "    pushl %esi\n"
    "    pushl %edi\n"
    "    movl  20(%ebp), %eax\n"
    "    movl  24(%ebp), %esi\n"
    "1:  testl %eax, %eax\n"
    "    jle   2f\n"
    "    decl  %eax\n"
    "    pushl (%esi,%eax,4)\n"
    "    jmp   1b\n"
    "2:  movl  12(%ebp), %ecx\n"
    "    movl  16(%ebp), %edx\n"
    "    call  *8(%ebp)\n"
    "    leal  -12(%ebp), %esp\n"
    "    popl  %edi\n"
    "    popl  %esi\n"
    "    popl  %ebx\n"
    "    popl  %ebp\n"
    "    ret\n");
static uint32_t g_game_mxcsr, g_our_mxcsr = 0x1F80u;   /* MXCSR default: round to nearest, all masked */
static uint16_t g_game_fcw;
static uint32_t g_x87_popped;
uint32_t roam_win_mxcsr_default(void){ return 0x1F80u; }
uint32_t roam_win_call(uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, uint32_t edx, int n, const uint32_t *args){
    uint16_t sw0, sw1;
    if (g_test_fault > 0 && g_frame >= g_test_fault && ecx){ g_test_fault = 0; ecx = g_test_fault_ptr; }
    __asm__ volatile ("fnstsw %0" : "=m"(sw0));
    __asm__ volatile ("ldmxcsr %0" :: "m"(g_game_mxcsr));          /* the game's code, the game's MXCSR */
    uint32_t r = roam_call_asm(fn, ecx, edx, n, args);
    __asm__ volatile ("ldmxcsr %0" :: "m"(g_our_mxcsr));
    __asm__ volatile ("fnstsw %0" : "=m"(sw1));
    /* a function that returns a float leaves it in st(0): pop it, so the
     * x87 stack is as the game left it */
    int t0 = (sw0 >> 11) & 7, t1 = (sw1 >> 11) & 7, k = 0;
    while (t1 != t0 && k < 8){ __asm__ volatile ("fstp %%st(0)" ::: "st"); t1 = (t1 + 1) & 7; k++; }
    g_x87_popped += (uint32_t)k;
    return r;
}

/* ---- the frame hook ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
uint32_t g_roam_chain = HOOK_ORIG_TGT;            /* where the patched call went before */
uint32_t g_roam_resume_esp, g_roam_resume_ebp;   /* the fault guard's way back */
uint32_t g_roam_resume_seh;                       /* the thread's SEH chain head (FS:[0]) at the hook */
void roam_frame_thunk(void);
void roam_fault_resume(void);
void roam_asi_frame(void);
void roam_asi_fault(void);
__asm__(
    ".text\n"
    ".globl _roam_frame_thunk\n"
    "_roam_frame_thunk:\n"
    "    pushal\n"
    "    pushfl\n"
    "    movl  %esp, %ebp\n"
    "    andl  $-16, %esp\n"
    "    cld\n"
    "    movl  %esp, _g_roam_resume_esp\n"
    "    movl  %ebp, _g_roam_resume_ebp\n"
    "    movl  %fs:0, %eax\n"
    "    movl  %eax, _g_roam_resume_seh\n"
    "    call  _roam_asi_frame\n"
    "3:  movl  %ebp, %esp\n"
    "    popfl\n"
    "    popal\n"
    "    jmp   *_g_roam_chain\n"
    /* back from a fault: the game functions the plugin calls (CreateCar,
     * SetRideInfo, SetDriverType, SetPhysicsMode, ...) put an SEH frame on
     * the stack and into FS:[0] at their start; a fault inside them leaves
     * FS:[0] pointing below the stack the plugin resumes on, which is then
     * reused, and the next exception on this thread would walk a garbage
     * chain (with SEHOP: the process is ended).  The chain as it was at the
     * hook goes back first. */
    ".globl _roam_fault_resume\n"
    "_roam_fault_resume:\n"
    "    movl  _g_roam_resume_esp, %esp\n"
    "    movl  _g_roam_resume_ebp, %ebp\n"
    "    movl  _g_roam_resume_seh, %eax\n"
    "    movl  %eax, %fs:0\n"
    "    call  _roam_asi_fault\n"
    "    jmp   3b\n");

static volatile LONG g_guard;                     /* inside the frame step */
static DWORD  g_guard_tid;
static DWORD  g_fault_code; static uint32_t g_fault_eip, g_fault_addr; static int g_fault_rw;
static LONG CALLBACK roam_veh(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep){
    if (!g_guard || GetCurrentThreadId() != g_guard_tid) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    DWORD code = ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode;
    if (code != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && code != EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION && code != EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO &&
        code != EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION && code != EXCEPTION_IN_PAGE_ERROR && code != EXCEPTION_DATATYPE_MISALIGNMENT &&
        code != EXCEPTION_ARRAY_BOUNDS_EXCEEDED && code != EXCEPTION_INT_OVERFLOW) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint32_t eip = (uint32_t)ep->ContextRecord->Eip;
    /* only faults in our code or in the game's: anything else (a system
     * DLL probing memory under its own __try) is not ours to catch */
    if (!((eip >= g_self_lo && eip < g_self_hi) || (eip >= EXE_TEXT_LO && eip < EXE_TEXT_HI))) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    g_guard = 0;
    g_fault_code = code; g_fault_eip = eip;
    g_fault_addr = ep->ExceptionRecord->NumberParameters >= 2 ? (uint32_t)ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1] : 0;
    g_fault_rw = ep->ExceptionRecord->NumberParameters >= 1 ? (int)ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] : -1;
    ep->ContextRecord->Eip = (DWORD)(uintptr_t)roam_fault_resume;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
}
/* back from a fault: the game's FPU state, the plugin off for good */
void roam_asi_fault(void){
    __asm__ volatile ("fninit");
    __asm__ volatile ("fldcw %0" :: "m"(g_game_fcw));
    __asm__ volatile ("ldmxcsr %0" :: "m"(g_game_mxcsr));
    g_dead = 1;
    roam_plat_fault_unlock();
    roam_log("[roam] FAULT %08lx at %08x (%s %08x) in frame %ld, in %s: free-roam multiplayer is OFF until the game restarts; "
             "the game continues. Please send this log to the developers.\n", (unsigned long)g_fault_code, g_fault_eip,
             g_fault_rw == 1 ? "writing" : g_fault_rw == 8 ? "executing" : "reading", g_fault_addr, g_frame,
             g_fault_eip >= g_self_lo && g_fault_eip < g_self_hi ? "the plugin" : "a game function the plugin called");
    roam_plat_stop(1);                            /* BYE: friends remove this car at once */
}
long roam_win_frame_no(void){ return g_frame; }
uint64_t roam_win_ns(void){
    static LARGE_INTEGER f; LARGE_INTEGER c;
    if (!f.QuadPart && (!QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f) || !f.QuadPart)) f.QuadPart = 1000;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    return (uint64_t)(c.QuadPart / f.QuadPart) * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)(c.QuadPart % f.QuadPart) * 1000000000ull / (uint64_t)f.QuadPart;
}
static uint32_t g_world_last;
void roam_asi_frame(void){
    if (g_dead || !g_ready) return;
    __asm__ volatile ("stmxcsr %0" : "=m"(g_game_mxcsr));
    __asm__ volatile ("fnstcw %0" : "=m"(g_game_fcw));
    __asm__ volatile ("ldmxcsr %0" :: "m"(g_our_mxcsr));
    g_guard_tid = GetCurrentThreadId(); g_guard = 1;
    g_frame++;
    /* the World object changes at every track load: forget the memory map */
    uint32_t w = *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x00890080u;
    if (w != g_world_last || (g_frame & 1023) == 0){ vq_flush(); g_world_last = w; }
    if (g_test_fault < 0 && g_frame == -g_test_fault) *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)g_test_fault_ptr = 1u;
    if (g_test_fault_seh > 0 && g_frame == g_test_fault_seh){ uint32_t a = 0; roam_win_call(0x005EBA30u, g_test_fault_ptr, 0, 1, &a); }
    roam_win_poll();                              /* NetThread = 0, or no thread: receive here */
    roam_game_frame(0);
    g_guard = 0;
    __asm__ volatile ("ldmxcsr %0" :: "m"(g_game_mxcsr));
}

/* ---- the pose log (test aid) ------------------------------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct rh_file rh_file;
struct rh_file { HANDLE h; uint32_t n; char b[60000]; };
rh_file *rh_fopen(const char *path){
    static rh_file f;
    if (f.h && f.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    f.h = CreateFileA(path, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, 0, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, 0);
    f.n = 0;
    return f.h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? 0 : &f;
}
void rh_fflush(rh_file *f){ if (f && f->n){ DWORD w; WriteFile(f->h, f->b, f->n, &w, 0); f->n = 0; } }
int rh_fprintf(rh_file *f, const char *fmt, ...){
    if (!f) return 0;
    if (f->n > sizeof f->b - 600) rh_fflush(f);
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(f->b + f->n, sizeof f->b - f->n, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (n > 0) f->n += (uint32_t)n < sizeof f->b - f->n ? (uint32_t)n : (uint32_t)(sizeof f->b - f->n - 1);
    return n;
}

/* ---- the exe check ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* readable without a fault (at load there is no fault guard yet: a packed or
 * different exe must not crash the game here) */
static int readable(uint32_t a, uint32_t n){
    for (uint32_t p = a & ~0xFFFu; p < a + n; p += 0x1000u){
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
        if (!VirtualQuery((LPCVOID)(uintptr_t)p, &mi, sizeof mi) || mi.State != MEM_COMMIT || (mi.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) ||
            !(mi.Protect & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)))
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
static int exe_check(void){
    if ((uint32_t)(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(0) != EXE_BASE){
        roam_log("[roam] the game is not loaded at 0x400000: not SPEED2.EXE v1.2\n"); return 0; }
    const uint8_t *mz = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)EXE_BASE;
    if (!readable(EXE_BASE, 0x400)){ roam_log("[roam] the exe's header is not readable\n"); return 0; }
    uint32_t pe = *(const uint32_t *)(mz + 0x3C);
    if (mz[0] != 'M' || mz[1] != 'Z' || pe > 0x300 || *(const uint32_t *)(mz + pe) != 0x00004550u){
        roam_log("[roam] no PE header at 0x400000\n"); return 0; }
    uint32_t entry = *(const uint32_t *)(mz + pe + 0x28), stamp = *(const uint32_t *)(mz + pe + 8),
             size = *(const uint32_t *)(mz + pe + 0x50);
    roam_log("[roam] exe: entry point 0x%08x, time stamp 0x%08x, image size 0x%x\n", EXE_BASE + entry, stamp, size);
    if (EXE_BASE + entry != RF_ENTRY_VA){
        roam_log("[roam] entry point 0x%08x is not v1.2 North America's 0x%08x\n", EXE_BASE + entry, RF_ENTRY_VA); return 0; }
    int bad = 0, hooked = 0, nfn = 0, nref = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof RF / sizeof RF[0]; i++){
        const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)RF[i].va;
        if (!readable(RF[i].va, RF[i].len)){ roam_log("[roam]   0x%08x %s: not readable\n", RF[i].va, RF[i].what); bad++; continue; }
        uint32_t crc = rc_crc32(p, RF[i].len);
        if (RF[i].kind == RF_FN) nfn++; else nref++;
        if (crc == RF[i].crc) continue;
        /* a function another mod has replaced with a jump to its own code
         * (Unlimiter does this with UpdatePartsEnabled): still the same
         * function to call */
        if (RF[i].kind == RF_FN && (p[0] == 0xE9 || (p[0] == 0xFF && p[1] == 0x25) || (p[0] == 0x68 && p[5] == 0xC3))){
            roam_log("[roam]   0x%08x %s: replaced by another mod (a jump at its start): fine\n", RF[i].va, RF[i].what);
            hooked++; continue;
        }
        roam_log("[roam]   0x%08x %s: different code (crc %08x, v1.2 NA has %08x)\n", RF[i].va, RF[i].what, crc, RF[i].crc);
        bad++;
    }
    if (bad){ roam_log("[roam] %d of %u checks differ: this is not SPEED2.EXE v1.2 (North America)\n", bad, (unsigned)(sizeof RF / sizeof RF[0])); return 0; }
    roam_log("[roam] SPEED2.EXE v1.2 (North America) recognised: %d game functions (%d replaced by other mods) and %d "
             "uses of game globals checked\n", nfn, hooked, nref);
    return 1;
}

/* ---- the hook ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static int hook_install(void){
    uint8_t *site = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)HOOK_SITE;
    if (!readable(HOOK_SITE, 5)) return 0;
    if (site[0] != 0xE8){
        roam_log("[roam] the frame hook site 0x%08x is %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x, not a call: another mod changed it? Plugin off\n",
                 HOOK_SITE, site[0], site[1], site[2], site[3], site[4]);
        return 0;
    }
    int32_t rel; memcpy(&rel, site + 1, 4);
    uint32_t tgt = HOOK_SITE + 5u + (uint32_t)rel;
    uint32_t mine = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)roam_frame_thunk;
    if (tgt == mine){ roam_log("[roam] the frame hook is already installed\n"); return 1; }
    if (tgt != HOOK_ORIG_TGT) roam_log("[roam] another mod hooks 0x%08x too (it calls 0x%08x): it is called after this plugin's step\n", HOOK_SITE, tgt);
    g_roam_chain = tgt;
    DWORD old;
    if (!VirtualProtect(site, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &old)){ roam_log("[roam] VirtualProtect failed (%lu)\n", GetLastError()); return 0; }
    int32_t nrel = (int32_t)(mine - (HOOK_SITE + 5u));
    uint8_t code[5] = { 0xE8 }; memcpy(code + 1, &nrel, 4);
    memcpy(site, code, 5);
    VirtualProtect(site, 5, old, &old);
    FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), site, 5);
    roam_log("[roam] frame hook: call at 0x%08x now goes to the plugin (0x%08x), then on to 0x%08x\n", HOOK_SITE, mine, tgt);
    return 1;
}

/* ---- start-up ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void init_once(void){
    if (g_inited) return;
    g_inited = 1;
    char me[MAX_PATH];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(g_self, me, sizeof me);
    if (!n || n >= sizeof me - 4) return;
    lstrcpyA(g_ini, me); lstrcpyA(g_logpath, me);
    int dot = -1; for (int i = 0; g_ini[i]; i++) if (g_ini[i] == '.') dot = i; else if (g_ini[i] == '\\' || g_ini[i] == '/') dot = -1;
    if (dot < 0){ dot = lstrlenA(g_ini); }
    lstrcpyA(g_ini + dot, ".ini"); lstrcpyA(g_logpath + dot, ".log");
    opts_load();
    if (opt_int("NFSU2_ROAM_LOG", 1)) log_open();
    {
        IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *d = (IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *)g_self; IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *nt = (IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *)((uint8_t *)g_self + d->e_lfanew);
        g_self_lo = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)g_self; g_self_hi = g_self_lo + nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;
    }
    roam_log("[roam] NFSU2FreeRoam.asi %s (protocol %d) at 0x%08x; settings %s\n", ROAM_ASI_VERSION, RC_PROTO_VER, g_self_lo, g_ini);
    if (!opt_int("NFSU2_ROAM", 1)){ roam_log("[roam] Enable = 0 in the .ini: the plugin does nothing\n"); return; }
    if (!exe_check()){ roam_log("[roam] free-roam multiplayer stays OFF; the game runs as without the plugin\n"); return; }
    g_test_fault = opt_int("NFSU2_ROAM_TEST_FAULT", 0);
    g_test_fault_seh = opt_int("NFSU2_ROAM_TEST_FAULT_SEH", 0);
    if (!AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, roam_veh)) roam_log("[roam] no fault guard (AddVectoredExceptionHandler failed)\n");
    if (!hook_install()) return;
    g_ready = 1;
    roam_log("[roam] ready: the network starts with the game's first frame\n");
}

__declspec(dllexport) void InitializeASI(void){ init_once(); }

BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE h, DWORD reason, LPVOID reserved){
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH){
        g_self = (HMODULE)h;
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(h);
        /* like ExtraOptions and Unlimiter: everything at load (only kernel32
         * calls: the .ini, the log, the exe check, one 5-byte patch); the
         * network starts later, at the first frame.  InitializeASI (Ultimate
         * ASI Loader calls it next) finds it done. */
        init_once();
    } else if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_DETACH){
        /* at process exit every other thread is gone already; if the network
         * thread died holding the session lock, skip the report (and the
         * BYE: friends drop this car after 2 s anyway) */
        if (g_ready && !g_dead){ g_dead = 1; if (roam_plat_quiesced()) roam_game_report(); }
        if (g_x87_popped) roam_log("[roam] %u float result(s) of game functions popped off the x87 stack\n", g_x87_popped);
        roam_log("[roam] unloaded%s\n", reserved ? " (game exit)" : "");
        if (g_log != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){ CloseHandle(g_log); g_log = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
    }
    return TRUE;
}

/* roam_host_win.h -- free-roam multiplayer: what runtime/roam_game.c needs
 * from its host, for the Windows companion NFSU2FreeRoam.asi (the original
 * 32-bit SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA).  The names are those of runtime/roam_host.h
 * (the port); see there.
 *
 * Here the game's memory is the process's own: a guest address is a
 * pointer, and the guest functions are the game's original x86 code, called
 * through roam_win_call (roam_asi.c) with ecx/edx and stack arguments, any
 * convention (the stack pointer is restored after the call).  There is no C
 * runtime: the few C library functions roam_game.c uses come from
 * roam_libc.c, and no system header is included here (windows.h would bring
 * in names roam_game.c does not expect).
 */
#ifndef ROAM_HOST_WIN_H
#define ROAM_HOST_WIN_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdarg.h>

typedef struct CPU CPU;                  /* the port's guest CPU: not used here (always 0) */

/* ---- guest memory: the process's own -------------------------------------- */
#define MR8(a)   (*(uint8_t  *)(uintptr_t)(uint32_t)(a))
#define MR16(a)  (*(uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(uint32_t)(a))
#define MR32(a)  (*(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(uint32_t)(a))
#define MRF32(a) (*(float    *)(uintptr_t)(uint32_t)(a))
#define GPTR(a)  ((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(uint32_t)(a))
int      roam_win_committed(uint32_t a);          /* VirtualQuery, cached */
#define rh_committed(a) roam_win_committed(a)

/* ---- guest calls --------------------------------------------------------------- */
uint32_t roam_win_call(uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, uint32_t edx, int n, const uint32_t *args);
#define rh_call(c, fn, ecx, edx, n, args) ((void)(c), roam_win_call((fn), (ecx), (edx), (n), (args)))

/* ---- options, log, clocks ------------------------------------------------------- */
const char *roam_opt(const char *name);           /* environment, then the .ini */
void        roam_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
long        roam_win_frame_no(void);
uint64_t    roam_win_ns(void);
#define rlog(...)        roam_log(__VA_ARGS__)
#define rh_opt(k)        roam_opt(k)
#define rh_frame()       roam_win_frame_no()
#define rh_heap_mb()     0u
#define rh_hud_marker(x, y) ((void)(x), (void)(y))   /* the HUD as the game shows it */
#define RH_FE_NODES      512             /* the game's own level sorter (0x536520's 0x1000 bytes): nothing patched here */
#define rh_ns()          roam_win_ns()
/* no horn here: the companion neither sounds one nor plays friends', nor
 * their nitrous and hydraulics (carsfx.c) */
#define rh_horn_held(stick) ((void)(stick), 0)
#define rh_horn_mine()   (-1)
#define rh_horn_name(k)  ((void)(k), "another")
#define rh_horn_begin(pos, fwd, vel)   ((void)(pos), (void)(fwd), (void)(vel))
#define rh_horn_sound(who, name, kind, p, v) ((void)(who), (void)(name), (void)(kind), (void)(p), (void)(v))
#define rh_horn_end()    ((void)0)
#define rh_carsfx_begin(pos, fwd, vel)    ((void)(pos), (void)(fwd), (void)(vel))
#define rh_carsfx_car(who, name, p, v, st) ((void)(who), (void)(name), (void)(p), (void)(v), (void)(st))
#define rh_carsfx_end()  ((void)0)
/* no show-off here: the companion opens no parts and shows friends' cars closed (showoff.c needs the port's
 * overrides of the cars' drawing) */
#define rh_showoff_mine() ((uint8_t)0)
#define rh_showoff_car(c, k, car, open) ((void)(c), (void)(k), (void)(car), (void)(open))
/* no light key here either: the companion's lights are the game's, and friends' cars show theirs */
#define rh_lights_mine() 0
#define rh_lights_car(k, car, st) ((void)(k), (void)(car), (void)(st))
/* no crash damage here: the companion sends none, asks for none (no RC_HF_DENTS) and shows friends' cars undamaged */
#define rh_damage_on()   0
#define rh_damage_rev()  0u
#define rh_damage_mine(e, f, d, m) ((void)(e), (void)(f), (void)(d), (void)(m), 0)
#define rh_damage_car(c, k, car, peer, e, f, n, d) \
    ((void)(c), (void)(k), (void)(car), (void)(peer), (void)(e), (void)(f), (void)(n), (void)(d))
/* no license plates of our own here: the companion sends none, and friends' cars wear the game's (plates.c needs the
 * port's overrides of the cars' drawing) */
#define rh_plate_mine()  ""
#define rh_plate_car(k, car, text) ((void)(k), (void)(car), (void)(text))
#define rh_plates_forget() ((void)0)
#define rh_stance_mine(v) ((void)(v), 0)

/* roam_libc.c -- the C library subset NFSU2FreeRoam.asi needs (it links no C
 * runtime: no DLL besides KERNEL32 and WS2_32, nothing that could clash with
 * the game's or the other mods' runtimes).  Built with -fno-builtin
 * -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns, so these loops are not turned back
 * into calls of themselves.
 *
 * vsnprintf: %d %i %u %x %X %o %c %s %p %f %%, flags - 0 + space #, width
 * and precision (also *), length hh h l ll z j t.  %f is exact for what the
 * log prints (up to 18 significant digits); no %e/%g (printed as %f).
 */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdarg.h>

void *memcpy(void *d, const void *s, size_t n){
    uint8_t *o = d; const uint8_t *i = s;
    while (n--) *o++ = *i++;
    return d;
}
void *memmove(void *d, const void *s, size_t n){
    uint8_t *o = d; const uint8_t *i = s;
    if (o == i || !n) return d;
    if (o < i){ while (n--) *o++ = *i++; }
    else { o += n; i += n; while (n--) *--o = *--i; }
    return d;
}
void *memset(void *d, int c, size_t n){
    uint8_t *o = d;
    while (n--) *o++ = (uint8_t)c;
    return d;
}
int memcmp(const void *a, const void *b, size_t n){
    const uint8_t *x = a, *y = b;
    for (; n; n--, x++, y++) if (*x != *y) return *x < *y ? -1 : 1;
    return 0;
}
size_t strlen(const char *s){ size_t n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }
int strcmp(const char *a, const char *b){
    while (*a && *a == *b){ a++; b++; }
    return (uint8_t)*a - (uint8_t)*b;
}
int strncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t n){
    for (; n; n--, a++, b++){ if (*a != *b) return (uint8_t)*a - (uint8_t)*b; if (!*a) return 0; }
    return 0;
}
static int lower(int c){ return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c + 32 : c; }
int strncasecmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t n){
    for (; n; n--, a++, b++){
        int x = lower((uint8_t)*a), y = lower((uint8_t)*b);
        if (x != y) return x - y;
        if (!x) return 0;

    for (;; s++){
        if (*s == (char)c) return (char *)s;
        if (!*s) return 0;
    }
}
long strtol(const char *s, char **end, int base){
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\f' || *p == '\v') p++;
    int neg = 0;
    if (*p == '+' || *p == '-'){ neg = *p == '-'; p++; }
    if ((base == 0 || base == 16) && p[0] == '0' && (p[1] == 'x' || p[1] == 'X')){ p += 2; base = 16; }
    else if (base == 0) base = p[0] == '0' ? 8 : 10;
    const char *start = p;
    unsigned long v = 0, lim = neg ? 0x80000000ul : 0x7FFFFFFFul;
    int over = 0;
    for (;; p++){
        int d = *p >= '0' && *p <= '9' ? *p - '0' : lower((uint8_t)*p) >= 'a' && lower((uint8_t)*p) <= 'z' ? lower((uint8_t)*p) - 'a' + 10 : 99;
        if (d >= base) break;
        if (v > (lim - (unsigned long)d) / (unsigned long)base) over = 1;
        else v = v * (unsigned long)base + (unsigned long)d;
    }
    if (end) *end = (char *)(p == start ? s : p);
    if (over) return neg ? (long)-2147483647 - 1 : 2147483647L;
    return neg ? (long)(0 - v) : (long)v;
}

/* ---- vsnprintf -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct { char *b; size_t n, k; } Out;
static void put(Out *o, char c){ if (o->k + 1 < o->n) o->b[o->k] = c; o->k++; }
static void pad(Out *o, char c, int w){ while (w-- > 0) put(o, c); }
static int utoa(char *t, uint64_t v, unsigned base, int upper){
    const char *dg = upper ? "0123456789ABCDEF" : "0123456789abcdef";
    int n = 0;
    do { t[n++] = dg[v % base]; v /= base; } while (v);
    return n;                                     /* reversed */
}
static void emit_num(Out *o, const char *sign, const char *rev, int nd, int prec, int width, int left, int zero){
    int sl = 0; while (sign[sl]) sl++;
    int digits = nd > prec ? nd : prec;
    int w = width - sl - digits;
    if (!left && !zero) pad(o, ' ', w);
    for (int i = 0; i < sl; i++) put(o, sign[i]);
    if (!left && zero) pad(o, '0', w);
    pad(o, '0', digits - nd);
    for (int i = nd - 1; i >= 0; i--) put(o, rev[i]);
    if (left) pad(o, ' ', w);
}
static void emit_f(Out *o, double v, int prec, int width, int left, int zero, int plus, int space){
    char t[64]; int n = 0;
    const char *sign = "";
    uint64_t bits; memcpy(&bits, &v, 8);
    if (bits >> 63){ sign = "-"; v = -v; } else if (plus) sign = "+"; else if (space) sign = " ";
    if (v != v){ emit_num(o, sign, "nan", 3, 0, width, left, 0); return; }
    if (v > 1.8e18){ emit_num(o, sign, "fni", 3, 0, width, left, 0); return; }   /* inf or too large for us */
    if (prec > 9) prec = 9;
    uint64_t scale = 1; for (int i = 0; i < prec; i++) scale *= 10u;
    double sv = v * (double)scale;
    uint64_t whole;
    if (sv < 1.8e19){
        uint64_t q = (uint64_t)sv; double fr = sv - (double)q;
        if (fr > 0.5 || (fr == 0.5 && (q & 1u))) q++;
        whole = q / scale; uint64_t frac = q % scale;
        for (int i = 0; i < prec; i++){ t[n++] = (char)('0' + frac % 10u); frac /= 10u; }
    } else {                                       /* a huge value: no fraction digits */
        whole = (uint64_t)v;
        for (int i = 0; i < prec; i++) t[n++] = '0';
    }
    if (prec) t[n++] = '.';
    n += utoa(t + n, whole, 10, 0);
    emit_num(o, sign, t, n, 0, width, left, zero);
}
int vsnprintf(char *buf, size_t size, const char *f, va_list ap){
    Out o = { buf, size, 0 };
    for (; *f; f++){
        if (*f != '%'){ put(&o, *f); continue; }
        f++;
        int left = 0, zero = 0, plus = 0, space = 0, alt = 0, width = 0, prec = -1, len = 0;
        for (;; f++){
            if (*f == '-') left = 1; else if (*f == '0') zero = 1; else if (*f == '+') plus = 1;
            else if (*f == ' ') space = 1; else if (*f == '#') alt = 1; else break;
        }
        if (*f == '*'){ width = va_arg(ap, int); if (width < 0){ left = 1; width = -width; } f++; }
        else while (*f >= '0' && *f <= '9') width = width * 10 + (*f++ - '0');
        if (*f == '.'){
            f++; prec = 0;
            if (*f == '*'){ prec = va_arg(ap, int); f++; } else while (*f >= '0' && *f <= '9') prec = prec * 10 + (*f++ - '0');
        }
        for (;; f++){
            if (*f == 'h') len = len == -1 ? -2 : -1;
            else if (*f == 'l') len = len == 1 ? 2 : 1;
            else if (*f == 'z' || *f == 't') len = sizeof(size_t) == 8 ? 2 : 0;
            else if (*f == 'j') len = 2;
            else break;
        }
        char t[72]; int n;
        switch (*f){
        case 'd': case 'i': {
            int64_t v = len == 2 ? va_arg(ap, long long) : len == 1 ? va_arg(ap, long) : va_arg(ap, int);
            if (len == -1) v = (short)v; else if (len == -2) v = (signed char)v;
            uint64_t u = v < 0 ? 0 - (uint64_t)v : (uint64_t)v;
            n = utoa(t, u, 10, 0);
            emit_num(&o, v < 0 ? "-" : plus ? "+" : space ? " " : "", t, n, prec < 0 ? 1 : prec, width, left, zero && prec < 0);
            break; }
        case 'u': case 'x': case 'X': case 'o': {
            uint64_t v = len == 2 ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long long) : len == 1 ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long) : va_arg(ap, unsigned);
            if (len == -1) v = (unsigned short)v; else if (len == -2) v = (unsigned char)v;
            unsigned base = *f == 'u' ? 10u : *f == 'o' ? 8u : 16u;
            n = utoa(t, v, base, *f == 'X');
            emit_num(&o, alt && base == 16 && v ? (*f == 'X' ? "0X" : "0x") : "", t, n, prec < 0 ? 1 : prec, width, left, zero && prec < 0);
            break; }
        case 'p': {
            uintptr_t v = (uintptr_t)va_arg(ap, void *);
            n = utoa(t, v, 16, 0);
            emit_num(&o, "0x", t, n, 1, width, left, 0);
            break; }
        case 'c': { char c = (char)va_arg(ap, int); if (!left) pad(&o, ' ', width - 1); put(&o, c); if (left) pad(&o, ' ', width - 1); break; }
        case 's': {
            const char *s = va_arg(ap, const char *);
            if (!s) s = "(null)";
            int sl = 0; while (s[sl] && (prec < 0 || sl < prec)) sl++;
            if (!left) pad(&o, ' ', width - sl);
            for (int i = 0; i < sl; i++) put(&o, s[i]);
            if (left) pad(&o, ' ', width - sl);
            break; }
        case 'f': case 'F': case 'e': case 'E': case 'g': case 'G':
            emit_f(&o, va_arg(ap, double), prec < 0 ? 6 : prec, width, left, zero, plus, space);
            break;
        case '%': put(&o, '%'); break;
        case 0: f--; break;
        default: put(&o, '%'); put(&o, *f); break;
        }
    }
    if (size) buf[o.k < size ? o.k : size - 1] = 0;
    return (int)o.k;
}
int snprintf(char *buf, size_t n, const char *fmt, ...){
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    int r = vsnprintf(buf, n, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return r;
}

/* roam_win.c -- free-roam multiplayer: the Winsock platform layer under the
 * core, for NFSU2FreeRoam.asi.  It implements runtime/roam_plat.h exactly as
 * runtime/roam_bsd.c does on the Mac: one UDP socket, a network thread (or,
 * with NetThread=0 in the .ini, polling from the frame hook), the session
 * lock, the monotonic clock, the test-harness guard, the LAN discovery
 * targets.
 *
 * Test-harness guard (fail closed), as on the Mac: in test mode
 * (NFSU2_ROAM_HARNESS=1 in the environment, or TestMode=1 in the .ini) the
 * socket is bound to 127.0.0.1, every destination outside 127/8 and every
 * broadcast is refused before it reaches Winsock and logged as
 * "[roam] BLOCKED ...", and listed peers outside 127/8 are refused.
 *
 * Windows specifics: an ICMP "port unreachable" makes the next recvfrom of a
 * UDP socket fail with WSAECONNRESET (switched off with SIO_UDP_CONNRESET,
 * and ignored anyway); the interfaces for the directed broadcasts come from
 * SIO_GET_INTERFACE_LIST; the clock is QueryPerformanceCounter.
 */
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "roam_plat.h"

void roam_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
const char *roam_opt(const char *name);
void roam_game_event(int ev, int peer, const char *text);
int snprintf(char *buf, size_t n, const char *fmt, ...);
uint32_t roam_win_mxcsr_default(void);

#define SIO_UDP_CONNRESET _WSAIOW(IOC_VENDOR, 12)
#endif

static void mu_init(void){
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_mu_init, 1, 0) == 0){ InitializeCriticalSection(&g_mu); g_mu_init = 2; }
    while (g_mu_init != 2) Sleep(0);
}
void roam_plat_lock(void){ mu_init(); EnterCriticalSection(&g_mu); }
void roam_plat_unlock(void){ LeaveCriticalSection(&g_mu); }
int64_t roam_plat_now_us(void){
    LARGE_INTEGER c;
    if (!g_qpf.QuadPart && (!QueryPerformanceFrequency(&g_qpf) || !g_qpf.QuadPart)) g_qpf.QuadPart = 1000;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    int64_t f = g_qpf.QuadPart, q = c.QuadPart / f, r = c.QuadPart % f;
    return q * 1000000 + r * 1000000 / f;
}
uint32_t roam_plat_random(void){
    /* test aid (tests/asi_harness.c): a fixed session id, to compare the
     * plugin's datagrams byte for byte with the Mac build's */
    const char *tid = roam_opt("NFSU2_ROAM_TEST_ID");
    if (tid && *tid){
        uint32_t v = 0;
        for (const char *p = tid[0] == '0' && (tid[1] == 'x' || tid[1] == 'X') ? tid + 2 : tid; *p; p++)
            v = v << 4 | (uint32_t)(*p >= 'a' ? *p - 'a' + 10 : *p >= 'A' ? *p - 'A' + 10 : *p - '0');
        if (v) return v;
    }
    /* a session id: unique per start, not a secret */
    LARGE_INTEGER c; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    uint32_t h = 0x811C9DC5u, v[6] = { (uint32_t)c.QuadPart, (uint32_t)(c.QuadPart >> 32), GetTickCount(),
                                       GetCurrentProcessId(), GetCurrentThreadId(), (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&c };
    static uint32_t salt;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++){ h ^= (v[i] >> (8 * k)) & 255u; h *= 0x01000193u; }
    h ^= ++salt * 0x9E3779B9u;
    h ^= h >> 16; h *= 0x7FEB352Du; h ^= h >> 15; h *= 0x846CA68Bu; h ^= h >> 16;
    return h ? h : 1u;
}
const char *roam_ip_str(uint32_t ip, char *b){
    snprintf(b, 16, "%u.%u.%u.%u", ip >> 24, (ip >> 16) & 255u, (ip >> 8) & 255u, ip & 255u); return b; }
void roam_plat_get_stats(roam_plat_stats *o){ roam_plat_lock(); *o = g_st; roam_plat_unlock(); }

static int opt_on(const char *k){ const char *v = roam_opt(k); return v && *v && !(v[0] == '0' && !v[1]); }
